phrases.stem: The outdoor concert was ____ until next weekend because heavy rain was expected on Saturday night.
phrases.ex: because heavy rain was expected 說明無法如期舉行，until next weekend 表示「延到」下週末。
dist: put on：上演；穿上（上演不能接 until next weekend）

phrases.stem: I can no longer ____ my neighbor's loud music every night, so I will call the building manager.
phrases.ex: can no longer 加上要打電話給管理員，表示「再也忍受不了」吵鬧的音樂。
dist: come up with：想出（點子），與 up with 字形相近但意思不合

phrases.stem: After working through the night, the fire fighters finally ____ the fire before it reached the village.
phrases.ex: 消防員工作整夜，在火燒到村莊前「撲滅」它。

phrases.stem: She ____ a little money every month so that she could travel to Japan after graduation.
phrases.ex: every month 加上 so that she could travel，表示每月「存」一點錢當旅費。
dist: put on：穿上；增加（體重），put on weight 是字面陷阱

phrases.stem: At the meeting, Tom ____ a new plan to reduce waste, and everyone agreed to try it.
phrases.ex: 大家同意試試看，可知 Tom 在會中「提出」新計畫。
dist: put off：延期（與「大家同意試」矛盾）

phrases.stem: It was freezing outside, so Mia ____ her thickest coat and a warm hat before leaving the house.
phrases.ex: 外面很冷，出門前「穿上」最厚的外套。

phrases.stem: Our school ____ colorful posters all over the hallway last week to advertise the charity sale on Friday.
phrases.ex: to advertise 說明是「張貼」海報做宣傳。
dist: put away：收起來（與宣傳目的矛盾）
took off：脫下；拿掉（拿掉海報無法宣傳）

phrases.stem: Please ____ your toys after you finish playing; otherwise someone might trip over them in the dark.
phrases.ex: otherwise someone might trip over them 說明玩具要「收好」。

phrases.stem: Instead of encouraging her, her older brother always ____ her ideas, saying they were silly and useless.
phrases.ex: Instead of encouraging 與 saying they were silly 表示哥哥總是「貶低」她的想法。

phrases.stem: Lisa really ____ her mother; they both have curly hair, love to sing, and laugh the same way.
phrases.ex: 後半句說兩人都捲髮、都愛唱歌，表示 Lisa「像」媽媽。
dist: takes up：開始從事（嗜好）；占用

phrases.stem: When the old manager retired last year, his assistant ____ the company and made many changes to it.
phrases.ex: 經理退休後，助理「接管」公司並做了許多改變。

phrases.stem: After seeing a concert, my father decided to ____ the guitar at the age of fifty.
phrases.zh: take up：開始從事（嗜好、活動）
phrases.ex: 看完演唱會，五十歲才決定「開始學」吉他。

phrases.stem: Although she was already very busy, Amy agreed to ____ another project for the team.
phrases.ex: Although she was already very busy 形成對比：雖然很忙，仍同意「承擔」另一個專案。

phrases.stem: The story was so unbelievable that I was surprised so many people were ____ by it.
phrases.ex: 故事難以置信，卻有那麼多人「被騙」，所以感到驚訝。

phrases.stem: Please fasten your seat belts and turn off your phones; the plane will ____ in five minutes.
phrases.ex: 繫好安全帶，飛機五分鐘後「起飛」。

phrases.stem: As soon as he told me his phone number, I grabbed a pen to ____ the number before I forgot it.
phrases.ex: 拿筆是為了在忘記之前「記下」電話號碼。

phrases.stem: I am sorry I called you lazy this morning; I ____ what I said, and it was not fair.
phrases.ex: I'm sorry 表示道歉，所以「收回」剛才說的話。

phrases.stem: My little brother ____ the old radio to see how it worked, but he couldn't put it back together.
phrases.ex: 後半句 couldn't put it back together（裝不回去）說明他把收音機「拆開」了。

phrases.stem: It took him months to ____ the loss of his dog, but now he is smiling again.
phrases.zh: get over：從（悲傷、疾病）中恢復；克服
phrases.ex: 花了好幾個月，現在又笑了，表示他終於「走出」失去愛犬的傷痛。
dist: get along：相處融洽（後面要接 with 人）

phrases.stem: Jenny is friendly and kind to others, so she ____ almost everyone in her class and her club.
phrases.ex: friendly and kind 是原因，所以她和班上幾乎每個人都「處得好」。
dist: gets away with：做壞事而未受罰

phrases.stem: Without a job, the student had to ____ on only a few hundred dollars a month.
phrases.ex: 沒有工作，每月只靠幾百元「勉強過日子」。

phrases.stem: The speaker used simple examples and pictures to ____ her main idea to the young audience at the school.
phrases.zh: get across：把（想法）講清楚、傳達給人
phrases.ex: 用簡單例子是為了把主旨「傳達清楚」給年輕聽眾。

phrases.stem: We need to ____ these old newspapers in the living room; they are taking up too much space.
phrases.ex: 舊報紙太占空間，所以要「丟掉」。

phrases.stem: I do not know how I ____ that terrible week of exams, but I am glad it is finally over.
phrases.zh: get through：熬過；度過（困難時期）
phrases.ex: terrible week 加上 I'm glad it's over，表示「熬過」了那一週。
dist: got away：逃走（後面不能直接接 that week 當受詞）

phrases.stem: The thief thought he could ____ stealing, but the police caught him the next day.
phrases.zh: get away with：做壞事而逃過懲罰
phrases.ex: but the police caught him 形成對比：他以為偷東西可以「逍遙法外」。

phrases.stem: You should ____ the bus at the third stop and then walk two blocks to the museum.
phrases.ex: and then walk two blocks 表示在第三站「下車」再走路。
dist: get on：上（車），方向相反，上車後不會接著走路

phrases.stem: My high school friends and I ____ every summer to catch up and share stories.
phrases.ex: to catch up and share stories 說明大家每年夏天「聚在一起」。

phrases.stem: We need to ____ a better idea before the meeting, or the boss will be disappointed.
phrases.zh: come up with：想出（點子、辦法）
phrases.ex: 開會前要「想出」更好的點子，否則老闆會失望。

phrases.stem: Kevin ____ a bad cold after playing in the rain, and he had to stay in bed for three days.
phrases.zh: come down with：染上（感冒等小病）
phrases.ex: had to stay in bed 說明 Kevin「得了」重感冒。

phrases.stem: While cleaning the attic last weekend, I ____ some old photos of my grandfather and grandmother.
phrases.zh: come across：偶然發現；偶然遇到
phrases.ex: 打掃閣樓時「無意間發現」舊照片。
dist: came up：被提起；發生（不接受詞）

phrases.stem: Nobody knows exactly how the accident ____ last night; the police are still looking into it carefully.
phrases.ex: 警方仍在調查，所以沒人知道意外是怎麼「發生」的。
dist: came across：偶然遇到（需接受詞）

phrases.stem: After years of hard work and many difficult exams, her dream of becoming a doctor finally ____.
phrases.ex: 多年努力後，當醫生的夢想終於「實現」。

phrases.stem: The singer's new album will ____ next month, and fans are already lining up to buy it.
phrases.ex: 粉絲已排隊要買，表示新專輯下個月「推出」。

phrases.stem: Why don't you ____ to my house this weekend? We can watch a movie together.
phrases.ex: to my house 與一起看電影，表示邀請對方「過來」家裡。

phrases.stem: A problem ____ during the test, so the teacher had to stop and fix the computer.
phrases.ex: 老師只好停下來修電腦，表示考試中「出現」了問題。
dist: came across：偶然遇到（需接受詞）

phrases.stem: Hurry up! If you want to ____, get your jacket now, because we are leaving in two minutes.
phrases.ex: we are leaving in two minutes，想「一起去」就快拿外套。

phrases.stem: She ____ a lot of difficulties after moving abroad alone, but she never gave up on her dream.
phrases.ex: but she never gave up 形成對比：搬到國外後「經歷」許多困難，卻沒放棄。

phrases.stem: Before the final exam, the teacher ____ the main points of each chapter with us one more time.
phrases.ex: 考前老師和我們「複習」各章重點。

phrases.stem: Although Ben did not like the plan very much, he ____ it to avoid an argument with his team.
phrases.zh: go along with：附和；同意（不完全認同的事）
phrases.ex: Although he didn't like the plan 與 to avoid an argument，表示他勉強「配合」這個計畫。
dist: came up with：想出（他不喜歡這計畫，不會是他想的）
went off with：帶著……離開；拿走

phrases.stem: The alarm clock ____ at six, but I was so tired that I didn't hear it.
phrases.ex: didn't hear it 說明鬧鐘有「響」，只是沒聽到。

phrases.stem: The lights suddenly ____ during the storm last night, and the whole house became completely dark.
phrases.ex: the whole house became dark 表示燈「熄滅」了。
dist: went on：（燈）亮起；繼續，與變暗方向相反

phrases.stem: Please ____ with your story; I really want to know what happened after you got lost in the forest.
phrases.ex: 想知道接下來發生什麼，所以請對方「繼續」說。

phrases.stem: During the camping trip in the mountains, we had to ____ hot showers and the Internet for five days.
phrases.ex: 露營時五天都「沒有」熱水澡可洗。

phrases.stem: As time ____, she became more and more confident in speaking English in front of her classmates.
phrases.ex: 隨著時間「過去」，她說英文越來越有自信。

phrases.stem: "May I use your phone for a minute? Mine is dead." "Sure, ____. It is on the desk."
phrases.ex: Sure 表示同意，所以說「請用」。
dist: go away：走開（與 Sure 矛盾）

phrases.stem: To ____ missing her son's school play, she took him to the zoo and bought him ice cream the next day.
phrases.ex: 錯過兒子的學校表演，隔天帶他去動物園、買冰淇淋來「彌補」。

phrases.stem: The boy ____ a story about a dog eating his homework, but the teacher didn't believe him.
phrases.ex: the teacher didn't believe him 表示故事是「編出來」的。

phrases.stem: The writing on the old letter was so faded that I could hardly ____ the words.
phrases.ex: 字跡褪色，所以幾乎「看不清」字。

phrases.stem: We didn't have any milk, so we had to ____ water when making the pancakes.
phrases.ex: 沒有牛奶，只好「將就用」水做鬆餅。

phrases.stem: When the fire alarm rang, everyone ____ the nearest exit as fast as possible without looking back.
phrases.ex: 火警響起，大家以最快速度「朝」最近的出口走去。
dist: made off：匆忙逃走（不直接接地點受詞）

phrases.stem: The two friends had a big fight, but they ____ the next day and are close again.
phrases.ex: but 與 are close again 表示吵架後隔天就「和好」了。

phrases.stem: The traffic on the highway was terrible, but we ____ to the airport just in time for our flight.
phrases.ex: 雖然塞車，但 just in time 表示「及時趕到」機場。

phrases.stem: Before you leave the room, please ____ that all the windows are closed and the lights are off.
phrases.ex: 離開教室前「確認」窗戶都關好。

phrases.stem: It is not kind to ____ people who speak English with an accent; everyone is still learning.
phrases.ex: not kind 與 everyone is still learning，表示不該「取笑」有口音的人。

phrases.stem: Although the workers protested for weeks, the company refused to ____ to their demands for higher pay.
phrases.ex: 工人抗議數週，公司仍拒絕對他們的要求「讓步」。to their demands 是 give in 的固定搭配。
dist: give up：放棄（不接 to 人的要求）

phrases.stem: Tired of arguing, Dad finally ____ and let us stay up to watch the movie.
phrases.ex: Tired of arguing 加上 let us stay up，表示爸爸終於「讓步」。

phrases.stem: Smoking is bad for your health and your family's health; you should ____ it as soon as possible.
phrases.ex: 抽菸傷身，應該盡快「戒掉」。
dist: give in：讓步；屈服（不接受詞 it）

phrases.stem: Don't ____ your dream just because one person said you couldn't do it; keep trying.
phrases.ex: 不要因為一個人說你辦不到就「放棄」夢想。
dist: give in：讓步（不直接接受詞）

phrases.stem: On the first day of the festival, volunteers stood at the door, ____ free maps to every visitor.
phrases.ex: 站在門口把免費地圖「發給」每位訪客。

phrases.stem: The rotten fish ____ such a terrible smell that we had to open all the windows.
phrases.ex: 腐爛的魚「散發」出可怕的味道，只好開窗。

phrases.stem: Since she was moving abroad, she ____ most of her books to the local library.
phrases.ex: 要搬出國，所以把大部分的書「捐給」圖書館。
dist: gave out：分發；用完、停止運作（give out 多指「發給很多人」，捐給圖書館用 give away）

phrases.stem: Please ____ the books you borrowed from me by Friday, because I need them for the exam.
phrases.ex: you borrowed from me 加上 I need them，表示請對方週五前「還書」。
dist: give away：送掉（與 I need them 矛盾）

phrases.stem: The old bridge suddenly ____ under the weight of the heavy truck and fell into the river.
phrases.ex: under the weight 與 fell into the river 表示橋「垮了」。

phrases.stem: After her parents passed away in an accident, she was ____ by her grandmother in a small village.
phrases.ex: 父母過世後，她由祖母「撫養長大」。

phrases.stem: Please don't ____ the topic of money at dinner tonight; it always starts a fight between my parents.
phrases.ex: the topic 加上 it always starts a fight，表示別在晚餐時「提起」錢的話題。

phrases.stem: The new law ____ great changes in the way people in our city sort and recycle their trash.
phrases.ex: 新法「帶來」回收方式的重大改變。

phrases.stem: The new phone will be ____ next month in three different colors, and many fans cannot wait to buy one.
phrases.ex: 新手機下個月以三種顏色「上市」。

phrases.stem: The government is trying to ____ the price of eggs, which has risen sharply this year.
phrases.ex: which has risen sharply 說明蛋價大漲，政府想「壓低」價格。
dist: bring up：提起；養育（價格已漲，政府不會再推高）

phrases.stem: This old song always ____ memories of my childhood summers at the beach with my whole family.
phrases.ex: 老歌總是「喚起」童年在海邊的夏日回憶。

phrases.stem: The night market is popular with visitors and ____ a lot of money for the town every year.
phrases.ex: 夜市受遊客歡迎，每年為小鎮「賺進」很多錢。

phrases.stem: A good coach knows how to ____ the best in every player, even the shy and quiet ones.
phrases.zh: bring out：激發；使顯現（the best in sb）
phrases.ex: 好教練懂得「激發」每位球員最好的一面。

phrases.stem: Every year, the festival ____ people from different cultures to share their food, music, and stories.
phrases.ex: to share food and music 表示節慶「讓」不同文化的人「聚在一起」。

phrases.stem: The lecture was so boring that many students began to ____ and look at their phones.
phrases.ex: 演講太無聊，學生開始「放空」滑手機。
dist: tune in：收看；收聽，與放空方向相反

phrases.stem: The new dance first appeared online, and it quickly ____ among teenagers all over the world.
phrases.ex: 在網路出現後，很快在全世界青少年之間「流行起來」。

phrases.stem: This math problem is really hard, but if we work together, I'm sure we can ____.
phrases.zh: figure it out：想出答案；弄懂
phrases.ex: 題目很難，但一起努力一定能「解出來」。
dist: give it out：把它分發出去

phrases.stem: She ____ the job offer because the company was too far from her home and the pay was low.
phrases.ex: because 後說明公司太遠、薪水低，所以「拒絕」這份工作。

phrases.stem: Everyone expected the test to be hard, but it ____ to be much easier than we had thought.
phrases.zh: turn out (to be)：結果是、原來是
phrases.ex: but 表對比：本來以為很難，「結果」卻很簡單；turn out to be 是固定用法。
dist: turn into：變成（後接名詞，不接 to be）

phrases.stem: We waited for Tom for an hour, but he never ____, so we went to the movie without him.
phrases.ex: 等了一小時他都沒「出現」，所以我們自己去看電影。

phrases.stem: The police promised to ____ the cause of the fire and report the results to the public next week.
phrases.ex: 警方要查明起火原因並公布結果，是「調查」。

phrases.stem: Many young players ____ the team captain because he works hard and is always willing to help others.
phrases.ex: because 說明隊長努力又樂於助人，所以大家「尊敬」他。
dist: look down on：瞧不起（方向相反）
look forward to：期待（對象應是事情）

phrases.stem: After a long semester full of tests, the students are all ____ the summer vacation at the beach.
phrases.ex: 考了一學期的試，學生「期待」暑假到來。
dist: look up to：尊敬（對象是人）

phrases.stem: It is wrong to ____ people just because they are poor or have had less education than you.
phrases.ex: 因為別人窮或學歷低就「瞧不起」他們是不對的。
dist: look up to：尊敬（方向相反，「因為窮而尊敬」不合理）
look after：照顧（照顧窮人不是錯事）

phrases.stem: My car ____ on the highway last night, so I had to walk two miles to the nearest gas station.
phrases.zh: break down：（機器、車子）故障、拋錨
phrases.ex: 車子「拋錨」了，只好走路去加油站。

phrases.stem: The fire ____ in the middle of the night, and soon the whole building was in flames.
phrases.zh: break out：（火災、戰爭、疾病）爆發
phrases.ex: 半夜「發生」火災，整棟樓陷入火海。

phrases.stem: A thief ____ the house while the family was away on vacation and took their jewelry and TV.
phrases.ex: 小偷趁全家度假時「闖入」屋內偷東西。
dist: break out：爆發；逃出（逃出要用 break out of）

phrases.stem: After ten years with the band, the singer decided to ____ the group and start a career of her own.
phrases.ex: start a career of her own 說明她要「脫離」樂團單飛。
dist: break into：闖入；進入（某行業），與「單飛」矛盾

phrases.stem: The scientists will ____ a series of experiments to find out whether the new medicine is safe for children.
phrases.zh: carry out：執行、進行（實驗、計畫）
phrases.ex: 「進行」一系列實驗以確認新藥是否安全。

phrases.stem: Although it started to rain, the players ____ with the game until the referee finally stopped it.
phrases.ex: 雖然下雨，球員仍「繼續」比賽，直到裁判叫停。

phrases.stem: "____ a minute, please. I will check whether the manager is in his office," the secretary said on the phone.
phrases.zh: hold on：（電話中）稍等、別掛斷
phrases.ex: 電話中請對方「稍等」一下，秘書去查經理在不在。

phrases.stem: She did her best to ____ her tears at the funeral, but when her best friend hugged her, she began to cry.
phrases.ex: but 表對比：她努力「忍住」眼淚，最後還是哭了。

phrases.stem: Sorry I'm late for the meeting. I was ____ by heavy traffic on the way here.
phrases.ex: 因為塞車被「耽擱」所以遲到。

phrases.stem: He reads the news every morning to ____ what is happening in Taiwan and around the world.
phrases.zh: keep up with：跟上；了解最新情況
phrases.ex: 每天看新聞是為了「跟上」世界動態。
dist: keep away from：遠離（與看新聞的目的相反）

phrases.stem: The sign in the park says "____ the grass," so please walk on the path instead.
phrases.ex: so 請走步道，可知告示是「勿踩草皮」。

phrases.stem: Even though his mother said no several times, the little boy ____ asking her for a new toy.
phrases.ex: Even though 表讓步：媽媽拒絕多次，孩子仍「一直」吵著要玩具。
dist: keep up with：跟上（不接 V-ing）

phrases.stem: We ____ for the mountains at five in the morning so that we could reach the top before noon.
phrases.ex: 清晨五點「出發」，才能中午前登頂。

phrases.stem: With some money borrowed from his parents, he ____ a small coffee shop near the university.
phrases.ex: 用借來的錢「開」了一家咖啡店。

phrases.stem: No matter how busy she is, she ____ an hour every evening for reading, because books help her relax.
phrases.ex: 每晚「撥出」一小時閱讀；no matter how busy 強調特地留時間。

phrases.stem: I ____ an old classmate at the supermarket yesterday; we hadn't seen each other for ten years.
phrases.ex: 十年沒見，在超市「巧遇」老同學。

phrases.stem: The printer has ____ paper. Could you bring some more from the office next door?
phrases.ex: 請人再拿紙來，可知印表機的紙「用完」了。

phrases.stem: The driver didn't see the dog in the dark and almost ____ it, but he stopped the car just in time.
phrases.ex: 開車沒看到狗，差點「輾過」牠。
dist: run after：追趕（他沒看到狗，不可能追）
run away：逃跑（不接受詞 it）

phrases.stem: The old chair was so badly made that it ____ the moment I sat on it.
phrases.ex: 椅子做得很差，一坐就「散掉」了。

phrases.stem: After missing two weeks of school because of illness, Jenny ____ the rest of her class in math.
phrases.ex: 病假兩週，所以數學進度「落後」同學。

phrases.stem: Our plan to travel to Japan ____ when my father suddenly had to work over the holidays.
phrases.zh: fall through：（計畫、交易）告吹、落空
phrases.ex: 爸爸臨時要加班，出國計畫「泡湯」了。

phrases.stem: He ____ her the first time he saw her at the library, and they got married a year later.
phrases.ex: 一見面就「愛上」她，一年後結婚。

phrases.stem: The doctor told my father to ____ salt and sugar if he wants to lower his blood pressure.
phrases.zh: cut down on：減少（攝取、使用）
phrases.ex: 想降血壓就要「減少」鹽和糖。

phrases.stem: Our electricity was ____ last week because we had forgotten to pay the bill for three months.
phrases.ex: 三個月沒繳電費，所以電被「斷」了。

phrases.stem: It's rude to ____ while other people are talking; please wait until they have finished.
phrases.ex: 別人說話時「插嘴」很沒禮貌，要等他們說完。

phrases.stem: Could you ____ my sister from school on your way home? Her class finishes at four.
phrases.ex: 順路去學校「接」妹妹。

phrases.stem: She ____ some Japanese while working in Tokyo for a year, though she never took a single class.
phrases.ex: 沒上過課，卻在東京工作時「學會」一些日語。

phrases.stem: Look at this class photo from twenty years ago. Can you ____ my mother among all these students?
phrases.ex: 從團體照中「認出」哪個是我媽媽。

phrases.stem: The baseball game was ____ because of the typhoon, and everyone who bought a ticket will get their money back.
phrases.ex: 因颱風比賽「取消」，買票的人可退費。

phrases.stem: The air pollution in the city has become so serious that it ____ immediate action from the government.
phrases.ex: 污染嚴重到「需要」政府立刻採取行動。

phrases.stem: During our trip to Tainan, we ____ my grandmother and stayed at her house for a night.
phrases.ex: stayed at her house 說明是親自「拜訪」祖母。
dist: call up：打電話給（但有住在她家）

phrases.stem: You can always ____ Mark when you need help; he has never broken a promise to any of his friends.
phrases.ex: 他從不食言，所以你可以「依靠」他。

phrases.stem: Don't ____ the weather being good this weekend; the report says there is a strong chance of rain.
phrases.zh: count on：指望、期待（某事會發生）
phrases.ex: 氣象說可能下雨，別「指望」天氣會好。

phrases.stem: All her hard work finally ____ when she was accepted by the university of her dreams.
phrases.zh: pay off：（努力）有成果、成功（熟字生義）
phrases.ex: 考上夢想大學，表示努力終於「有回報」。

phrases.stem: Starting the business was a big risk, but it ____: the shop made a profit in its very first year.
phrases.zh: pay off：（冒險、計畫）成功、值得
phrases.ex: 冒險創業，第一年就賺錢，表示「成功了」。
dist: pay for：付錢買；付出代價（需受詞）

phrases.stem: He borrowed some money from his brother and promised to ____ him as soon as he found a job.
phrases.ex: 借了錢，承諾找到工作就「還」哥哥。
dist: pay off：還清（債務）；成功；收買（不用於還錢給家人）

phrases.stem: After trying for nearly an hour, I finally ____ the answer to the last math problem.
phrases.zh: work out：算出、想出（答案、辦法）
phrases.ex: 試了快一小時，終於「解出」答案。
dist: work on：致力於（finally 表示已完成，不合）

phrases.stem: Don't worry too much about the problem with your boss. I am sure everything will ____ fine in the end.
phrases.zh: work out：（事情）順利解決、有好結果
phrases.ex: 安慰對方：最後一切都會「順利」的。

phrases.stem: In many countries, a white bird called the dove ____ peace, so it often appears on posters against war.
phrases.ex: 和平鴿「象徵」和平，所以常出現在反戰海報上。

phrases.stem: In her bright red coat, she really ____ in the crowd of people who were all dressed in black.
phrases.ex: 紅外套在一片黑衣人中很「顯眼」。

phrases.stem: No matter what other people say about you, I will always ____ you, because you are my best friend.
phrases.ex: 不管別人說什麼，我都會「支持」你。

phrases.stem: He loves to ____ his expensive new phone to everyone, which makes his classmates a little annoyed.
phrases.ex: 到處「炫耀」新手機，讓同學覺得煩。

phrases.stem: Only five people ____ for the meeting, so we decided to hold it again another day.
phrases.ex: 只有五人「到場」，所以改天再開。

phrases.stem: Run faster! The others are already far ahead, and if we don't hurry, we will never ____ them.
phrases.ex: 別人已遙遙領先，要快跑才能「趕上」他們。
dist: catch up on：補做（睡眠、工作），對象是事不是人

phrases.stem: The idea of bringing your own cup ____ quickly, and now most coffee shops in the city offer a small discount for it.
phrases.ex: now most coffee shops...offer a discount 說明這個做法很快「流行」起來。

phrases.stem: He had to ____ of school when he was only 15 to help his parents run their small store.
phrases.ex: 十五歲就「輟學」幫忙顧店；drop out of school 是固定用法。
dist: drop in：順道拜訪（不接 of）

phrases.stem: If you are ever in the neighborhood, feel free to ____ for a cup of tea and a chat.
phrases.ex: 在附近的話歡迎「順道過來」喝茶聊天。

phrases.stem: I have worn these shoes every day for three years, and they are completely ____, so I need to buy a new pair.
phrases.zh: wear out：穿破、用壞；（人）筋疲力盡
phrases.ex: 天天穿了三年，鞋子已「穿壞」了，要買新的。
dist: wear off：（效果、感覺）逐漸消失
wear in：（新鞋）穿到合腳（與要買新鞋矛盾）

phrases.stem: The effect of the medicine began to ____ after a few hours, and soon the pain came back.
phrases.zh: wear off：（藥效、感覺）逐漸消失
phrases.ex: 幾小時後藥效「退了」，疼痛又回來。

phrases.stem: Always ____ your important files so that you will not lose them if your computer breaks down.
phrases.ex: 電腦壞了也不會遺失，是因為有「備份」。

phrases.stem: When the teacher didn't believe me, my friends ____ my story and said they had seen everything.
phrases.ex: 朋友說他們都看到了，是在「替我作證」。

phrases.stem: Please ____ your reports to me by Friday afternoon; late work will not be accepted for any reason.
phrases.ex: 遲交不收，所以要在週五前「繳交」報告。

phrases.stem: Along the race route, volunteers ____ free bottles of water to the tired runners as they passed.
phrases.ex: 志工沿路「分發」水給跑者。

phrases.stem: This ring has been ____ in my family for four generations, from mother to daughter.
phrases.ex: 四代由母傳女，是「代代相傳」。
dist: hand over：交出、移交（指一次性交出，不用於世代相傳）

phrases.stem: His grandfather ____ peacefully in his sleep last night after a long and happy life of 92 years.
phrases.ex: 長壽一生後在睡夢中安詳「辭世」。

phrases.stem: It was so hot during the ceremony that one of the students ____ and had to be carried to the nurse's office.
phrases.ex: 天氣太熱，學生「昏倒」被抬到保健室。
dist: pass away：過世（被送保健室表示只是昏倒）

phrases.stem: Could you ____ this message to my teacher when she gets back? I have to leave for the airport now.
phrases.ex: 自己要離開，請人把訊息「轉達」給老師。

phrases.stem: To apply for the job, you must ____ this form and send it back to us with a recent photo.
phrases.ex: 申請工作要「填寫」表格並寄回。

phrases.stem: Please ____ the gas tank before you return the car; otherwise, you will have to pay extra.
phrases.ex: 還車前要把油「加滿」。
dist: fill with：使充滿（要說 fill A with B）

phrases.stem: Our math teacher is sick in the hospital this week, so another teacher will ____ him in class.
phrases.ex: 數學老師住院，由另一位老師「代課」。

phrases.stem: After years of traveling around the world, he finally ____ in a small town and got married.
phrases.ex: 四處旅行多年後終於「定居」結婚。

phrases.stem: It took the new student a few weeks to ____ at her new school, but now she has many friends there.
phrases.ex: 花幾週「適應」新學校，現在朋友很多。

phrases.stem: Once you have made a study plan, ____ it; don't change your mind every time something goes wrong.
phrases.zh: stick to：堅持、遵守（計畫、原則）
phrases.ex: 後半句說不要一直改變主意，所以要「堅持」計畫。

phrases.stem: Why don't you ____ for a while after the party? We could talk about the old days.
phrases.ex: 派對後「留下來」聊聊往事。

phrases.stem: His ears ____ so much that his classmates gave him a funny nickname when he was little.
phrases.ex: 耳朵很「突出」，所以被取綽號。

phrases.stem: His classmates called him "Professor" as a joke in first grade, and the nickname ____ him all through high school.
phrases.zh: stick with：（名字、印象）一直跟著；沿用（the name stuck＝名字沿用下來）
phrases.ex: 一年級的綽號一路「跟著」他到高中，也就是一直被沿用。
dist: stand by：支持（某人）；主詞是綽號，不能「支持」他

phrases.stem: To ____, the new plan is cheap, easy to carry out, and good for the environment.
phrases.zh: sum up：總結；to sum up＝總而言之
phrases.ex: 句首用來把前述優點「總結」一下。

phrases.stem: In the last paragraph, the writer ____ the main points of the whole article in just two sentences.
phrases.ex: 最後一段用兩句話「總結」全文重點。
dist: take up：佔據（空間、時間）；開始從事

phrases.stem: The doctor asked me to come back next week to ____ on the results of my blood test.
phrases.ex: 下週回診「追蹤」驗血結果。

phrases.stem: After the job interview, she sent the manager an email to ____ and thank him for his time.
phrases.ex: 面試後寄信「後續聯繫」並致謝。

phrases.stem: Everyone in the waiting room was ____ as they waited nervously for the doctor to announce the results of the surgery.
phrases.ex: waited nervously 說明大家心情緊繃，所以是「緊張不安」。
dist: on the whole：大體上、整體而言

phrases.stem: My sister has been ____ all week; she cannot sleep well and gets angry at the smallest things because of her coming job interview.
phrases.ex: 睡不好、為小事生氣，原因是面試將至，表示他「焦躁不安」。
dist: on the spot：當場；立刻（與心情無關）
on end：連續不斷地（須接在時間後）

phrases.stem: The manager was so impressed by Amy's interview that she offered her the job ____, without waiting to talk with anyone else.
phrases.ex: without waiting 說明沒有拖延，「當場」就錄用他。
dist: on the whole：大體上、整體而言

phrases.stem: The police arrived within minutes, and the thief was arrested ____, with the stolen jewelry still in his bag.
phrases.ex: 警察很快趕到，珠寶還在袋子裡，表示小偷「當場」被抓。

phrases.stem: I am sure he broke the window ____; I saw him pick up a stone, aim carefully, and throw it as hard as he could.
phrases.ex: pick up a stone, aim carefully 表示他是有意的，所以是「故意」打破。

phrases.stem: It rained for days ____ last month, and the river finally rose high enough to flood several farms near the village.
phrases.ex: for days on end＝一連好幾天，雨下不停才會讓河水暴漲。

phrases.stem: Since the president of the company was sick, the vice president gave a speech ____ the whole company to thank the volunteers.
phrases.ex: 總裁生病，由副總裁「代表」全公司致詞。
dist: on top of：在……之上；除……之外

phrases.stem: ____ losing her job, Amy also lost her home in the same month, and she had no idea where to turn for help.
phrases.zh: on top of：除了……之外（還有）
phrases.ex: also 表示壞事一件接一件：「除了」失業之外，還失去住處。
dist: on the whole：大體上、整體而言
on the way to：在去……的路上

phrases.stem: Because of hunting and the loss of forests, this kind of tiger is now ____ disappearing, with fewer than 500 left in the wild.
phrases.ex: 只剩不到 500 隻，表示「有」消失的「危險」。

phrases.stem: There were a few problems with the sound system, but ____, the concert was a great success and the fans loved it.
phrases.zh: on the whole：大體上、整體而言
phrases.ex: 雖有小問題（but 轉折），「整體而言」演唱會很成功。

phrases.stem: The number of people working from home is ____; it has doubled in the past five years and is still growing.
phrases.ex: doubled、still growing 說明人數「正在增加」。

phrases.stem: The nurse who was ____ that night noticed the patient's breathing problem and called the doctor at once.
phrases.ex: 那晚「值班」的護士發現病人呼吸問題並立刻叫醫生。

phrases.stem: I planned to order the steak, but ____, I'll have the fish instead because I already had beef for lunch.
phrases.zh: on second thought：再想一想、改變主意
phrases.ex: 本來要點牛排，後來因為午餐吃過牛肉而「改變主意」點魚。

phrases.stem: Living in a big city is convenient because everything is nearby. ____, it can be noisy, crowded, and very expensive.
phrases.zh: on the other hand：另一方面
phrases.ex: 前句講優點、後句講缺點，需要表示對比的「另一方面」。
dist: on the whole：大體上（是總結，不是對比）

phrases.stem: When the tourist asked me a question in Russian, I was completely ____ for words because I didn't understand any of it.
phrases.zh: at a loss：不知所措（at a loss for words：說不出話）
phrases.ex: 聽不懂俄語，所以「不知該說什麼」。

phrases.stem: The doctors were ____ to explain the boy's sudden illness, as all of his test results looked perfectly normal.
phrases.zh: at a loss：困惑、不知所措
phrases.ex: 檢查結果都正常，醫生「無法解釋」病因。

phrases.stem: Children who spend too many hours in front of screens may be ____ of developing poor eyesight at a young age.
phrases.ex: 看螢幕太久「有」視力變差的「風險」。
dist: at stake：攸關成敗（不接 of＋V-ing）

phrases.stem: The players knew exactly what was ____ in this game: the winner would go on to play in the world championship.
phrases.zh: at stake：攸關成敗、得失所繫
phrases.ex: 冒號後說明勝者可進世界賽，這就是這場比賽「攸關」的東西。

phrases.stem: The general ordered his soldiers to protect the bridge ____, even if it meant losing their own lives.
phrases.zh: at all costs：不惜任何代價
phrases.ex: even if it meant losing their own lives 表示「不惜一切代價」。

phrases.stem: Lost at sea in a small boat with no engine, the three men were ____ the wind and waves for three days.
phrases.zh: at the mercy of：任由……擺布
phrases.ex: 小船沒引擎，只能「任由」風浪擺布。
dist: at the risk of：冒著……的危險
at the cost of：以……為代價
at the end of：在……的末端

phrases.stem: He fell in love with her ____; the moment he saw her smile at the party, he knew she was the one.
phrases.zh: at first sight：一見（鍾情）、第一眼
phrases.ex: the moment he saw her 說明是「第一眼」就愛上。

phrases.stem: The kind nurse talked gently with the nervous patient to put him ____ before the operation began.
phrases.zh: at ease：自在、放鬆（put sb at ease：使安心）
phrases.ex: 病人緊張，護士溫柔說話是為了讓他「放鬆」。

phrases.stem: The winners of the prize were chosen ____ by a computer, so everyone who joined had an equal chance.
phrases.ex: everyone had an equal chance 說明是「隨機」選出。

phrases.stem: People worked for hours to save the old house, but ____; by morning, it had burned to the ground.
phrases.ex: 努力了好幾小時，房子仍燒毀，表示努力「白費」。

phrases.stem: Our English teacher has been ____ the school's English club for five years, planning all its activities and choosing its new members.
phrases.ex: 規劃活動、挑選新成員，表示她「負責」這個社團。

phrases.stem: Clean water was ____ after the earthquake, so each family could receive only two bottles a day.
phrases.zh: in short supply：供應不足、短缺
phrases.ex: 每戶每天只能領兩瓶，表示乾淨的水「短缺」。
dist: in the long run：長遠來看

phrases.stem: When the cat jumped into the yard, the frightened birds flew off ____, some to the trees and others over the roof.
phrases.ex: some to the trees, others over the roof 說明鳥「四散」飛走。
dist: in the same boat：處境相同
in due time：時候到了、終將

phrases.stem: Exercising every day may seem hard at first, but ____ it will make you healthier and save you money on doctors.
phrases.zh: in the long run：長遠來看、最終
phrases.ex: at first 與 but 對比，指「長期下來」會有好處。

phrases.stem: Don't feel bad about failing the math test; most of us are ____, since nobody understood the last chapter.
phrases.zh: in the same boat：處境相同、同病相憐
phrases.ex: 大家都沒懂最後一章，所以「處境一樣」。

phrases.stem: When the factory suddenly closed, all the workers were ____: they had lost their jobs and had no idea how to pay their bills.
phrases.zh: in the same boat：處境相同（與「船」無關）
phrases.ex: 冒號後說明每個人都失業、付不出帳單，大家「處境相同」。
dist: in due time：時候到了、終將

phrases.stem: The road trip was long and dangerous, but we all got home ____, without even a scratch on the car.
phrases.zh: in one piece：平安無事、完好無損
phrases.ex: without even a scratch 表示「毫髮無傷」，不是「一片」。
dist: in the same boat：處境相同

phrases.stem: Be patient and keep practicing. Your hard work will be rewarded ____, because real success rarely comes overnight.
phrases.zh: in due time：在適當的時候、終將
phrases.ex: success rarely comes overnight 表示不會很快，但「時候到了」就會有回報。
dist: in no time：很快、立刻（與 rarely comes overnight 矛盾）
in vain：徒勞（與 rewarded 矛盾）

phrases.stem: The new train is so fast that we will be in Kaohsiung ____; the whole trip takes only about an hour and a half.
phrases.ex: so fast、only an hour and a half 表示「很快」就到。
dist: in due time：時候到了、終將（沒有「快」的意思）

phrases.stem: The teacher asked the students to stand up ____ and say their names, starting with the boy in the front row.
phrases.ex: starting with the boy in the front row 表示「依序」說出名字。

phrases.stem: Most of the students voted ____ a longer lunch break, so the school agreed to give them ten extra minutes.
phrases.ex: 學校因此多給十分鐘，表示學生投票「贊成」。

phrases.stem: ____ price, the two phones are almost the same, but the second one has a much better camera.
phrases.zh: in terms of：就……而言、在……方面
phrases.ex: 「就價格而言」兩支差不多，但相機有差。

phrases.stem: ____ the heavy rain, thousands of fans waited outside the stadium for hours to see their favorite singer.
phrases.ex: 下大雨卻仍等好幾小時，是讓步關係「儘管」。

phrases.stem: Since the coach was sick, his assistant led the team ____ him during the final game of the season.
phrases.ex: 教練生病，由助理「代替」他帶隊。
dist: in charge of：負責（後面不會接 him 表代替）

phrases.stem: The hotel was dirty, the food was cold, and the staff were rude. ____, it was the worst trip of my life.
phrases.ex: 前面列舉多項缺點，最後「總之」做結論。

phrases.stem: My brother said he was "a little short of money" this month. ____, he wanted to borrow some from me.
phrases.ex: 把「手頭有點緊」換個說法，就是想跟我借錢。
dist: in the long run：長遠來看

phrases.stem: The workers were kept ____ about the company's plans, so they were shocked when the factory suddenly closed.
phrases.zh: in the dark：被蒙在鼓裡、不知情
phrases.ex: 工廠突然關閉讓他們震驚，表示事先「不知情」，與黑暗無關。
dist: in the same boat：處境相同

phrases.stem: Our team has won five games ____, and everyone hopes we can keep winning until the end of the season.
phrases.ex: keep winning 表示是「連續」贏五場。

phrases.stem: If you want a good seat at the concert, you had better buy your ticket ____, because tickets usually sell out a week before.
phrases.ex: 門票常提前一週賣完，所以要「事先」買。

phrases.stem: I would rather talk to you ____ than over the phone, so let's meet for coffee tomorrow afternoon.
phrases.ex: than over the phone、meet for coffee 表示想「當面」談。

phrases.stem: My grandfather jogs every morning to stay ____, and even at his age he can still run faster than many young people.
phrases.zh: in shape：身材健康、體能良好
phrases.ex: 每天慢跑、年紀大仍跑得比年輕人快，表示保持「健康狀態」。

phrases.stem: "May I borrow your dictionary for a minute?" "____! Take as long as you need."
phrases.ex: Take as long as you need 表示很樂意，所以是「當然可以」。
dist: by no means：絕不（與後句意思相反）

phrases.stem: Learning a new language is ____ easy; it usually takes years of hard work and daily practice.
phrases.zh: by no means：絕不、一點也不
phrases.ex: 要花好幾年努力，表示「一點也不」容易。
dist: by all means：當然可以（與文意相反）

phrases.stem: I didn't mean to read your diary; I found it ____ while I was looking for my keys under the bed.
phrases.ex: didn't mean to、在找鑰匙時發現，表示是「意外」找到。

phrases.stem: The actor had learned all his lines ____, so he didn't need to look at the script even once during the show.
phrases.ex: 完全不用看劇本，表示台詞都「背熟了」。

phrases.stem: This is ____ the best movie I've seen this year; none of the others even comes close to it.
phrases.zh: by far：顯然、遠遠地（修飾最高級）
phrases.ex: 其他片完全比不上，表示「遠遠」是最好的。

phrases.stem: The concert last night was a lot of fun. ____, did you remember to return the book you borrowed from the library?
phrases.ex: 話題從演唱會轉到還書，用「順便一提」轉換話題。

phrases.stem: This map is ____; it doesn't show any of the new roads that have been built in the past ten years.
phrases.ex: 沒有近十年的新路，表示地圖「過時了」。

phrases.stem: The elevator is ____ again, so we will have to walk up the stairs to the top floor.
phrases.ex: 只能走樓梯，表示電梯「故障」。

phrases.stem: Always keep medicine ____ of small children, for example in a locked box on a high shelf.
phrases.ex: 放在高架上鎖的盒子，讓小孩「拿不到」。

phrases.stem: Our camping trip this weekend is ____ because a strong typhoon is expected to hit the island on Saturday.
phrases.zh: out of the question：不可能、不予考慮
phrases.ex: 颱風要來，露營「不可能」成行。

phrases.stem: After running up six floors of stairs, the old man was so ____ that he had to sit down and rest for a while.
phrases.zh: out of breath：上氣不接下氣
phrases.ex: 爬六層樓後需坐下休息，表示「喘不過氣」。

phrases.stem: The fire spread quickly through the dry forest and was soon ____; help had to be called in from three nearby cities.
phrases.ex: 火勢迅速蔓延、需三個城市支援，表示「失控」。
dist: under control：在控制之下（方向相反）

phrases.stem: As soon as the train was ____, she stopped waving goodbye and slowly walked back to her car.
phrases.ex: 火車「看不見」了，她才停止揮手。

phrases.stem: Since the factory closed last year, many people in the town have been ____ and are looking for new jobs.
phrases.ex: 工廠關閉、在找新工作，表示「失業」。

phrases.stem: Work on the new library is already ____; the builders started digging last month and plan to finish next year.
phrases.ex: 上個月已開工，表示工程「正在進行」。

phrases.stem: The fire burned for two whole days before the workers were finally able to bring it ____.
phrases.ex: 燒了兩天才終於「控制住」火勢。

phrases.stem: Many students feel ____ to get high scores, because their parents expect them to enter top universities.
phrases.ex: 父母期望高，學生「感到壓力」。

phrases.stem: I am feeling a bit ____ today; I have a headache and a sore throat, so I think I'll stay home from school.
phrases.ex: 頭痛、喉嚨痛，表示「身體不適」，與天氣無關。
dist: under pressure：承受壓力（不是生病症狀）

phrases.stem: The police officer told the driver that he was ____ for driving after drinking and put him in the police car.
phrases.ex: 酒駕被帶上警車，表示「被逮捕」。

phrases.stem: Our new office will not be ready until March, so ____ we will be working in a small room on the second floor.
phrases.zh: for the time being：暫時、目前
phrases.ex: 新辦公室三月才好，在那之前「暫時」用小房間。

phrases.stem: After living abroad for twenty years, my uncle has decided to return to Taiwan ____; he never wants to leave again.
phrases.ex: never wants to leave again 表示「永遠」回來，不是「為了好」。
dist: for the time being：暫時（與文意相反）

phrases.stem: A good doctor needs both knowledge and skill, but ____, he or she must truly care about the patients.
phrases.ex: 列出知識技能後用 but 帶出「最重要」的一點。

phrases.stem: Parents hope their children will do well in school, but ____, they want them to grow up healthy and happy.
phrases.zh: above all else：最重要的是、比什麼都重要
phrases.ex: 成績之外，父母「最」希望孩子健康快樂。
dist: for the time being：暫時（不是「最重要」）

phrases.stem: ____, the small team from a poor mountain village beat the national champions and won the cup.
phrases.zh: against all odds：儘管困難重重、出乎意料地
phrases.ex: 窮村小隊擊敗全國冠軍，是「克服萬難」的結果。

phrases.stem: The view from the top of the mountain was beautiful ____; not even the best photos could show how amazing it was.
phrases.ex: 連照片都無法呈現，表示美得「難以言喻」。
dist: off the record：私下說、不公開

phrases.stem: The bridge project is three months ____ because heavy rains kept the workers away from the river for weeks.
phrases.ex: 大雨讓工人無法施工，所以「落後」三個月。
dist: ahead of schedule：進度超前（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The official told the reporter, "This is ____, so please don't print my name or my words in the newspaper."
phrases.zh: off the record：私下說、不可公開
phrases.ex: 不要刊登名字或話語，表示這是「不公開」的談話。

phrases.stem: The two old friends walked ____ along the beach, talking and laughing just as they did when they were young.
phrases.ex: 邊走邊聊笑，表示「並肩」而行。
dist: far apart：相隔遙遠（方向相反）

phrases.stem: Although the two brothers live ____, one in Taipei and the other in London, they still talk on the phone every week.
phrases.ex: 一個在台北一個在倫敦，表示「相隔遙遠」。
dist: side by side：並肩（方向相反）
close together：住得很近（方向相反）

phrases.stem: Make sure the ladder is ____ before you climb up, or it might move and you could fall and get hurt.
phrases.zh: firmly in place：牢牢固定在位置上
phrases.ex: 否則梯子會移動，所以要確認它「固定好」。

phrases.stem: During the typhoon, rescue workers worked ____, taking turns to sleep for only a few hours at a time.
phrases.zh: around the clock：日以繼夜、全天候
phrases.ex: 輪流只睡幾小時，表示「24 小時不停」工作，與時鐘無關。

phrases.stem: I agree with you ____, but I still think there are a few serious problems with your plan.
phrases.zh: to some extent：在某種程度上
phrases.ex: but 後仍有保留，表示只是「部分」同意。

phrases.stem: "You must be new here." "____, I've worked in this office for three years; we just haven't met before."
phrases.zh: as a matter of fact：事實上
phrases.ex: 糾正對方的誤會，用「事實上」帶出真實情況。

phrases.stem: We were enjoying a picnic in the park when ____ it started to rain heavily, and we all ran to find shelter.
phrases.ex: 野餐時「突然」下起大雨。
dist: to some extent：在某種程度上

phrases.stem: Smart shoppers ____ the holiday sales to buy expensive items such as TVs and computers at half price.
phrases.ex: to buy ... at half price 說明顧客「利用」特價買便宜貨。
dist: take part in：參加（活動）；特價不是活動
take charge of：負責管理；顧客不管理特價

phrases.stem: More than two hundred students ____ the beach-cleaning event last weekend, collecting over fifty bags of trash.
phrases.ex: collecting over fifty bags of trash 表示學生實際「參加」淨灘。
dist: take place：發生、舉行；主詞須是活動，不是人
take notice of：注意到；只注意不會撿垃圾

phrases.stem: The annual music festival will ____ in the city park, so the nearby roads will be closed that weekend.
phrases.ex: 音樂節在公園「舉行」，所以附近道路封閉。
dist: take part：參加；須接 in，且主詞應是人
take shape：成形；與在公園、封路無關

phrases.stem: The instructions were written in such poor English that nobody could ____ them, so we had to call the store for help.
phrases.ex: 英文太差、只好打電話求助，表示沒人「看得懂」說明書。

phrases.stem: Even small actions, like bringing your own bag when shopping, can ____ in reducing plastic waste.
phrases.zh: make a difference：產生影響、有幫助
phrases.ex: in reducing plastic waste 表示小行動對減塑「有影響」。
dist: make a mess：弄得一團亂；與減塑方向相反

phrases.stem: We only have three days in Tokyo, so let's ____ our time and visit as many places as possible.
phrases.zh: make the most of：充分利用
phrases.ex: 只有三天、想多去幾個地方，所以要「善用」時間。
dist: make light of：輕視、不當一回事；與想多玩方向相反

phrases.stem: If you ____ the warning signs along the mountain trail, you will not get lost or hurt during the hike.
phrases.ex: 注意警示牌才不會迷路受傷。
dist: pay a visit to：拜訪；不能拜訪告示牌
pay the price for：為……付出代價

phrases.stem: My father uses his phone to ____ how much money he spends each month, so he never spends more than he plans to.
phrases.zh: keep track of：記錄、掌握……的動態
phrases.ex: 用 app 記帳、never spends more 表示他「掌握」花費。
dist: lose track of：失去……的掌握；與從不超支方向相反
keep in touch with：與……保持聯絡

phrases.stem: I was so busy reading the exciting novel that I completely ____ time and missed the last bus home.
phrases.zh: lose track of time：忘了時間
phrases.ex: 讀得太入迷、錯過末班車，表示「忘了時間」。
dist: keep track of：掌握；若掌握時間就不會錯過車

phrases.stem: Could you ____ my bag for a minute while I go to the restroom? I don't want anyone to take it.
phrases.zh: keep an eye on：照看、留意
phrases.ex: 怕包包被拿走，請人「幫忙看著」。
dist: keep in mind：記住；須說 keep sth in mind
keep up with：跟上；趕上進度

phrases.stem: Sleep ____ memory, so students who stay up all night before exams often forget what they have studied.
phrases.zh: play a role in：在……中扮演角色、有作用
phrases.ex: 熬夜就會忘記，說明睡眠對記憶「有重要作用」。
dist: get rid of：擺脫、除掉；若睡眠除掉記憶，結論應相反

phrases.stem: The company was ____ hiding the fact that its products contained harmful chemicals, and it now faces strong anger from customers.
phrases.ex: 隱瞞有害化學物質、顧客憤怒，表示公司「被指控」。
dist: be proud of：以……為傲；不合顧客憤怒

phrases.stem: Many people are not ____ the dangers of using their phones while crossing the street, so such accidents keep happening.
phrases.ex: 不「知道」危險，所以意外一直發生。

phrases.stem: This new robot is ____ lifting objects that weigh up to 500 kilograms, so factories no longer need many workers to move heavy boxes.
phrases.ex: 機器人「能夠」舉起500公斤，工廠因此不需人力。
dist: be afraid of：害怕；不合後半句

phrases.stem: As the team leader, Amy is ____ making sure that everyone finishes their part of the project on time.
phrases.ex: 身為組長，她「負責」確保大家準時完成。
dist: be eager for：渴望（接名詞，不接此動名詞）

phrases.stem: The city of Tainan is ____ its traditional snacks, and many tourists travel there just to try the local food.
phrases.ex: 小吃是台南的「特色」，用 for；as 後接身分。
dist: be famous as：以……身分聞名；台南不是小吃
be made from：由……製成（原料變質）

phrases.stem: Before she became a writer, Linda was ____ a singer, and many of her songs are still popular today.
phrases.zh: be famous as＋身分：以……身分聞名
phrases.ex: a singer 是她的「身分」，所以用 as。
dist: be famous for：後接特色、作品，不接身分

phrases.stem: Wine is ____ grapes; the fruit goes through a long process before it finally becomes a drink.
phrases.zh: be made from：由……製成（原料已看不出原貌）
phrases.ex: 葡萄經過長時間處理才變成酒，原料變質用 from。
dist: be made into：被製成（後接成品）；方向相反

phrases.stem: Heavy rain for three days ____ serious floods in the southern part of the island, and many families lost their homes.
phrases.ex: 大雨是因，水災是果，用 result in。
dist: result from：起因於（果←因）；方向相反

phrases.stem: Doctors say that many of his health problems ____ years of smoking and drinking too much.
phrases.ex: 健康問題是果，多年抽菸喝酒是因，用 result from。

phrases.stem: The school committee ____ five teachers and three students, who meet every Monday to discuss school rules.
phrases.ex: 委員會「由」五位老師和三位學生「組成」。

phrases.stem: Whether we will have the picnic tomorrow will ____ the weather; if it rains, we will stay home and watch movies.
phrases.ex: 下雨就不去，表示野餐「取決於」天氣。
dist: insist on：堅持；天氣不會堅持

phrases.stem: The new manager knows how to ____ angry customers patiently and politely, so complaints have dropped a lot.
phrases.ex: 冷靜有禮地「應付」生氣顧客，抱怨因此減少。

phrases.stem: Smoke from the factories ____ the rise in lung disease in this area, so the government plans to close some of them.
phrases.zh: contribute to：促成、是……的原因之一
phrases.ex: 工廠煙霧「造成」肺病增加，所以政府要關廠。

phrases.stem: Staying up late every night can ____ poor grades and health problems, so try to go to bed before eleven.
phrases.ex: 熬夜是因，成績差、健康問題是果，用 lead to。

phrases.stem: The new rule ____ all students, including those who live in the school dormitory, so everyone must follow it.
phrases.ex: 規定「適用於」所有學生，所以每個人都要遵守。
dist: apply for：申請（工作、獎學金等）

phrases.stem: Although it was raining heavily, my grandfather ____ walking to the market alone instead of taking a taxi.
phrases.ex: 雖然下大雨卻仍要走路，表示他「堅持」。

phrases.stem: Many residents ____ the plan to build a factory near the school, worrying that the air would become dirty.
phrases.ex: 擔心空氣變髒，所以居民「反對」建廠。
dist: insist on：堅持；與擔心方向相反
look forward to：期待；方向相反

phrases.stem: I am really ____ seeing my cousins again during the summer vacation; we haven't met for almost three years.
phrases.ex: 三年沒見面，所以「期待」再見到表親。

phrases.stem: Having grown up in a quiet village, she is still not ____ living in a busy and noisy city like Taipei.
phrases.ex: 在安靜鄉村長大，還不「習慣」吵鬧城市；後接 V-ing。
dist: be made to V：被迫……（接原形）
be about to V：即將……（接原形）
be supposed to V：應該……（接原形）

phrases.stem: It took me about two weeks to ____ the time difference after I moved to London; at first I couldn't sleep at night.
phrases.ex: 花兩週、起初睡不著，表示慢慢「習慣」時差。
dist: get rid of：擺脫；時差不是能丟掉的東西

phrases.stem: After he retired, the old doctor ____ his life to helping poor children learn to read, spending every afternoon at the library.
phrases.zh: devote oneself / one's life to V-ing：致力於……
phrases.ex: 每天下午都在圖書館教孩子，表示他把餘生「奉獻」於此。
dist: accuse sb of：指控（介系詞是 of，且受詞須是人）

phrases.stem: The new law against drunk driving will ____ next month, and drivers who break it will have to pay a heavy fine.
phrases.ex: 新法下個月起，違者會被罰，表示法律「生效」。
dist: come to an end：結束；新法才剛要實施

phrases.stem: Instead of admitting his own mistake, the manager chose to ____ his assistant, which made everyone in the office angry.
phrases.zh: shift the blame onto：把責任推給
phrases.ex: 不承認錯誤、大家生氣，表示他「把責任推給」助理。

phrases.stem: The two parties agreed to ____ their differences and work together to help the people who lost their homes in the flood.
phrases.ex: 為了合作救災，兩黨同意「擱置」歧見。

phrases.stem: New evidence ____ the young man of the crime, and he was finally set free after two years in prison.
phrases.zh: clear sb of：洗清某人（罪名）
phrases.ex: 新證據使他獲釋，表示「洗清」罪名。
dist: accuse sb of：指控；與獲釋方向相反

phrases.stem: Two men ____ the old woman of her purse while she was waiting for the bus, and then ran away.
phrases.zh: rob sb of sth：搶走某人的某物
phrases.ex: rob 的受詞是「人」，再接 of＋物品。
dist: steal 的受詞是「物」：stole her purse，不能 steal sb of

phrases.stem: This song always ____ me of my childhood, when my mother used to sing it to me every night before I fell asleep.
phrases.ex: 歌「讓我想起」童年；remember 不接 sb of。
dist: remember：記得；主詞須是人，不能 remember me of

phrases.stem: The heavy snow ____ us from driving up the mountain, so we had to spend the night at a hotel at the foot of it.
phrases.zh: prevent sb from V-ing：阻止某人……
phrases.ex: 只好住旅館，表示大雪「阻止」我們上山；且搭 from。
dist: protect sb from：保護某人免於…；雪不是在保護我們
excuse sb from：免除某人（義務）

phrases.stem: Don't ____ your little brother for the broken glass; I saw the cat knock it off the table.
phrases.zh: blame A for B：把 B 怪罪於 A
phrases.ex: 是貓打破的，所以「別怪」弟弟。
dist: forgive A for B：原諒；弟弟沒做錯，談不上原諒

phrases.stem: After failing the exam, she ____ the fact that her friends and family still believed in her.
phrases.ex: 考試失敗後，親友的信任讓她「得到安慰」。

phrases.stem: The bills he could not pay ____ his mind for weeks, and he could hardly sleep at night.
phrases.zh: weigh on one's mind：使人心情沉重、掛心
phrases.ex: 幾週都睡不著，表示帳單「壓在心上」。
dist: slip one's mind：忘記；與睡不著方向相反
cross one's mind：一時閃過腦中；不會持續數週
make up one's mind：下定決心

phrases.stem: It took the city nearly a year to bring the spread of the disease under ____, and by then thousands of people had become sick.
phrases.ex: 花十小時才把火勢「控制住」。

phrases.stem: Since Kevin had practiced every day, the piano test was ____ for him; he played every piece without a single mistake.
phrases.zh: a piece of cake：小事一樁、很容易
phrases.ex: 天天練習、零失誤，表示考試很「容易」。
dist: the last straw：壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草
a recipe for disaster：必定招致災難的做法
the tip of the iceberg：冰山一角

phrases.stem: At the start of the party, nobody knew each other, so the host told a funny story to ____.
phrases.zh: break the ice：打破僵局、化解尷尬
phrases.ex: 大家互不認識，主人講笑話來「打破冷場」。
dist: call it a day：今天到此為止
sit on the fence：保持中立、不表態

phrases.stem: Fixing my old car would ____, so I decided to spend the money on a new one instead.
options: cost an arm and a leg
hit the nail on the head
phrases.zh: cost an arm and a leg：非常昂貴
phrases.ex: 修車太「貴」，乾脆買新車。
dist: work like a charm：非常有效
hit the nail on the head：一針見血

phrases.stem: When Tom said our team lost because nobody listened to the coach, he really ____; that was exactly the problem.
options: hit the nail on the head
phrases.zh: hit the nail on the head：一針見血、說中要點
phrases.ex: that was exactly the problem 表示他「說中了」。
dist: miss the mark：沒說中；方向相反
beat around the bush：拐彎抹角

phrases.stem: The ten cases reported so far are only ____; the police believe thousands of people have been cheated in the same way.
phrases.zh: the tip of the iceberg：冰山一角
phrases.ex: 已知十件，實際可能上千件，表示只是「冰山一角」。
dist: the last straw：最後一根稻草
a blessing in disguise：塞翁失馬

phrases.stem: Losing that job turned out to be ____, because it pushed him to start his own business, which is now very successful.
phrases.zh: a blessing in disguise：因禍得福、塞翁失馬
phrases.ex: 失業反而讓他創業成功，是「因禍得福」。
dist: a recipe for disaster：會招致災難的事；方向相反
the tip of the iceberg：冰山一角

phrases.stem: My uncle lives abroad, so we only see him ____, usually when someone in the family gets married.
phrases.zh: once in a blue moon：極少、難得一次
phrases.ex: 住國外、只在婚禮見面，表示「很少」見到。
dist: out of the blue：突然、出乎意料；同有 blue 但意思不同

phrases.stem: The teacher warned the students many times about cheating, but her words ____, and three of them were caught during the exam.
options: hit the nail on the head
phrases.zh: fall on deaf ears：被當耳邊風
phrases.ex: 警告多次仍有人作弊，表示話被「當耳邊風」。
dist: work like a charm：非常有效；方向相反
hit the nail on the head：一針見血
go according to plan：按計畫進行

phrases.stem: I was worried the old medicine wouldn't help, but it ____; my headache was gone in ten minutes.
phrases.zh: work like a charm：非常有效
phrases.ex: 十分鐘頭痛就好，表示藥「很有效」。
dist: fall on deaf ears：被當耳邊風
have the opposite effect：適得其反；方向相反

phrases.stem: Shouting at a crying child often ____; instead of becoming quiet, the child usually gets even louder.
options: hits the nail on the head
phrases.zh: have the opposite effect：產生反效果、適得其反
phrases.ex: instead of becoming quiet ... gets even louder 表示「反效果」。
dist: work like a charm：非常有效；方向相反
go according to plan：按計畫進行
hit the nail on the head：一針見血

phrases.stem: Everything ____ at first, but then our bus broke down and we arrived at the concert two hours late.
options: cost an arm and a leg
phrases.zh: go according to plan：按計畫進行
phrases.ex: but then 轉折，表示一開始「一切順利」。
dist: fall on deaf ears：被當耳邊風
cost an arm and a leg：非常昂貴
miss the mark：沒達到目標；與 but 的轉折不合

phrases.stem: No one wanted to speak first at the meeting, so the manager shared her own idea to ____.
phrases.zh: get the ball rolling：起個頭、開始進行
phrases.ex: 沒人先發言，經理先分享來「起個頭」。
dist: drop the ball：犯錯、搞砸；同有 ball 但意思不同

phrases.stem: Although the two sisters love each other, they rarely ____ on anything; they argue about everything from food to movies.
phrases.zh: see eye to eye：意見一致
phrases.ex: 什麼都吵，表示她們很少「意見一致」。
dist: turn a blind eye：睜一隻眼閉一隻眼；同有 eye 但意思不同
make ends meet：勉強維持生計

phrases.stem: After I forgot to meet her for dinner, Lisa gave me ____ for a whole week; she wouldn't even say hello to me.
phrases.zh: give sb the cold shoulder：冷落某人
phrases.ex: 連招呼都不打，表示她「冷落」我。
dist: give sb the green light：准許
give sb a ride：載某人一程

phrases.stem: The results of the job interview will come out tomorrow, so I'm ____ that I will get the position.
phrases.zh: keep one's fingers crossed：祈求好運
phrases.ex: 明天公布結果，我「祈禱」能錄取。
dist: pull one's weight：盡自己的本分

phrases.stem: The film critic ____ in her review, calling the movie the most boring one she had seen in years.
phrases.zh: pull no punches：直言不諱、毫不留情
phrases.ex: 直接說是多年來最無聊的電影，表示「毫不留情」。
dist: beat around the bush：拐彎抹角；方向相反
sit on the fence：不表態；方向相反
keep one's fingers crossed：祈求好運

phrases.stem: Stop ____ and tell me directly: did you break my computer or not?
options: hitting the nail on the head
phrases.zh: beat around the bush：拐彎抹角
phrases.ex: tell me directly 表示對方一直在「拐彎抹角」。
dist: hit the nail on the head：一針見血
pull no punches：直言不諱；方向相反

phrases.stem: When his parents argued about where to go on vacation, Tom ____ and refused to support either side.
phrases.zh: sit on the fence：保持中立、不表態
phrases.ex: refused to support either side 表示他「不表態」。
dist: make ends meet：勉強維持生計

phrases.stem: As the only person wearing jeans at the formal dinner, Mark felt ____ and wanted to go home early.
phrases.zh: feel out of place：覺得格格不入
phrases.ex: 只有他穿牛仔褲、想早點走，表示「格格不入」。
dist: on top of the world：非常開心
feel at home：覺得自在；方向相反（勿被 go home 字面誤導）
in the same boat：處境相同

phrases.stem: The company's new ad ____; instead of attracting young people, it confused them, and sales dropped.
options: hit the nail on the head
phrases.zh: miss the mark：沒達到目標、失準
phrases.ex: 沒吸引年輕人、銷量下滑，表示廣告「失準」。
dist: work like a charm：非常有效；方向相反
go according to plan：按計畫進行
hit the nail on the head：一針見血

phrases.stem: Driving fast on wet mountain roads at night is ____; you should slow down or wait until morning.
phrases.zh: a recipe for disaster：必定招致災難的做法
phrases.ex: 雨夜山路開快車很危險，所以要減速。
dist: a blessing in disguise：因禍得福
the tip of the iceberg：冰山一角

phrases.stem: He had been late many times, but sleeping through the most important meeting of the year was ____, and his boss fired him.
phrases.zh: the last straw：最後一根稻草、忍無可忍
phrases.ex: 多次遲到後又睡過頭，老闆「忍無可忍」開除他。
dist: the tip of the iceberg：冰山一角
a blessing in disguise：因禍得福

phrases.stem: We have been working on this report for ten hours. Let's ____ and finish the rest tomorrow.
phrases.zh: call it a day：今天到此為止、收工
phrases.ex: 做了十小時、其餘明天做，表示「收工」。
dist: make ends meet：勉強維持生計
get the ball rolling：開始進行；方向相反

phrases.stem: If his mother finds out that Jack skipped school to play video games, he will be ____.
phrases.ex: 逃學被媽媽發現就會「有麻煩」。
dist: on top of the world：非常開心

phrases.stem: We planned a surprise party for Dad, but my little brother ____ by asking him what kind of cake he wanted.
options: let the cat out of the bag
phrases.zh: let the cat out of the bag：洩漏祕密
phrases.ex: 問爸爸要什麼蛋糕，等於「洩漏」驚喜派對。
dist: rain cats and dogs：下傾盆大雨；同有 cat 但意思不同

phrases.stem: After losing his job, he had to work two part-time jobs just to ____ and pay the rent.
phrases.zh: make ends meet：勉強維持生計
phrases.ex: 兼兩份工才付得出房租，表示「勉強餬口」。
dist: make a scene：當眾大吵大鬧

phrases.stem: Don't tell Mary about the surprise; she can never keep a secret and will ____ to everyone in class.
phrases.ex: 她守不住祕密，會「說溜嘴」。

phrases.stem: The news on that website is often wrong, so you should take what it says with ____.
phrases.zh: take sth with a grain of salt：對……半信半疑
phrases.ex: 網站常出錯，所以要「保留地看待」。
dist: with open arms：熱烈歡迎；方向相反
with flying colors：（考試）高分通過
with a heavy heart：心情沉重地

phrases.stem: I have made you my best offer. Now ____: you can accept it or look for another buyer.
options: the ball is in your court
the shoe is on the other foot
phrases.zh: the ball is in your court：輪到你做決定了
phrases.ex: 我已出價，接不接受由你「決定」。
dist: the coast is clear：沒有危險、四下無人
the sky is the limit：沒有極限
the shoe is on the other foot：情勢逆轉、立場互換

phrases.stem: The test is already over, so there's no use ____; just study harder for the next one.
phrases.zh: cry over spilled milk：為無法挽回的事懊悔
phrases.ex: 考試已結束，後悔「沒有用」，下次努力就好。
dist: spill the beans：洩漏祕密；同有 spill 但意思不同

phrases.stem: Everyone on the team lost money when the company closed, so we were all ____ and decided to help one another find new jobs.
phrases.zh: in the same boat：處境相同
phrases.ex: 大家都考不好、要一起讀書，表示「同病相憐」。
dist: on top of the world：非常開心；不合考差

phrases.stem: It took the new nurse a few months to ____, but now she handles every task in the hospital without help.
phrases.zh: learn the ropes：學會訣竅、熟悉工作
phrases.ex: 幾個月後能獨立處理，表示她「上手」了。

phrases.stem: The builders ____ to save money, and the bridge started cracking only a year after it was finished.
phrases.ex: 為省錢、橋一年就裂，表示「偷工減料」。
dist: turn the corner：度過難關、好轉；同有 corner 但意思不同

phrases.stem: The money we have raised is just ____ compared with what is needed to rebuild the town after the earthquake.
phrases.zh: a drop in the ocean：滄海一粟、杯水車薪
phrases.ex: compared with what is needed 表示募款「微不足道」。
dist: the last straw：最後一根稻草
a blessing in disguise：因禍得福

phrases.stem: Instead of simply listening to the students' complaints, the principal decided to ____ their suggestions and changed the lunch menu.
phrases.zh: act on：根據（建議）採取行動
phrases.ex: Instead of simply listening 與 changed the lunch menu 說明校長不只是聽，而是「照建議行動」。

phrases.stem: In English class, each group had to ____ a scene from the play in front of their classmates, using simple costumes.
phrases.ex: in front of their classmates 與 costumes 說明是「演出」劇中一幕。

phrases.stem: The numbers in the report didn't ____, so the manager asked the staff to check every figure again.
phrases.zh: add up：合乎邏輯；（數字）加起來對得上
phrases.ex: so ... check every figure again 表示數字「對不起來」，要重新核對。

phrases.stem: I don't know any good dentists in this city, but I'll ____ at the office and see if anyone can recommend one.
phrases.ex: see if anyone can recommend one 表示要向同事「四處打聽」。

phrases.stem: When Tom broke her new phone, his sister ____ at him and refused to speak to him for days.
phrases.ex: refused to speak to him for days 說明姊姊對他「大發雷霆」。

phrases.stem: After everyone sang "Happy Birthday," the little girl made a wish and ____ the candles on her cake.
phrases.ex: 生日許願後「吹熄」蠟燭。

phrases.stem: In the end, the whole problem ____ one simple question: does the town have enough money to build the new library?
phrases.ex: 冒號後是「一個簡單的問題」，表示整件事「歸結為」這一點。

phrases.stem: While the family was away on vacation, someone ____ and stole their TV and all of their jewelry.
phrases.ex: stole their TV and jewelry 說明小偷「闖入」家中。
dist: break out：（戰爭、火災）爆發；逃出

phrases.stem: Before her trip to Japan, Amy took a short course to ____ her Japanese, which she hadn't used since college.
phrases.zh: brush up on：複習、重溫（生疏的技能）
phrases.ex: hadn't used since college 表示日文生疏了，所以要「溫習」。

phrases.stem: Working twelve hours a day without a break, many young doctors ____ within a few years and leave the job.
phrases.ex: 每天工作十二小時、最後離職，表示「過勞倦怠」。

phrases.stem: When we arrived at the hotel, we had to wait almost an hour to ____ because the computer system was down.
phrases.ex: arrived at the hotel 表示剛抵達，要辦「入住」，不是退房。

phrases.stem: The nurse came in every two hours to ____ the old man and make sure he was breathing normally.
phrases.ex: make sure he was breathing normally 說明護士定時「察看」病人。

phrases.stem: After losing the game, Ben was so sad that his friends bought him ice cream to ____.
phrases.zh: cheer up：使振作、使高興起來
phrases.ex: so sad 加上朋友請吃冰淇淋，目的是「讓他開心」。

phrases.stem: After the party, everyone stayed to ____ the living room, picking up cups and washing the dishes.
phrases.ex: picking up cups and washing the dishes 是在「收拾打掃」。

phrases.stem: The sky was dark all morning, but the weather ____ in the afternoon, so we went to the beach after all.
phrases.ex: but 表示轉折，下午天氣「轉晴」所以去了海邊。

phrases.stem: Because fewer and fewer customers came, the small bookstore had to ____ after thirty years in business.
phrases.zh: close down：（商店、工廠）歇業、關閉
phrases.ex: 客人越來越少，書店只好「歇業」。

phrases.stem: He may ____ unfriendly when you first meet him, but he is actually very shy and kind.
phrases.ex: when you first meet him 與 but he is actually... 對比「第一印象」與真實個性。

phrases.stem: Let the soup ____ for a few minutes before you give it to the baby; it's still too hot.
phrases.ex: it's still too hot 說明湯要「放涼」。
dist: settle down：安定下來；（情緒）平靜，不用於湯

phrases.stem: If you make a mistake on the form, just ____ the wrong word with a single line and write the correct one above it.
phrases.ex: with a single line 再在上方寫正確的字，是「劃掉」錯字。

phrases.stem: Many traditional crafts may ____ in the near future because young people are not interested in learning them.
phrases.zh: die out：（物種、習俗）消失、絕跡
phrases.ex: 年輕人不想學，傳統手藝漸漸「失傳」。

phrases.stem: We will wait inside the cave until the storm ____, and then we will continue walking down the mountain.
phrases.zh: die down：（風雨、聲音）逐漸平息
phrases.ex: 等到暴風雨「減弱」才繼續下山。
dist: turn down：拒絕；調小聲（需受詞）
break out：爆發，與「等它結束」相反

phrases.stem: The village has no supermarket, so people there have learned to ____ many things that city people think they need.
phrases.ex: 沒有超市，村民學會「不靠」那些東西過日子。
dist: do away with：廢除（制度、規定）

phrases.stem: Many schools have now decided to ____ school uniforms, letting students wear whatever they like.
phrases.ex: letting students wear whatever they like 表示「廢除」制服。
dist: put up with：忍受，與讓學生自由穿相反

phrases.stem: Everyone ____ as a famous movie character for the Halloween party, and Lisa came as Snow White.
phrases.ex: came as Snow White 說明大家「扮裝」成電影角色。

phrases.stem: We took the wrong exit on the highway and ____ in a small town fifty kilometers away from our hotel.
phrases.ex: 走錯出口，「結果」跑到五十公里外的小鎮。

phrases.stem: Sooner or later, you will have to ____ the fact that your plan failed and start thinking of a new one.
phrases.zh: face up to：勇敢面對（困難、事實）
phrases.ex: the fact that your plan failed 是不愉快的事實，需要「面對」。

phrases.stem: Nobody knew who had left the gift on the teacher's desk until we ____ it was the quiet new student.
phrases.ex: Nobody knew ... until 表示後來才「查明」是誰。

phrases.stem: In today's job market, you need more than a degree to ____; skills and experience matter just as much.
phrases.ex: 談就業市場、技能與經驗，指要「出頭」成功。

phrases.stem: After his brother read his diary without asking, Sam wanted to ____ him by hiding his favorite video game.
phrases.ex: 哥哥偷看日記，Sam 藏他的遊戲是要「報復」。

phrases.stem: Having ____ on a farm, Mia knows how to take care of chickens, cows, and pigs.
phrases.ex: 在農場「長大」，所以會照顧家禽家畜。

phrases.stem: My son used to be afraid of the dark, but he ____ it by the time he was eight.
phrases.zh: grow out of：長大後擺脫（習慣、恐懼）
phrases.ex: used to be afraid ... but 表示長大後「不再」怕黑。

phrases.stem: On weekends, the teenagers like to ____ at the mall with their friends, just chatting and window shopping.
phrases.zh: hang out：閒晃、和朋友混在一起
phrases.ex: just chatting and window shopping 是「閒逛」。

phrases.stem: The climber's fingers were tired and cold, but he ____ until the rescue team finally reached him.
phrases.zh: hang on：緊抓不放；堅持下去
phrases.ex: but 轉折：手指很累卻「撐住」直到救援到達。
dist: give out：（體力）耗盡，與 but 不合

phrases.stem: When the heavy rain started, the tired hikers turned around and ____ the nearest shelter on the trail.
phrases.ex: turned around 後「朝」最近的避雨處走去。
dist: head off：攔截；出發（不接目的地）

phrases.stem: The two companies still need to ____ a few small problems before they sign the final agreement.
phrases.zh: iron out：解決（小問題）、消除分歧
phrases.ex: 簽約前要先「解決」幾個小問題。iron 不是熨衣服。

phrases.stem: The music festival will ____ on Friday evening with a concert by a popular local band.
phrases.ex: 音樂節以樂團演出「揭開序幕」。

phrases.stem: Because of falling sales this year, the factory had to ____ two hundred workers last month.
phrases.ex: falling sales 導致工廠「裁員」。

phrases.stem: When you tell the story to the children, you can ____ the scary parts so they will not have bad dreams.
phrases.ex: so they won't have bad dreams 表示把可怕的部分「略去」。

phrases.stem: The refugees had to ____ almost everything they owned when they ran away from the war.
phrases.ex: 逃離戰爭時只能把財物「留在原地」。

phrases.stem: I promised to help my friend move this weekend, and I really don't want to ____.
phrases.ex: I promised 表示答應了，不想「讓她失望」。

phrases.stem: Hundreds of fans ____ outside the theater for hours to buy tickets for the singer's only concert.
phrases.ex: for hours to buy tickets 說明粉絲「排隊」。

phrases.stem: The new restaurant was very expensive, and sadly the food did not ____ our expectations.
phrases.zh: live up to：達到、不辜負（期望）
phrases.ex: sadly 表示食物「沒達到」期待。

phrases.stem: Before you leave for vacation, make sure you ____ the house and close all the windows.
phrases.ex: 出門度假前，要把房子「鎖好」、關窗。

phrases.stem: You need your student number and password to ____ to the school website and check your grades.
phrases.ex: 需要帳號密碼才能「登入」查成績。

phrases.stem: When I ____ my high school years, I remember the friends I made more than the tests I took.
phrases.ex: I remember 表示在「回想」過去的高中時光。
dist: look forward to：期待（未來），方向相反

phrases.stem: I ____ all my old photo albums twice, but I still couldn't find the picture of us at the beach.
phrases.ex: 在相簿裡找照片，是「翻閱」。

phrases.stem: The twins look so much alike that even their own teachers and close friends often ____ in class.
phrases.ex: 雙胞胎長得太像，連老師都會「搞混」。

phrases.stem: It's been a year since you lost the competition; it's time to ____ and focus on your next goal.
phrases.zh: move on：放下過去、繼續前進
phrases.ex: 已過一年，focus on your next goal 表示該「向前走」。

phrases.stem: After reading a long list of baby names, the couple ____ their choices to three just before the baby was born.
phrases.ex: 從長長的名單「縮小範圍」到三個。

phrases.stem: It took months before the shy boy began to ____ and talk about his problems with the school counselor.
phrases.ex: 害羞的男孩終於「打開心房」談問題。

phrases.stem: Instead of a big wedding, the couple ____ a small dinner with a few close family members.
phrases.ex: Instead of a big wedding 表示他們「選擇」小型晚宴。

phrases.stem: Nobody ____ breaking the window, so the teacher kept the whole class after school to talk about it.
phrases.ex: 沒人「承認」，所以全班留下。

phrases.stem: The government plans to ____ plastic straws over the next five years and replace them with paper ones.
phrases.ex: replace them with paper ones 表示塑膠吸管將「逐步淘汰」。
dist: phase in：逐步引進，方向相反

phrases.stem: The company wanted to ____ the problem, saying it affected only a few customers, but the news spread quickly.
phrases.ex: saying it affected only a few customers 是在「淡化」問題。
dist: play up：強調、誇大，方向相反

phrases.stem: My teacher kindly ____ a few grammar mistakes in my essay before I handed it in.
phrases.ex: 老師「指出」作文裡的文法錯誤。

phrases.stem: The police officer signaled the driver to ____ because he was driving much faster than the speed limit.
phrases.ex: 超速被警察示意「靠邊停車」。

phrases.stem: The doctors weren't sure he would survive the accident, but he ____ and was back at work six months later.
phrases.ex: weren't sure he would survive ... but 表示他「撐過來」了。

phrases.stem: Nobody believed a small team with so little money could win the championship, but they somehow ____.
phrases.zh: pull off：（克服困難）成功完成
phrases.ex: Nobody believed ... but 表示他們居然「辦到了」。

phrases.stem: The doctor has ____ any serious illness, but she still wants you to rest for a few days just in case.
phrases.ex: but ... just in case 表示已「排除」重病，只是保險起見休息。

phrases.stem: Don't ____ marriage just because all your friends are getting married; take time to know each other first.
phrases.ex: take time 與之對比，表示不要「倉促」結婚。

phrases.stem: We went to the airport early to ____ before her flight to London, and we all waved goodbye.
phrases.ex: before her flight 與 waved goodbye 表示是「送行」，不是接機。

phrases.stem: The boy said he was too sick to go to school, but his mother ____ his trick immediately.
phrases.ex: but 轉折，媽媽立刻「識破」裝病的把戲。

phrases.stem: The tickets for the concert ____ in just ten minutes, so many fans who waited online were disappointed.
phrases.ex: 十分鐘內「賣光」，所以很多人失望。

phrases.stem: The power company had to ____ the nuclear plant for safety checks after the earthquake.
phrases.zh: shut down：（機器、工廠）關閉、停止運轉
phrases.ex: 地震後做安全檢查，需「停機」。

phrases.stem: If you want to join the summer camp, you must ____ it before the end of May.
phrases.ex: want to join ... before the end of May 是報名期限。

phrases.stem: The teacher ____ Kevin for praise because his science project was the most creative in the class.
phrases.ex: the most creative 說明老師特別「挑出」他表揚。
dist: leave out：遺漏、排除在外，方向相反

phrases.stem: My computer kept crashing, but my brother, who is good with machines, ____ the problem in ten minutes.
phrases.ex: 擅長機器的哥哥十分鐘就「解決」問題。

phrases.stem: I cannot hear you at the back of the room. Could you ____ a little, please?
phrases.ex: I can't hear you 表示請對方「說大聲點」。

phrases.stem: After the scandal, the mayor announced that he would ____ and let someone else lead the city.
phrases.ex: let someone else lead 表示市長要「下台」。
dist: step up：加強；挺身而出，方向相反

phrases.stem: The police have ____ patrols in the area after a series of robberies last month.
phrases.ex: 連續搶案後警方「加強」巡邏。
dist: give up：放棄，與搶案後的反應相反

phrases.stem: I did not want to go camping at first, but my friends finally ____ it, and I had a great time.
phrases.zh: talk sb into sth：說服某人做某事
phrases.ex: did not want ... but ... had a great time 表示被朋友「說服去了」。
dist: talk sb out of：勸某人不要做，方向相反

phrases.stem: My cousin Jack wanted to quit school and travel the world, but his parents ____ it, so he stayed and graduated.
phrases.zh: talk sb out of：勸某人打消念頭
phrases.ex: so he stayed and graduated 表示父母「勸他打消」休學念頭。
dist: talk sb into：說服某人做，方向相反
let sb in on：讓某人知道（秘密）

phrases.stem: The old factory will be ____ next month to make room for a new park.
phrases.ex: to make room for a new park 表示舊工廠要「拆掉」。

phrases.stem: This is an important decision, so take a few days to ____ before you give me your answer.
phrases.ex: important decision ... before you give me your answer，表示先「好好考慮」。
dist: turn down：拒絕，與「之後再回覆」不合

phrases.stem: Don't ____ those glass bottles; we can recycle them or use them as flower vases.
phrases.ex: 可以回收或當花瓶，所以別「丟掉」。

phrases.stem: The boat was rocking so much that several passengers felt sick and ____ over the side.
phrases.ex: felt sick 在搖晃的船上，表示「吐了」。

phrases.stem: You should ____ the jeans before you buy them; sizes can be different from brand to brand.
phrases.ex: 買褲子前先「試穿」，因為尺寸各品牌不同。
dist: try out：試用（機器）；參加選拔

phrases.stem: The coach will let new players ____ for the soccer team next Monday after school.
phrases.ex: new players ... for the soccer team 是「參加選拔」。

phrases.stem: In the old story, the ugly frog ____ a handsome prince after the princess kissed him.
phrases.ex: 青蛙被親吻後「變成」王子。

phrases.stem: We have ____ all the milk, so someone needs to go to the store before breakfast tomorrow.
phrases.ex: 需要去買，表示牛奶「用完」了。
dist: pick up：買回；拿起，與需要去買矛盾

phrases.stem: It took a serious flood for the town to ____ the danger of building houses so close to the river.
phrases.ex: 大水災之後才「意識到」危險。

phrases.stem: Before the race, the runners spent ten minutes ____ by jogging slowly and stretching their legs.
phrases.ex: Before the race 慢跑、伸展是「熱身」。
dist: cool down：（運動後）緩和、冷卻，時間相反

phrases.stem: ____ for falling rocks when you drive along this mountain road, especially after heavy rain.
phrases.ex: falling rocks 是危險，要「小心」。

phrases.stem: The terrible disease almost ____ the island's birds, and only a few hundred are left today.
phrases.ex: only a few hundred are left 表示疾病幾乎「消滅」鳥群。

phrases.stem: Please ____ my phone number in case you get lost and need to call me.
phrases.ex: in case you get lost 要先「記下」電話。

phrases.stem: Although the two sisters look alike, they have very little ____; one loves sports, while the other prefers reading.
phrases.ex: 後半句說兩人興趣不同，表示「共同點」很少。

phrases.stem: The teacher explained the new rules ____, covering each point slowly so that no one would be confused.
phrases.ex: covering each point slowly 表示「詳細地」說明；in short 與逐點慢講相反。

phrases.stem: ____, people who exercise regularly live longer, although there are of course some exceptions.
phrases.ex: although there are some exceptions 說明這是「一般而言」的情況。

phrases.stem: The shy singer felt nervous whenever she had to perform ____, so she practiced in front of her family first.
phrases.ex: 害羞又緊張，是因為要「當眾」表演；in private 方向相反。

phrases.stem: The manager didn't want to embarrass Tom in front of others, so she asked to speak with him ____.
phrases.ex: 不想在別人面前讓他難堪，所以「私下」談。

phrases.stem: I enjoy all kinds of music, but I love jazz ____; I listen to it every night before bed.
phrases.ex: all kinds of music 與 jazz 對照，表示「尤其」喜歡爵士。

phrases.stem: The school changed its lunch menu ____ complaints from many parents about unhealthy food.
phrases.ex: 家長抱怨在先，學校改菜單是「回應」抱怨。

phrases.stem: The farmer let us stay in his house for free ____ our help on his farm.
phrases.ex: 免費住宿是對我們幫忙的「回報」。

phrases.stem: When it gets cold, these birds fly thousands of miles south ____ warmer weather and food.
phrases.ex: 鳥飛往南方是為了「尋找」溫暖氣候和食物。

phrases.stem: We argued about where to eat for nearly an hour, but ____ we just ordered pizza and stayed home.
phrases.ex: 爭論了一小時後的結果，「最後」叫披薩。

phrases.stem: Your new passport will be ready in two weeks; ____, you can use this paper to prove who you are.
phrases.ex: 兩週內護照還沒好，「在此期間」先用這張紙證明身分。
dist: in the long run：長遠來看

phrases.stem: We left home early and arrived at the theater just ____ to find our seats before the movie began.
phrases.ex: 提早出門，剛好「及時」在電影開始前入座。

phrases.stem: The boy knew he would be ____ with his parents when they found out he had skipped school.
phrases.ex: 翹課被發現，會和父母「惹上麻煩」。

phrases.stem: Our teacher coaches the school basketball team ____ teaching math classes, which means she does both jobs every day.
phrases.ex: does both jobs 表示兩份工作都做，是「除了…還有」。

phrases.stem: All visitors must wear helmets ____ the safety rules of the factory.
phrases.ex: 戴安全帽是「依照」工廠安全規定。

phrases.stem: ____ her quiet older brother, Amy is outgoing and loves talking to strangers.
phrases.ex: 安靜的哥哥與外向的 Amy 形成「對比」。

phrases.stem: The boy gave his friend two comic books ____ a baseball card he had wanted for years.
phrases.ex: 用兩本漫畫「交換」想要的球員卡。

phrases.stem: The villagers live ____ nature; they take only what they need from the forest and plant new trees.
phrases.ex: 只取所需又種新樹，是與自然「和諧共處」。

phrases.stem: The park was built ____ the men and women who lost their lives saving others in the big fire.
phrases.ex: 為犧牲的消防員建公園，是為了「紀念」他們。

phrases.stem: The money raised at the concert will be used to help families ____ after the earthquake.
phrases.ex: 地震後要幫助的是「有需要的」家庭。

phrases.stem: He was ____ this morning and left his lunch box on the kitchen table.
phrases.ex: 忘了帶便當，是因為早上「匆忙」。

phrases.stem: If you didn't want to go to the party, why did you say yes ____?
phrases.zh: in the first place：當初；首先
phrases.ex: 質問對方「當初」為什麼要答應。
dist: in the long run：長遠來看

phrases.stem: The young doctor remained brave ____ great danger and saved many lives during the war.
phrases.ex: 戰爭中「面對」極大危險仍保持冷靜。

phrases.stem: The new speed limit is ____ the rules used in most other countries.
phrases.ex: 新速限與多數國家規定「一致、符合」。

phrases.stem: He says he is too busy to help, but ____ he just watched TV all afternoon.
phrases.ex: but 表轉折：說很忙，「事實上」在看電視。

phrases.stem: Please move your bike; it's ____ and people cannot get through the door.
phrases.ex: 人過不了門，是因為腳踏車「擋路」；on the way 是「在途中」。

phrases.stem: I will pick up some milk ____ home from work, so you don't need to go to the store.
phrases.ex: 下班「回家途中」順便買牛奶；in the way 是擋路。
dist: out of the way：偏僻；不擋路

phrases.stem: Students at this school spend, ____, about two hours a day on homework; some spend more and others less.
phrases.ex: some more, others less 說明兩小時是「平均」數字。

phrases.stem: All passengers must be ____ ten minutes before the plane takes off.
phrases.ex: 起飛前旅客必須「登機、在機上」。

phrases.stem: The museum has hundreds of old paintings ____, and visitors can enjoy them for free on Sundays.
phrases.ex: 畫作讓遊客欣賞，是「展示中」。

phrases.stem: Smoke was pouring out of the windows; the whole building was ____, and people rushed to put it out.
phrases.ex: 冒煙、消防員滅火，表示大樓「著火」。

phrases.stem: Since there were no buses in the small village, we had to travel ____ from one place to another.
phrases.ex: 沒有公車，只能「步行」。

phrases.stem: A nurse will be ____ during the marathon in case any runner feels sick.
phrases.ex: 以防跑者不舒服，護士會「在場待命」。

phrases.stem: My brother isn't lazy at all. ____, he is the hardest-working student in our class.
phrases.ex: 否定 lazy 後提出相反事實，用「相反地」。

phrases.stem: These shoes are usually expensive, but they are ____ this week at 40% off.
phrases.ex: 打六折是「特價」。

phrases.stem: It rained ____ all day, so we kept opening and closing our umbrellas.
phrases.ex: 一直開傘又收傘，表示雨「斷斷續續」地下。
dist: once and for all：一勞永逸

phrases.stem: The trains in Japan are famous for running ____; they are rarely even one minute late.
phrases.ex: 很少晚一分鐘，表示火車「準時」。

phrases.stem: Thanks to good weather, the building of the bridge is ____ and will be finished in June as planned.
phrases.ex: as planned 表示工程「按進度」進行；behind schedule 方向相反。

phrases.stem: With the final exam close ____, the students spent every evening in the library.
phrases.ex: close at hand 指考試「即將到來」，所以每晚泡圖書館。

phrases.stem: You should drink ____ eight glasses of water a day; more is even better in hot weather.
phrases.ex: more is even better 表示八杯是下限，「至少」；at most 方向相反。

phrases.stem: The bag is small; it can hold five books ____, so don't try to put more in.
phrases.ex: don't put more in 表示五本是上限，「最多」；at least 方向相反。

phrases.stem: The work is hard ____, but most days it's quite relaxing.
phrases.ex: 與 most days relaxing 對比，工作只是「有時」辛苦。

phrases.stem: Don't try to talk on the phone and drive ____; it's very dangerous.
phrases.ex: 邊講電話邊開車，是「同時」做兩件事。

phrases.stem: He finished the project on time, but ____ his health; he slept only three hours a night for a month.
phrases.zh: at the cost of：以…為代價
phrases.ex: 每晚只睡三小時，是「犧牲」健康換來的。

phrases.stem: The map is so clear that you can tell ____ where the nearest station is.
phrases.ex: 地圖很清楚，「一眼」就看出車站在哪。

phrases.stem: I am never ____ in the morning; I cannot think clearly until I've had coffee.
phrases.zh: at my best：處於最佳狀態
phrases.ex: 早上腦袋不清楚，表示不在「最佳狀態」。

phrases.stem: Sorry, the manager is in a meeting ____. Could you call back in an hour?
phrases.ex: 請一小時後再打，表示他「此刻」在開會。

phrases.stem: After waiting in line for three hours, we ____ got our tickets.
phrases.ex: 排了三小時，「終於」買到票。

phrases.stem: ____, I didn't like living in the city, but after a few months, I began to enjoy it.
phrases.ex: 與 after a few months 對比，「起初」不喜歡。

phrases.stem: I met my old classmate ____ at the train station; we had not planned it.
phrases.ex: we had not planned it 表示是「偶然」遇見。

phrases.stem: The old man was able to walk again ____ a special machine that supports his legs.
phrases.ex: 「藉由」特殊機器支撐才能再走路。

phrases.stem: My brother is shy ____, so he finds it hard to make new friends.
phrases.ex: 個性「天生」害羞，所以難交朋友。

phrases.stem: Nobody knows ____ whether it will rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella just in case.
phrases.ex: 沒人「確定」會不會下雨，所以帶傘以防萬一。

phrases.stem: Children under six can ride the bus ____; they don't need a ticket.
phrases.ex: 不用買票，就是「免費」搭車。

phrases.stem: Many fruits are rich in vitamin C. Oranges, ____, contain a lot of it.
phrases.ex: 柳丁是富含維生素C水果的「例子」。

phrases.stem: She quit smoking ____ her children, who were often sick because of the smoke.
phrases.ex: 孩子因煙生病，她「為了」孩子戒菸。

phrases.stem: I am tired of studying; let's take a break ____ and go for a walk.
phrases.ex: 休息「一會兒」去散步；for good 是永遠，不合休息。

phrases.stem: The cake isn't from a box; my mother made it ____ with flour, eggs, and sugar.
phrases.ex: 不是現成的，而是用麵粉雞蛋「從零開始」做。

phrases.stem: We don't see each other often now, but we still have dinner together ____.
phrases.ex: 不常見面但仍「偶爾」一起吃飯。
dist: once and for all：一勞永逸
