phrases.stem: This book is ____, so you cannot buy a new copy; you will have to find a used one.
phrases.ex: 買不到新書只能找二手，表示「絕版」。
dist: out of breath：上氣不接下氣

phrases.stem: Sorry, the red sweater is ____ in your size, but we will get more next week.
phrases.ex: 下週才會進貨，表示目前「缺貨」。
dist: out of breath：上氣不接下氣

phrases.stem: Those big shoulder pads went ____ years ago; nobody wears them now.
phrases.ex: 現在沒人穿，表示早已「退流行」。
dist: out of breath：上氣不接下氣

phrases.stem: The weather was terrible and two players were sick, so ____ the team did quite well to finish second.
phrases.zh: under the circumstances：在這種情況下
phrases.ex: 天候差又有人生病，「在這種情況下」拿第二算不錯。

phrases.stem: You should ____ open the door to strangers when you are home alone, even if they say they are from the police.
phrases.ex: 否定詞置首倒裝（should you），表示「絕不」可開門。
dist: under the circumstances：在這種情況下（意思相反，不表禁止）

phrases.stem: Keep your phone ____ when you go hiking, in case you need to call for help.
phrases.ex: 以防要求救，手機要放在「伸手可及」處；out of reach 相反。

phrases.stem: She is ____ the best player on the team; no one else scores as many points.
phrases.ex: 沒人得分比她多，「無疑」是最佳球員；by no means 方向相反。

phrases.stem: I am writing ____ your letter of May 3, in which you asked about our summer classes.
phrases.ex: 寫信是「關於」對方五月三日的來信。

phrases.stem: This new law will affect not just a few workers but the country ____.
phrases.ex: not just a few workers 對比「整個」國家。

phrases.stem: Everyone was talking quietly when, ____, the lights went out and people began to scream.
phrases.ex: 燈「突然」熄滅讓人尖叫。
dist: once and for all：一勞永逸
day in and day out：日復一日

phrases.stem: Let's solve this problem ____ so that we never have to argue about it again.
phrases.zh: once and for all：一勞永逸
phrases.ex: never again 表示要「一勞永逸」地解決。

phrases.stem: ____, her English improved, and after two years she could read novels without a dictionary.
phrases.ex: after two years 表示英文是「逐漸」進步。
dist: once and for all：一勞永逸

phrases.stem: He has worked at the same factory ____ for thirty years, without ever taking a long vacation.
phrases.zh: day in and day out：日復一日
phrases.ex: 三十年沒長假，表示「日復一日」工作。
dist: once and for all：一勞永逸

phrases.stem: I usually cook at home, but ____ we eat out at a restaurant as a treat.
phrases.ex: usually 在家煮，「偶爾」才外食；day in and day out 方向相反。
dist: day in and day out：日復一日
once and for all：一勞永逸

phrases.stem: If you keep spending more than you earn, ____ you will run out of money.
phrases.ex: 入不敷出，「遲早」會沒錢。
dist: once and for all：一勞永逸

phrases.stem: The work is ____ finished; we just need to check a few small details.
phrases.ex: 只剩小細節，表示「差不多」完成。
dist: once and for all：一勞永逸

phrases.stem: If you want good seats, you should book your tickets ____.
phrases.ex: 想要好位子要「提前」訂票。

phrases.stem: Doctors must read new studies to keep their knowledge ____.
phrases.ex: 讀新研究是為了讓知識保持「最新」；out of date 相反。

phrases.stem: I don't mind where we go for dinner; it's ____ you.
phrases.ex: 我不在意去哪，「由你決定」。

phrases.stem: It was unkind of them to laugh at him ____; they would never say those things to his face.
phrases.ex: 與 to his face 對比，是「在背後」嘲笑。

phrases.stem: The flight was delayed because of a storm, which was ____, so the airline could not be blamed.
phrases.zh: beyond their control：他們無法控制
phrases.ex: 暴風雨是航空公司「無法控制」的，所以不能怪他們。
dist: under their control：在他們控制之下
on their side：站在他們那邊

phrases.stem: Tom was so ____ the novel that he did not hear his mother calling him for dinner.
phrases.zh: be absorbed in：專心於、沉浸於
phrases.ex: so...that he did not hear his mother 表示他看小說看得太投入，所以是「沉浸於」。

phrases.stem: Many teenagers are ____ their phones; they feel nervous if they cannot check their messages for even an hour.
phrases.zh: be addicted to：沉迷於、對…上癮
phrases.ex: 一小時不看訊息就緊張，表示「上癮」。
dist: be indifferent to：漠不關心（與後半句相反）

phrases.stem: After shouting at his little sister for no reason, Ben felt ____ his behavior and said sorry to her.
phrases.ex: 無故對妹妹大吼，之後道歉，表示他「感到羞愧」。
dist: be proud of：以…為傲（與道歉相反）

phrases.stem: Lisa could not fall asleep the night before her driving test because she was ____ failing it again.
phrases.ex: 睡不著＋怕又沒考過，表示「焦慮」。

phrases.stem: The company is ____ reducing plastic waste; it has stopped giving out plastic bags in all its stores.
phrases.ex: 後半句說已停止發塑膠袋，表示公司「致力於」減塑。
dist: be opposed to：反對（與後半句相反）

phrases.stem: Many parents are ____ the safety of the old bridge, so they have asked the city to repair it before an accident happens.
phrases.ex: 要求在出事前修橋，表示家長「擔心」安全。

phrases.stem: My grandfather does not need a big house or a fancy car; he is ____ a simple life in the countryside.
phrases.ex: 不需要大房子或名車，表示他「滿足於」簡單生活。
dist: be bored with：對…感到厭煩（與前半句不合）

phrases.stem: Dr. Lin has been ____ helping poor children for thirty years, and she has never asked for anything in return.
phrases.zh: be dedicated to：致力於、奉獻於
phrases.ex: 三十年幫助貧童且不求回報，是「奉獻」。
dist: be addicted to：沉迷、上癮（多用於不良習慣）
be exposed to：暴露於；接觸到

phrases.stem: After months of staying at home, the students were ____ a chance to travel and see the world.
phrases.ex: 在家待了好幾個月，所以「渴望」有機會出門旅行。
dist: be tired of：厭倦（與想去旅行相反）

phrases.stem: The two countries have been ____ peace talks for weeks, hoping to reach an agreement soon.
phrases.ex: 兩國持續數週「進行」和談，希望達成協議。

phrases.stem: According to the law, all full-time workers are ____ at least seven days of paid holiday each year.
phrases.ex: According to the law 表示依法「有權享有」帶薪假。

phrases.stem: Don't worry about whether Amy can handle the new project. She is ____ the task; after all, she has managed bigger ones before.
phrases.ex: 她管過更大的專案，表示她「能勝任」這項任務。

phrases.stem: Children who are ____ second-hand smoke at home are more likely to develop health problems.
phrases.zh: be exposed to：暴露於、接觸到
phrases.ex: 在家「接觸」二手菸，所以較容易生病。
dist: be immune to：免疫（與健康問題矛盾）

phrases.stem: Since I grew up in this town, I am ____ every street here and can show you the way.
phrases.zh: be familiar with：（人）熟悉（某事物）
phrases.ex: 在這裡長大又能帶路，表示「熟悉」每條街。

phrases.stem: The song sounded ____ me, but I could not remember where I had heard it before.
phrases.zh: be/sound familiar to：（事物）為某人所熟悉
phrases.ex: 記不得在哪裡聽過，表示這首歌「聽起來耳熟」。

phrases.stem: The new medicine is ____ serious side effects, so doctors say it is safe even for young children.
phrases.ex: 連幼童都安全，表示「沒有」嚴重副作用。
dist: be subject to：易受…影響（與安全矛盾）

phrases.stem: I am ____ my English teacher for her patience; without her help, I would have given up long ago.
phrases.zh: be grateful to sb for sth：感謝某人
phrases.ex: 沒有老師的幫忙我早就放棄了，所以「感謝」老師。

phrases.stem: The man was found ____ stealing a car and was sent to prison for two years.
phrases.ex: 被送進監獄，表示被判偷車「有罪」。

phrases.stem: Once you have had the disease, your body becomes ____ it, so you will not catch it again.
phrases.ex: 不會再得到，表示身體已「免疫」。
dist: be sensitive to：對…敏感（與不會再得矛盾）

phrases.stem: After she found a job, Amy became financially ____ her parents and moved into her own apartment.
phrases.zh: be independent of：不依賴、獨立於
phrases.ex: 找到工作又搬出去住，表示經濟上「獨立」。
dist: be dependent on：依賴（方向相反）

phrases.stem: He is completely ____ fashion; he wears the same old jeans and T-shirt almost every day.
phrases.ex: 每天穿同樣舊衣服，表示對時尚「漠不關心」。
dist: be devoted to：熱衷於（皆與後半句相反）

phrases.stem: When the new baby arrived, the little boy became ____ his sister because his parents spent most of their time with her.
phrases.ex: 父母把時間都給妹妹，所以哥哥「嫉妒」。

phrases.stem: Jack is very ____ soccer; he plays it every afternoon and never misses a game on TV.
phrases.zh: be keen on：熱衷於、很喜歡
phrases.ex: 每天踢球又每場必看，表示「熱衷」。
dist: be indifferent to：漠不關心（皆與後半句相反）

phrases.stem: Look at those dark clouds. It is ____ rain this afternoon, so you had better take an umbrella.
phrases.ex: 烏雲密布、要帶傘，表示下午「可能」下雨。
dist: be ashamed to：羞於（皆形容有意願的人，不能形容天氣）

phrases.stem: She is ____ losing weight; she checks her weight five times a day and hardly eats anything.
phrases.zh: be obsessed with：著迷於、執著於
phrases.ex: 一天量五次體重又幾乎不吃，表示對減肥「過度執著」。

phrases.stem: Most people in the village are ____ building a factory here because they fear it will pollute the river.
phrases.ex: 擔心工廠汙染河川，所以「反對」蓋工廠。
dist: be dedicated to：奉獻於（皆與擔心汙染相反）

phrases.stem: Mr. Chen is very ____ his daughter, who has just won first prize in the national science fair.
phrases.ex: 女兒得全國科展首獎，父親「以她為傲」。
dist: be ashamed of：以…為恥（方向相反）

phrases.stem: Scientists believe that many health problems, such as weight gain and poor memory, are closely ____ a lack of sleep.
phrases.ex: 健康問題與睡眠不足「有關」。

phrases.stem: Although he knew he was wrong, he was ____ admit it because he did not want to lose face in front of his friends.
phrases.ex: 不想在朋友面前丟臉，所以「不願意」認錯。
dist: be ready to：準備好（皆與後半句相反）

phrases.stem: The customer was not ____ the service at all, so she asked to speak to the manager.
phrases.ex: 要求找經理，表示她對服務「不滿意」。

phrases.stem: My skin is very ____ the sun, so I always put on a hat even on cloudy days.
phrases.ex: 陰天也要戴帽子，表示皮膚對陽光「敏感」。
dist: be immune to：免疫（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The twins are so ____ each other in appearance that even their teacher often calls them by the wrong names.
phrases.ex: 老師常叫錯名字，表示雙胞胎長得很「像」。

phrases.stem: Please note that the time of the outdoor concert is ____ change because of the weather.
phrases.zh: be subject to：可能受…影響、易遭受
phrases.ex: 因天氣因素，戶外音樂會時間「可能會」變動。
dist: be immune to：不受影響（與天氣因素矛盾）

phrases.stem: Many experts believe the new phone is ____ the old one; it is faster and has a much better camera.
phrases.ex: 更快、相機更好，表示新手機「優於」舊款。
dist: be inferior to：劣於（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The old lady was ____ the stranger who kept asking about her bank account, so she called the police.
phrases.ex: 陌生人一直問銀行帳戶，她報警，表示她「起疑」。

phrases.stem: A good teacher should be ____ students' mistakes and give them chances to try again.
phrases.ex: 給學生再試的機會，表示對錯誤「寬容」。

phrases.stem: Arriving late is ____ Kevin; he has never been on time for a single meeting.
phrases.zh: be typical of：是…的典型作風
phrases.ex: 他從沒準時過，遲到是他的「典型作風」。
dist: be afraid of：害怕（主詞是「遲到」這件事，皆不合）

phrases.stem: Her brave act of saving the drowning child is ____ our respect and praise.
phrases.ex: 勇救溺水孩童，「值得」尊敬與讚美。

phrases.stem: Tainan is ____ its delicious street food and old temples, so it attracts many visitors every year.
phrases.ex: 後接出名的「原因」（美食、古廟），用 known for。
dist: be known as：以…身分／名稱為人所知（後接名稱、身分）
be known to：為某人所知（後接人）
be aware of：察覺到（主詞須為人）

phrases.stem: Abraham Lincoln, ____ "Honest Abe," was one of the most popular presidents in American history.
phrases.zh: be known as：被稱為、以…之名為人所知
phrases.ex: "Honest Abe" 是林肯的「稱號」，用 known as。
dist: be known for：因…而出名（後接原因）
be known to：為某人所知（後接人）

phrases.stem: More than two hundred volunteers were ____ cleaning up the beach after the typhoon.
phrases.ex: 志工「參與」颱風後的淨灘。
dist: be opposed to：反對（志工不會反對淨灘）

phrases.stem: We are ____ money this month, so we cannot afford to eat out this weekend.
phrases.ex: 吃不起外食，表示錢「不夠」。

phrases.stem: She is deeply ____ the old toy bear her grandmother gave her and refuses to throw it away.
phrases.ex: 拒絕丟掉奶奶給的熊，表示她很「依戀」它。

phrases.stem: Lack of sleep may ____ his poor grades this term; he has been staying up late playing games.
phrases.ex: 熬夜打電動導致睡眠不足，可以「說明」成績差的原因。

phrases.stem: It took Mia a few months to ____ the cold weather after she moved from Taiwan to Canada.
phrases.ex: 從台灣搬到加拿大，需要幾個月「適應」寒冷。

phrases.stem: I do not ____ you that money is the most important thing in life; health and family matter much more.
phrases.ex: 後半句提出不同看法，表示「不同意你」；agree with 後接人或意見。
dist: agree to：同意（提議、計畫），後面不接人

phrases.stem: Her parents do not ____ her plan to quit school and become a singer; they want her to finish college first.
phrases.ex: 父母要她先讀完大學，表示「不贊成」她休學。

phrases.stem: Our school ____ working in teams, so most of our classes include group projects.
phrases.ex: 課程多有小組作業，表示學校「重視」團隊合作（working in teams）。
dist: turn a blind eye to：視而不見（方向相反）
run the risk of：冒…的風險

phrases.stem: My grandmother ____ ghosts, so she never goes out alone at night during Ghost Month.
phrases.ex: 鬼月晚上不敢獨自外出，表示她「相信有」鬼。

phrases.stem: Students who read every day will ____ the habit; their vocabulary and writing skills will improve a lot.
phrases.ex: 字彙與寫作進步，表示從閱讀習慣中「獲益」。

phrases.stem: He always ____ his rich father and his expensive car, which makes his classmates dislike him.
phrases.ex: 一直炫耀爸爸有錢和名車，讓同學討厭，表示「吹噓」。

phrases.stem: After her mother fell ill, Jenny quit her job and stayed at home to ____ her day and night.
phrases.ex: 母親生病，她辭職在家日夜「照顧」。

phrases.stem: If you always ____ your classmates, you will never feel happy, because someone will always be better than you.
phrases.zh: compare A with/to B：將A與B比較
phrases.ex: 總有人比你強，所以老是「拿自己跟別人比」不會快樂。

phrases.stem: The neighbors ____ the loud music from our party, so we turned it down right away.
phrases.ex: 我們馬上把音樂關小聲，表示鄰居「抱怨」噪音。

phrases.stem: Please turn off the TV; I cannot ____ my homework with all this noise.
phrases.ex: 太吵了，無法「專心」寫作業。

phrases.stem: After hours of questioning by the police, the boy finally ____ breaking the store window.
phrases.zh: confess to：承認、坦白（錯誤或罪行）
phrases.ex: 被盤問數小時後終於「承認」打破窗戶。

phrases.stem: All new buildings must ____ the safety rules, or they will not be allowed to open.
phrases.ex: 否則不准開幕，表示建築必須「符合」安全規定。

phrases.stem: The doctor cannot operate on the child unless the parents ____ it in writing.
phrases.ex: 手術須家長書面「同意」。

phrases.stem: Customs in Japan ____ those in Taiwan in many ways; for example, people there do not usually give tips at restaurants.
phrases.ex: 舉例說明兩地習俗「不同」。

phrases.stem: Studies show that within a few days of birth, babies can ____ the voices of other women, often turning toward her when she speaks.
phrases.ex: 研究指出嬰兒出生幾天就能「分辨」媽媽和別人的聲音。
dist: mistake A for B：把A誤認為B（方向相反，下文說會轉向媽媽）
compare A with B：比較A與B（嬰兒不是在「比較」，且與轉向媽媽無因果）
separate A into B：把A分成B（語意不通）

phrases.stem: As a child, Kevin ____ becoming a pilot, and he finally made it at the age of twenty-five.
phrases.ex: 小時候的願望最後實現了，表示他從小「夢想」當機師。
dist: complain of：抱怨（與實現夢想矛盾）

phrases.stem: More than five hundred runners ____ the charity race last Sunday, and all the money went to poor families.
phrases.ex: 五百多名跑者「參加」慈善路跑。

phrases.stem: Instead of worrying about things you cannot change, you should ____ what you can do right now.
phrases.ex: 與其擔心無法改變的事，不如「專注於」能做的事。

phrases.stem: Playing video games late at night may ____ your sleep and make you feel tired the next day.
phrases.ex: 隔天疲累，表示深夜打電動「干擾」睡眠。

phrases.stem: The small factory could not ____ the rising demand for its products, so the company decided to build a bigger one.
phrases.ex: 因此要蓋更大的工廠，表示原工廠「跟不上」需求。
dist: turn a blind eye to：視而不見

phrases.stem: We moved the sofa into the corner to ____ the new piano in the living room.
phrases.ex: 把沙發移到角落，是為了「騰出空間」放鋼琴。
dist: run the risk of：冒…的風險

phrases.stem: Smart students ____ every free minute, even the time on the bus, to review what they have learned.
phrases.ex: 連搭公車時間都拿來複習，表示「善用」零碎時間。
dist: turn a blind eye to：視而不見
stand a chance of：有…的可能

phrases.stem: I still cannot ____ whether to study in Taipei or stay in my hometown for college.
phrases.zh: make up one's mind：下定決心、做決定
phrases.ex: whether to A or B 表示還無法「做決定」。

phrases.stem: After the flood, the charity ____ food and clean water, which helped them get through the hard times.
phrases.ex: 幫助災民度過難關，表示「提供」食物和水。
dist: deprive A of B：剝奪A的B（方向相反）

phrases.stem: How did your parents ____ the news that you had failed the math test?
phrases.ex: 問父母聽到消息的「反應」。

phrases.stem: It took my uncle three months to fully ____ the car accident and go back to work.
phrases.ex: 三個月後回去上班，表示從車禍中「康復」。
dist: suffer from：受…之苦（與回去上班不合）

phrases.stem: When you write a report, you should ____ reliable sources such as books and official websites.
phrases.ex: 寫報告要「參考」可靠資料。

phrases.stem: The company did not ____ my email for two weeks, so I finally called them instead.
phrases.ex: 公司兩週沒「回」信，所以改打電話。

phrases.stem: If you drive after drinking, you ____ losing your license or even your life.
phrases.zh: run the risk of：冒…的風險
phrases.ex: 酒駕會「冒著」失去駕照甚至生命的風險。

phrases.stem: With so many excellent players on the team this year, we ____ winning the championship.
phrases.zh: stand a chance of：有…的可能
phrases.ex: 球隊有很多好球員，所以「有機會」奪冠。
dist: run the risk of：冒…的風險（用於壞事，方向相反）
turn a blind eye to：視而不見

phrases.stem: If you do not have any sugar at home, you can ____ to make the cake sweet.
phrases.ex: 家裡沒糖，所以「用蜂蜜代替糖」。
dist: substitute sugar for honey：用糖代替蜂蜜（方向相反，家裡沒糖）

phrases.stem: After many failed attempts, the scientists finally ____ sending the small rocket into space.
phrases.ex: 多次失敗後終於「成功」發射火箭。

phrases.stem: Many office workers ____ back pain because they sit at their desks for too long every day.
phrases.ex: 久坐導致上班族「受」背痛「之苦」。
dist: recover from：復原（久坐不會讓人復原）

phrases.stem: While the manager was on vacation, Amy ____ the whole project and made sure everything went smoothly.
phrases.ex: 經理休假時由 Amy「負責」整個專案。
dist: run the risk of：冒…的風險

phrases.stem: When choosing a college, you should ____ not only your interests but also your future career.
phrases.ex: 選大學要「考慮」興趣與未來職涯。
dist: turn a blind eye to：視而不見（方向相反）
run the risk of：冒…的風險
stand a chance of：有…的可能

phrases.stem: The old man ____ his bread; he still gets up at four every morning to make it by hand.
phrases.ex: 每天四點起床手工做麵包，表示他「以自己的麵包為傲」。
dist: run the risk of：冒…的風險
turn a blind eye to：視而不見

phrases.stem: All the students ____ Mr. Wang because he is fair, patient, and always willing to help.
phrases.zh: think highly of：重視、高度評價
phrases.ex: 老師公正、耐心又樂於助人，學生都「很敬重」他。
dist: look down on：瞧不起（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The teacher could no longer ____ the bullying in her class, so she reported it to the school.
phrases.zh: turn a blind eye to：對…視而不見
phrases.ex: 她「無法再視而不見」，所以向學校報告霸凌。

phrases.stem: You can borrow my camera ____ you promise to bring it back by Sunday in good condition.
phrases.ex: 借相機的「條件」是答應週日前歸還。
dist: even though：雖然；答應歸還不是讓步關係
so that：以便；借相機不是為了讓你答應

phrases.stem: Please call me ____ your plane lands; I'll be waiting in the parking lot and will drive to the gate right away.
phrases.ex: right away 表示飛機一落地就要馬上打電話。
dist: as long as：只要；落地不是持續條件
in case：以防；落地不是需要預防的事

phrases.stem: ____ the price is concerned, this phone is a great deal, but its battery dies far too quickly.
phrases.zh: as far as ... is concerned：就…而言
phrases.ex: is concerned 與 as far as 固定搭配，表示「就價格而言」，後半句再談電池。
dist: as long as：只要；不與 is concerned 連用
as well as：以及；後面不接子句

phrases.stem: The community center now offers free cooking classes ____ computer lessons, so seniors can choose either one or both.
phrases.ex: choose either one or both 表示兩種課都有開。
dist: instead of：而不是；那就只有一種課
other than：除了…之外（排除）；與兩者皆可選矛盾

phrases.stem: ____ the heavy rain last night, several roads near the river were closed this morning.
phrases.zh: as a result of：由於、因為…的結果
phrases.ex: 大雨是道路封閉的原因。
dist: in spite of：儘管；大雨與封路不是讓步關係

phrases.stem: Most students in this class prefer reading printed books, ____ reading on phones, because staring at screens for hours hurts their eyes.
phrases.zh: as opposed to：而不是、與…相對
phrases.ex: 盯著螢幕傷眼，所以偏好紙本「而非」用手機讀。
dist: as well as：以及；與傷眼理由矛盾
such as：例如；用手機讀不是紙本書的例子
together with：連同；同 as well as

phrases.stem: Although they had met only once, he greeted her warmly ____ they had been close friends for years.
phrases.ex: 只見過一次，卻熱情得「好像」多年老友（與事實相反，用過去完成式）。
dist: even though：雖然；他們其實不是老友

phrases.stem: Take an umbrella with you ____ it rains this afternoon; the weather report says the sky may turn cloudy.
phrases.ex: 天氣可能轉陰，帶傘是「以防」下雨。
dist: unless：除非；「除非下雨才帶傘」不合理
as soon as：一…就…；下雨後才帶傘已來不及

phrases.stem: Many students get up at five every morning ____ catch the first bus and avoid the crowds.
phrases.ex: 早起的目的是搭到首班車、避開人潮。
dist: in order not to：為了不要；與 avoid the crowds 矛盾
as if to：彷彿要；語意不通

phrases.stem: She spoke in a very low voice ____ wake the baby sleeping in the next room.
phrases.zh: so as not to：為了不要…
phrases.ex: 低聲說話是為了「不要」吵醒寶寶。
dist: so as to：為了要；變成想吵醒寶寶
as if to：彷彿要；語意不通

phrases.stem: The teacher wrote the key words in large letters on the board ____ the students in the back could see them clearly.
phrases.ex: 寫大字的目的是讓後排學生看得清楚。
dist: in case：以防；看得清楚不是要預防的事

phrases.stem: ____ it rains tomorrow, the marathon will still be held, so runners should bring raincoats.
phrases.ex: still 表示「就算」下雨也照常舉行。
dist: only if：只有在…才；與 still 矛盾
as soon as：一…就…；語意不通
now that：既然；明天下雨尚未發生

phrases.stem: ____ he had studied hard for weeks, he failed the test because he misread the instructions.
phrases.zh: even though：雖然、儘管（事實的讓步）
phrases.ex: 用功卻沒考過，是讓步關係。
dist: now that：既然；前後不是因果
as long as：只要；語意不通

phrases.stem: ____ you have finally passed your driving test, you can drive yourself to school instead of taking the bus.
phrases.ex: 已考過駕照，所以可以自己開車上學。
dist: even though：雖然；與後句不是讓步

phrases.stem: The library lets you borrow ten books at once ____ you have a student card; visitors without one can borrow only two.
phrases.ex: 後半句說沒證只能借兩本，所以借十本「只限」有學生證。
dist: even if：即使；與有證才能借矛盾

phrases.stem: For this report, try to put things in your own words ____ copying sentences directly from websites.
phrases.ex: 老師要求用自己的話「而不要」直接抄網路句子。
dist: as well as：以及；老師不會要你也抄
in addition to：除…之外還；同上

phrases.stem: Since the elevator was broken, we had to walk all the way up to the top floor ____ taking it as usual.
phrases.ex: 電梯壞了，只好走樓梯「而不是」照常搭電梯。
dist: in spite of：儘管；語意不通
in terms of：就…而言；語意不通
by means of：藉由；不是靠搭電梯爬樓梯

phrases.stem: The new phone is light and fast, ____ its amazing camera, which takes clear photos even at night.
phrases.zh: not to mention：更不用說、何況還有（用於肯定）
phrases.ex: 前面列優點，再補上更厲害的相機。
dist: let alone：更不用說（只用於否定句後）
rather than：而不是；相機也是優點

phrases.stem: Since losing his job, he can hardly afford a used bike, ____ a brand-new car.
phrases.zh: let alone：更不用說（用於否定之後）
phrases.ex: hardly 為否定；連舊腳踏車都買不起，「更別說」新車。
dist: such as：例如；車不是腳踏車的例子
except for：除了；變成買得起新車，不合理

phrases.stem: You stayed up until three in the morning playing games? ____ you look so tired and keep yawning in class.
phrases.ex: 熬夜打電動，「難怪」上課一直打哈欠。

phrases.stem: Our English teacher never loses his temper; ____ the students behave, he always answers them in a calm and kind way.
phrases.ex: never loses his temper 說明不管學生表現「如何」都冷靜回應。
dist: only if：只有當…；與 never loses his temper 矛盾

phrases.stem: The shop was closed for the holiday, and there was nobody on the street ____ a few tourists taking pictures.
phrases.ex: nobody ... other than 表示「除了」幾個觀光客之外沒有人。
dist: as well as：以及；與 nobody 矛盾

phrases.stem: The museum is free for everyone, ____ age, so both young children and old people can enjoy it.
phrases.ex: free for everyone 表示「不論」年齡都免費。
dist: according to：依照；依年齡收費與免費矛盾

phrases.stem: ____ the help of many volunteers, the flood victims received food and clean water within hours.
phrases.ex: 志工幫忙是災民很快拿到物資的原因。
dist: in spite of：儘管；邏輯相反

phrases.stem: The flight was delayed for three hours ____ heavy fog, which made it unsafe for planes to take off.
phrases.ex: 濃霧使起飛不安全，是延誤的原因。
dist: in spite of：儘管；邏輯相反

phrases.stem: ____ his poor health, the old farmer had to give up his work in the fields and move in with his son.
phrases.ex: 身體不好是他放棄農事的原因。
dist: in spite of：儘管；邏輯相反
in place of：代替；語意不通

phrases.stem: ____ the weather report, it will be sunny all weekend, so we have decided to go camping.
phrases.ex: 晴天的訊息來自氣象報告。
dist: in spite of：儘管；語意不通

phrases.stem: ____ a few small spelling mistakes, your essay is excellent and well organized.
phrases.ex: 小錯不算優點，「除了」小錯，文章很好。
dist: because of：因為；拼字錯誤不是文章好的原因
along with：連同；錯誤不能和優點並列

phrases.stem: The kind old lady sent us a letter of thanks ____ a box of cookies she had baked herself, which we shared with the whole class.
phrases.ex: 後面說我們分享了餅乾，表示信「連同」餅乾一起寄來。
dist: instead of：代替；那就沒有餅乾可分

phrases.stem: The mayor, ____ several reporters, visited the new hospital, and the reporters took many photos of him with the doctors.
phrases.ex: 記者也在醫院拍照，表示市長「和」記者一起去。

phrases.stem: The owner agreed to rent us the apartment ____ we would not keep any pets, because the last family's dog had damaged the floors.
phrases.ex: 前房客的狗弄壞地板，所以出租「條件」是不養寵物。

phrases.stem: You may use the school's computer room after class, ____ a teacher is there to watch the students.
phrases.ex: 使用電腦教室的條件是有老師在場。

phrases.stem: ____ he had never cooked before, his first dinner for the family was impressive, and everyone asked for a second plate.
phrases.ex: 從沒做過菜，「就這點來看」第一頓晚餐表現得很好。
dist: now that：既然；從沒做過菜不會「使」菜好吃
as soon as：一…就…；語意不通

phrases.stem: The two sisters look alike, but they are quite different ____ one loves sports while the other prefers reading quietly at home.
phrases.ex: 後面說明兩人不同「之處在於」興趣。

phrases.stem: The tiny, crowded apartment was ____ the large house with a garden that the ad had described.
phrases.zh: a far cry from：與…相差甚遠
phrases.ex: tiny, crowded 與 large house 對比，實物與廣告「差很多」。
dist: the same as：和…一樣；與對比矛盾
a perfect match for：完全符合；與對比矛盾

phrases.stem: With his talent and hard work, it's only ____ before he becomes a famous pianist.
phrases.zh: a matter of time：只是時間早晚的問題
phrases.ex: 有天分又努力，成名「遲早」會發生。
dist: a waste of time：浪費時間

phrases.stem: The fire fighters were working ____ to rescue the people trapped in the building before the fire spread.
phrases.zh: against the clock：分秒必爭、與時間賽跑
phrases.ex: before the fire spread 表示要搶時間救人。
dist: out of the blue：突然、出乎意料

phrases.stem: Many people laughed at her ideas about electric cars in the 1980s, but now we know she was ____.
phrases.zh: ahead of one's time：超越時代、思想領先
phrases.ex: 當時被嘲笑、現在證明對，表示她「走在時代前端」。
dist: behind the times：落伍；方向相反

phrases.stem: Tell me everything about your trip to Japan. I am ____, and I will not say a word until you finish.
phrases.ex: I won't say a word 表示專心「聽」。
dist: all for it：完全贊成；這裡不是表態

phrases.stem: My uncle loves traveling so much that he will pack his bags and leave ____ whenever a friend invites him somewhere.
options: at the drop of a hat
at the top of his voice
phrases.zh: at the drop of a hat：毫不猶豫地、立刻
phrases.ex: loves traveling so much 表示一被邀就「馬上」出發。
dist: at first sight：第一眼；乍看之下
at a slow pace：慢慢地；方向相反
at the top of his voice：扯開嗓門

phrases.stem: The computer crashed before I saved my report, so I was ____ and had to write the whole thing again.
phrases.zh: back to square one：回到原點、從頭開始
phrases.ex: had to write the whole thing again 說明一切「從頭來過」。
dist: back on track：重回正軌；方向相反
on the right track：方向正確
on top of the world：非常開心

phrases.stem: Audiences only see the actors on stage, but many people work hard ____ to make each show a success.
phrases.ex: 與 on stage 對比，許多人在「幕後」工作。
dist: in the spotlight：受到注目；方向相反

phrases.stem: The small noodle shop never advertises; it became popular ____ as happy customers told their friends about it.
phrases.zh: by word of mouth：口耳相傳
phrases.ex: 顧客告訴朋友，就是「口碑」傳開。

phrases.stem: A bright red dress in the shop window ____ as I walked past, so I went in to try it on.
phrases.zh: catch one's eye：吸引某人目光
phrases.ex: so I went in to try it on 表示洋裝「吸引了我」。

phrases.stem: In many cultures, a special ceremony is held when young people ____, usually when they finish high school.
phrases.ex: 高中畢業時舉行的典禮，表示他們「成年」了。

phrases.stem: It took her a long time to ____ the loss of her pet dog, but now she can talk about him with a smile.
phrases.zh: come to terms with：接受、面對（傷痛）
phrases.ex: 現在能笑著談，表示她已「接受」失去愛犬。

phrases.stem: I don't mind helping my brother with his homework, but I ____ at writing all of it for him.
phrases.zh: draw the line at：拒絕做、劃清界線
phrases.ex: 願意幫忙但不幫他全寫，是「劃清界線」。

phrases.stem: After breaking his neighbor's window with a baseball, the boy decided to ____ and tell the truth instead of hiding.
phrases.zh: face the music：勇於承擔後果
phrases.ex: tell the truth instead of hiding 表示他願意「面對後果」。
dist: turn a blind eye：視而不見

phrases.stem: Good jobs are ____ in this small town, so many young people move to big cities after graduation.
phrases.zh: few and far between：稀少、難得
phrases.ex: 年輕人外移，表示好工作「很少」。
dist: a dime a dozen：多得是、不稀奇（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The speaker's talk about how much food we waste every day gave us plenty of ____; many of us started to rethink our eating habits.
options: a taste of their own medicine
phrases.zh: food for thought：值得深思的事
phrases.ex: 聽完開始反省飲食習慣，表示演講「發人深省」。
dist: a piece of cake：輕而易舉；字面與食物相關
bread and butter：主要收入來源；字面陷阱
a taste of one's own medicine：以其人之道還治其人之身

phrases.stem: I want to thank you ____ for taking care of my mother while I was abroad.
options: from the bottom of my heart
from the top of my head
phrases.zh: from the bottom of one's heart：衷心地
phrases.ex: 感謝照顧母親，是「由衷」感謝。
dist: from the top of one's head：不假思索地
from bad to worse：每況愈下

phrases.stem: Riding a bike seemed hard at first, but after a few days of practice, I ____ it.
phrases.zh: get the hang of：掌握訣竅、上手
phrases.ex: but 與 hard at first 對比，練習後「上手」了。
dist: get in the way of：妨礙

phrases.stem: I have never eaten stinky tofu before, but it smells interesting, so I will ____.
phrases.ex: 沒吃過但覺得有趣，所以「試試」。

phrases.stem: The hotel staff always ____ for their guests, like remembering their names and leaving welcome notes written by hand.
phrases.zh: go the extra mile：額外努力、多做一步
phrases.ex: 記住名字、手寫卡片是「超出本分」的服務。
dist: go back on one's word：食言

phrases.stem: Students should ____ the school rules, since they are the ones who have to follow them every day.
phrases.zh: have a say in：對…有發言權
phrases.ex: 要遵守規定的是學生，所以應「有發言權」。
dist: have a word with：和某人談談；對象須是人
have nothing to do with：與…無關；與理由矛盾

phrases.stem: It's getting dark and we still have a long drive home, so we had better ____ now.
options: hit the nail on the head
phrases.ex: 天黑、路途遠，該「出發」了。
dist: hit the nail on the head：一針見血

phrases.stem: Although my best friend moved to Canada, we ____ by sending messages and making video calls every week.
phrases.ex: 每週傳訊、視訊就是「保持聯絡」。
dist: keep one's distance：保持距離；方向相反

phrases.stem: Don't ____ just because you failed once; most successful people failed many times before they made it.
phrases.ex: Don't 加上成功者也失敗過，是勸人別「灰心」。
dist: take heart：振作；方向相反（不會叫人別振作）

phrases.stem: He ____ by selling a popular phone game he designed, and he used part of the money to build a school in his hometown.
phrases.ex: 用部分的錢就能蓋學校，表示他「賺大錢」。

phrases.stem: The teenager ____ around the world when she sailed alone across the Pacific Ocean.
phrases.zh: make headlines：登上頭條、成為新聞焦點
phrases.ex: 獨自橫渡太平洋，全世界都「報導」她。

phrases.stem: The drawer was full of ____ such as old keys, broken pens, and rubber bands.
phrases.ex: 鑰匙、斷筆、橡皮筋都是「雜七雜八的東西」。
dist: flesh and blood：血肉之軀；親人

phrases.stem: Before the project starts, let's have a short meeting to make sure everyone is ____ about the goals and the deadline.
phrases.zh: on the same page：看法一致、有共識
phrases.ex: 開會確認大家對目標「有共識」。
dist: in the same boat：處境相同（多指困境）；字面相似
on the waiting list：在候補名單上

phrases.stem: I hadn't heard from Tom for ten years, and then ____, he called me last night to invite me to his wedding.
phrases.zh: out of the blue：突然、出乎意料地
phrases.ex: 十年沒聯絡卻來電，是「突然」。

phrases.stem: We haven't made any plans for the weekend yet; we will just ____ and decide what to do depending on the weather.
phrases.zh: play it by ear：見機行事、臨場決定
phrases.ex: 沒計畫、看天氣決定，就是「見機行事」。
dist: play hard to get：故作矜持

phrases.stem: Before you laugh at his mistake, try to ____ and imagine how embarrassed he must feel.
phrases.zh: put oneself in someone's shoes：設身處地
phrases.ex: imagine how embarrassed he must feel 就是「設身處地」。
dist: put one's foot down：堅決反對
put someone on the spot：使人難堪；與體諒相反

phrases.stem: The night market is open every evening, ____, so you can visit it even during the rainy season.
phrases.ex: every evening 與 even during the rainy season 表示「風雨無阻」。
dist: now and then：偶爾；與 every evening 矛盾

phrases.stem: Her letter said everything was fine, but if you ____, you could tell she was lonely and missed home.
phrases.zh: read between the lines：讀出弦外之音
phrases.ex: 信上說沒事，卻能看出她寂寞，是「領會言外之意」。
dist: read in a hurry：匆忙讀；反而讀不出來

phrases.stem: Instead of admitting he was wrong in front of his students, the teacher made an excuse to ____.
phrases.ex: 不肯在學生面前認錯而找藉口，是為了「保面子」。
dist: face the facts：面對現實；與找藉口矛盾

phrases.stem: The service at this hotel is ____; the staff are polite, helpful, and always ready to solve any problem.
phrases.zh: second to none：首屈一指、最好的
phrases.ex: 員工有禮又熱心，服務「無人能比」。

phrases.stem: The main actors were great, but the little girl who played the cat ____ with her funny dance.
phrases.ex: but 對比主角，小女孩「搶走鋒頭」。
dist: run out of time：時間不夠

phrases.stem: There's only one computer at home, so my sister and I ____ using it, an hour each.
phrases.ex: 只有一台電腦、一人一小時，就是「輪流」。

phrases.stem: I thought the cat was chasing the mouse, but it was actually ____: the tiny mouse was chasing the frightened cat!
phrases.zh: the other way around：正好相反
phrases.ex: 冒號後說明是老鼠追貓，情況「相反」。
dist: the same way：一樣；方向相反

phrases.stem: You should ____ before lending money to him; he still hasn't paid back what he borrowed last year.
phrases.ex: 他欠錢未還，借錢前要「三思」。
dist: think straight：頭腦清楚地思考（多用於否定）

phrases.stem: Like every marriage, their marriage has had its ____, but after forty years they are still happily together.
phrases.zh: ups and downs：起起伏伏、好壞時光
phrases.ex: but still happily together 對比婚姻中的「起伏」。

phrases.stem: The teacher could tell that the student had copied the article ____ because even the spelling mistakes were the same.
phrases.ex: 連拼錯的字都一樣，是「一字不差」地抄。
dist: by word of mouth：口耳相傳；字面陷阱

phrases.stem: Whether the school trip will happen is still ____; the teachers will not decide until they check the weather on Friday.
phrases.zh: up in the air：懸而未決、尚未確定
phrases.ex: 老師週五才決定，表示旅行「還沒確定」。
dist: on the air：廣播中；字面陷阱

phrases.stem: His name is ____; I know I have heard it many times, but I just cannot remember it right now.
options: on the tip of my tongue
on the top of my list
phrases.zh: on the tip of one's tongue：話到嘴邊（一時想不起來）
phrases.ex: 聽過很多次卻想不起來，就是「話到嘴邊說不出」。
dist: on the top of one's list：列為第一優先
on the other hand：另一方面
on one's mind：掛念著；與想不起來矛盾

phrases.stem: Although she is a famous movie star, she is very ____ and often chats with her fans like an old friend.
phrases.zh: down to earth：務實的；平易近人的
phrases.ex: Although 對比大明星身分，她卻「平易近人」。
dist: out of this world：極好的（形容事物）
full of oneself：自以為是；方向相反

phrases.stem: Many people take clean water ____ until a typhoon cuts off the supply for several days.
phrases.zh: take ... for granted：視為理所當然
phrases.ex: 直到停水才知可貴，平常把水「視為理所當然」。
dist: for good：永遠（take ... for good 不成語）
take ... to heart：放在心上、認真看待

phrases.stem: Rising sea levels ____ to coastal cities, where millions of people may lose their homes in the coming decades.
phrases.zh: pose a threat to：對…構成威脅
phrases.ex: 後半句說數百萬人可能失去家園，可見海平面上升對沿海城市「構成威脅」。
dist: lend a hand to：幫忙；海平面不會幫助城市
pay a visit to：拜訪；字面像「來到城市」但語意不通
set an example to：給…做榜樣；與失去家園無關

phrases.stem: The charity runs free workshops in high schools to ____ the dangers of drunk driving among teenagers.
phrases.zh: raise awareness of：提高對…的認識（意識）
phrases.ex: 慈善團體辦免費講座，目的是讓青少年「更加意識到」酒駕的危險。
dist: take advantage of：利用；利用酒駕危險說不通
make fun of：取笑；與慈善講座目的相反
lose sight of：忽略、忘記；方向相反

phrases.stem: Since more people began working from home, the company has hired extra workers to ____ for office chairs, which has doubled this year.
phrases.ex: which has doubled 指椅子的需求倍增，所以多雇工人來「滿足需求」。
dist: pay the price：付出代價；不是指付錢買椅子
draw the line：劃清界線、設限；語意不通
break the ice：打破僵局；用於人際場合

phrases.stem: When you choose a university, ____ that the cheapest school is not always the best choice for your future.
phrases.ex: 後接 that 子句，提醒對方「記住」最便宜的學校不一定最好。
dist: keep in touch：保持聯絡；不能接 that 子句
come in handy：派上用場；主詞須是物品
fall in love：墜入愛河；語意不通

phrases.stem: The artist hung hundreds of plastic bottles from the bridge to ____ the waste problem, hoping people walking by would finally notice it.
phrases.zh: draw attention to：引起（別人）對…的注意
phrases.ex: hoping people walking by would notice 表示藝術家要讓「別人」注意，是引起注意，不是自己注意。
dist: pay attention to：（自己）注意；藝術家是要讓路人注意
turn a blind eye to：視而不見；方向相反
get used to：習慣於；與希望大家注意不合

phrases.stem: After several students were hurt on the stairs, the school promised to ____ to make the building safer, such as adding handrails.
phrases.ex: such as adding handrails 舉出具體作法，所以是「採取措施」。
dist: take turns：輪流；學校不是輪流做事
take notes：做筆記；與讓建築更安全無關

phrases.stem: As the oldest of five children, Mia always tries to ____ for her younger brothers by studying hard and keeping her room tidy.
phrases.ex: 身為長女，她用功、整理房間，是為弟弟們「做榜樣」。
dist: make a scene：當眾吵鬧；與用功整潔相反
pull a face：扮鬼臉；語意不通
take a chance：冒險一試；與做好榜樣無關

phrases.stem: Doctors warn that staring at a phone screen in the dark can ____ your eyes, so turn on a light if you must use it at night.
phrases.ex: 醫生警告、建議開燈，可見在黑暗中看手機「對眼睛有害」。
dist: make room for：騰出空間給…；語意不通
give way to：讓位給、被…取代；不合
pay a visit to：拜訪；語意不通

phrases.stem: Although he is shy, Leo ____ to talk to at least one new classmate every day, and now he has many friends.
phrases.ex: 雖然害羞（although），他仍「努力」每天跟新同學說話，結果交到很多朋友。
dist: make a fuss：小題大作；語意不通
make a face：扮鬼臉；不能接 to 表目的
make a living：謀生；與交朋友無關

phrases.stem: While waiting at the busy train station, I suddenly ____ an old friend I hadn't seen for ten years and ran over to say hello.
phrases.zh: catch sight of：突然看見、瞥見
phrases.ex: ran over to say hello 表示我「看見」老朋友才跑過去打招呼。
dist: lost sight of：看不見了、忽略；方向相反
made fun of：取笑；與跑去打招呼不合
took charge of：負責、掌管；語意不通

phrases.stem: Busy with work and money, many parents ____ what really matters: spending time with their children while they are still young.
phrases.zh: lose sight of：忽略、忘記（重要的事）
phrases.ex: 忙於工作與金錢，父母「忽略」了真正重要的事。
dist: catch sight of：看見；方向相反
get rid of：擺脫；父母不會想擺脫陪伴孩子這件重要的事，與 busy 的因果不合
make fun of：取笑；語意不通

phrases.stem: In many offices, video meetings have ____ business trips, saving companies both time and money.
phrases.ex: 視訊會議「取代」出差，因此替公司省下時間和金錢。
dist: taken advantage of：利用；會議不會利用出差
taken care of：照顧、處理；語意不通
taken part in：參加；語意不通

phrases.stem: Good sleep ____ students' success at school; those who sleep well often remember what they learn better.
phrases.zh: play a part in：在…中扮演角色、有影響
phrases.ex: 睡得好的人記得更牢，可見睡眠對學業成功「有影響」。
dist: makes fun of：取笑；語意不通
gets rid of：擺脫；睡眠不是擺脫成功
runs out of：用完；語意不通

phrases.stem: Talking about climate change is not enough; we need to ____ now, such as using less plastic and taking the bus.
phrases.ex: 「光說不夠」與後面的具體作法對比，表示要「採取行動」。
dist: take a seat：坐下；語意不通
take a break：休息；與要做事相反
take a look：看一看；仍只是觀察，不合「不只說」

phrases.stem: At first Amy could only say "hello" in Japanese, but after six months of practice she has ____ and can now order food on her own.
phrases.ex: 從只會說 hello 到能自己點餐，表示她「進步」了。
dist: made a fortune：發大財；與學語言無關
made a mistake：犯錯；與能點餐相反
made a scene：當眾吵鬧；語意不通

phrases.stem: The old letters found in the attic may ____ the mystery of why the famous writer suddenly left the city in 1920.
phrases.ex: 舊信件可能「揭開」作家突然離城之謎。
dist: turn a blind eye to：視而不見；信件不會無視
make room for：騰出空間給…；語意不通
keep an eye on：留意、看守；語意不通

phrases.stem: Working parents often find it hard to ____ between their jobs and family life, as both need a lot of time and energy.
phrases.zh: strike a balance (between A and B)：在A與B之間取得平衡
phrases.ex: 工作與家庭都需要時間精力，所以難以「取得平衡」。
dist: take a chance：冒險一試；不接 between A and B
make a point：提出論點；語意不通
take a stand：表明立場；語意不通

phrases.stem: After losing his office job, Mr. Chen ____ by selling bread he baked at home at the night market.
phrases.ex: 失業後靠賣自製麵包「維持生計」。
dist: made a face：扮鬼臉；語意不通
made a wish：許願；與賣麵包無關
made a fuss：小題大作；語意不通

phrases.stem: Dress neatly and arrive early for the interview; you only have one chance to ____ on the manager.
phrases.zh: make a good impression (on)：給（某人）留下好印象
phrases.ex: 穿著整齊、提早到，是為了給經理「留下好印象」，且只有 impression 能接 on 某人。
dist: make a big mistake：犯大錯；與準備周到相反
make a quick decision：快速做決定；不接 on 人
make a strong effort：努力；不接 on 人

phrases.stem: The new bus line has ____ local shops; many of them have seen twice as many customers since it opened.
phrases.zh: have an impact on：對…有影響
phrases.ex: 開通後顧客多了一倍，可見新公車路線對商店「影響很大」。
dist: kept a close eye on：密切注意；公車路線不會注意商店
put a stop to：制止；顧客反而增加
made a fuss about：對…小題大作；語意不通

phrases.stem: Marie Curie ____ science through her research, which later helped doctors around the world treat cancer and save countless lives.
phrases.zh: make a contribution to：對…有貢獻
phrases.ex: 她的研究後來幫助醫生治療癌症，表示她對科學「貢獻很大」。
dist: paid little attention to：不太注意；與研究成就相反
put an end to：終結；她沒有終結科學
turned her back on：背棄；方向相反

phrases.stem: The city has decided to ____ illegal parking on this street by putting up cameras and giving out heavy fines.
phrases.zh: put an end to：終止、結束
phrases.ex: 裝攝影機、重罰是為了「杜絕」違規停車。
dist: make room for：騰出空間給…；與罰款方向相反
pay a visit to：拜訪；語意不通
give birth to：生出、產生；方向相反

phrases.stem: When the long summer vacation finally ____, the students had to get used to waking up early again.
phrases.ex: 暑假「結束」，所以學生得重新習慣早起。
dist: came into being：產生、形成；暑假不是新出現的事物
came in handy：派上用場；語意不通
came to light：被揭露；語意不通

phrases.stem: The new law was passed in March, but it will not ____ until January, so drivers still have time to prepare.
phrases.ex: 三月通過、一月才「生效」，所以駕駛還有時間準備。
dist: take shape：成形；法律已通過，不是在成形
take place：發生、舉行；法律不說「舉行」

phrases.stem: The old cinema was torn down to ____ a new library, which will open next spring.
phrases.zh: make way for：讓路給、為…騰出位置
phrases.ex: 拆舊戲院是為新圖書館「騰出位置」。
dist: make fun of：取笑；語意不通
make use of：利用；拆掉後無法利用舊戲院，且受詞是圖書館也不通
make up for：彌補；新圖書館不是彌補的對象

phrases.stem: Moving all these boxes by myself will take hours. Could you ____ and carry some of them to the car?
phrases.zh: lend sb a hand：幫某人一把
phrases.ex: 自己搬很久，請對方「幫忙」搬到車上。
dist: catch my eye：吸引我的目光；語意不通
give me a call：打電話給我；不是請人搬東西
pull my leg：開我玩笑；語意不通

phrases.stem: Jack promised to pay me back by Friday, and he ____; the money was in my account on Thursday night.
phrases.ex: 週四晚上錢就到帳，表示他「守信」。
dist: broke his word：食言；方向相反
lost his temper：發脾氣；語意不通
changed his mind：改變主意；但錢準時到了

phrases.stem: The firefighters ____ to save the people trapped in the building, working through the night without rest.
phrases.ex: 整夜不休息救人，表示消防員「不遺餘力」。
dist: made no sense：沒道理；語意不通
took no notice：不理會；方向相反
had no idea：不知道；語意不通

phrases.stem: The parents ____ to find a doctor for their sick son, even flying to three different countries.
phrases.zh: go to great lengths：竭盡全力、費盡心思
phrases.ex: 甚至飛到三個國家找醫生，表示父母「竭盡全力」。
dist: went out of business：倒閉；語意不通
went out of fashion：退流行；語意不通
went into detail：詳細說明；不是找醫生的行動

phrases.stem: New evidence has ____ the man's story; a camera shows he was not at home that night as he claimed.
phrases.ex: 監視器顯示他不在家，與他的說法矛盾，使人「懷疑」他的說詞。
dist: shed tears over：為…流淚；證據不會哭
laid stress on：強調；語意不通
set foot on：踏上；語意不通

phrases.stem: Our cat ____ five kittens in a box under the stairs last night, and they are all healthy.
phrases.ex: 小貓昨晚出生且都健康，是母貓「生下」小貓。
dist: gave way to：讓位給、被…取代；語意不通
gave rise to：引起、導致；用於事件，不用於動物生產
gave in to：向…屈服；語意不通

phrases.stem: Wash your hands carefully with soap after you ____ wild animals, since they may carry diseases that spread to humans.
phrases.ex: 野生動物可能帶病，所以「接觸」後要洗手。
dist: come up with：想出；語意不通
come down with：染上（病）；後面接疾病，不接動物
come across as：給人…的印象；語意不通

phrases.stem: Instead of blaming his team, the manager ____ the failed project and apologized to the customers himself.
phrases.ex: 不怪團隊（instead of blaming）、自己道歉，表示經理「承擔責任」。
dist: took pride in：以…為傲；失敗的計畫不會令人驕傲
took advantage of：利用；語意不通
took the place of：取代；語意不通

phrases.stem: Our team was behind for most of the game, but we ____ in the last minute with a beautiful goal and won.
phrases.zh: take the lead：取得領先；帶頭
phrases.ex: 原本落後（behind），最後一分鐘進球而獲勝，表示「取得領先」。
dist: took a break：休息；最後一分鐘不會休息

phrases.stem: Indoor rock climbing has ____ in Taiwan in recent years; new climbing gyms are opening in almost every city.
phrases.ex: 各城市不斷開新攀岩館，表示攀岩「越來越受歡迎」。
dist: gained weight：體重增加；字面陷阱
lost its way：迷路；語意不通

phrases.stem: Many children in poor areas do not ____ clean water and must walk for hours every day to get it.
phrases.zh: have access to：能取得、能使用
phrases.ex: 每天要走好幾小時取水，表示他們「無法取得」乾淨的水。
dist: have a say in：對…有發言權；語意不通
have an eye for：對…有眼光；語意不通
have a word with：和…談一談；對象須是人

phrases.stem: Ryan stayed up every night playing video games, and he ____ it when he failed three of his final exams.
phrases.zh: pay the price for：為…付出代價
phrases.ex: 熬夜打電動導致三科不及格，是「付出代價」。
dist: made up for：彌補；不及格不是彌補
paid attention to：注意；語意不通
took credit for：把功勞歸於自己；與不及格不合

phrases.stem: Nobody asked Ken to clean the classroom, but he ____ and organized a cleaning team by himself.
phrases.ex: 沒人要求（nobody asked），他卻自己組隊打掃，是「主動」。
dist: took a back seat：退居幕後；方向相反
took offense：生氣、被冒犯；語意不通
took a nap：小睡；語意不通

phrases.stem: After months of planning, the design for the new park is finally ____, and workers will start building next week.
phrases.ex: 規劃數月後設計「成形」，下週就要開工。
dist: taking sides：選邊站；設計不會選邊

phrases.stem: The belief that girls are bad at math has ____ in some cultures, and it is very hard to change.
phrases.ex: hard to change 表示這種觀念已「根深柢固」。
dist: taken place：發生、舉行；觀念不說舉行

phrases.stem: Film cameras almost disappeared twenty years ago, but they have ____ recently because young people love their old-fashioned look.
phrases.zh: make a comeback：重新流行、捲土重來
phrases.ex: but 轉折：幾乎消失，但因年輕人喜愛而「重新流行」。
dist: gone out of fashion：退流行；方向相反
made a mistake：犯錯；語意不通
come to an end：結束；方向相反

phrases.stem: The movie's ticket sales ____ expectations; it earned only half of what the studio had hoped.
phrases.zh: fall short of：未達到（期望、標準）
phrases.ex: 只賺到預期的一半，表示票房「未達」預期。
dist: lived up to：達到、不辜負；方向相反
made up for：彌補；語意不通
kept up with：跟上；語意不通

phrases.stem: The World Wide Web ____ in the early 1990s, when the first websites appeared online.
phrases.ex: 第一批網站出現時，全球資訊網「誕生」了。
dist: came to an end：結束；方向相反
came down with：染上（病）；語意不通
came up against：遭遇（困難）；後面須接受詞

phrases.stem: Always keep a small umbrella in your bag; it may ____ when the weather suddenly changes.
phrases.ex: 天氣突變時雨傘會「派上用場」。
dist: come to light：被揭露；語意不通
come of age：成年；語意不通
come into force：（法律）生效；用於法規

phrases.stem: The truth about the company's secret deal only ____ after a worker shared some emails with reporters.
phrases.ex: 員工把信件交給記者後，真相才「曝光」。
dist: came in handy：派上用場；真相不是工具
came into force：生效；用於法律
came of age：成年；語意不通

phrases.stem: When the waiter brought the wrong dish for the third time, the customer finally ____ and started shouting.
phrases.ex: 第三次送錯菜，客人終於「發脾氣」大吼。
dist: kept his temper：忍住脾氣；與大吼相反
lost his way：迷路；語意不通

phrases.stem: Years of working night shifts have ____ her health; she now often feels tired and gets sick easily.
phrases.zh: take a toll on：對…造成損害
phrases.ex: 常疲倦、容易生病，可見夜班「損害」了她的健康。
dist: taken care of：照顧；方向相反
taken part in：參加；語意不通
taken pride in：以…為傲；語意不通

phrases.stem: After hours of discussion, the two companies finally ____ and signed the contract the next morning.
phrases.ex: 隔天就簽約，表示雙方「達成協議」。
dist: reached a dead end：陷入僵局；與簽約相反
made a fuss：小題大作；語意不通
took sides：選邊站；兩家公司是談判雙方

phrases.stem: With only five people in the survey, it is too early to ____ about what most students think.
phrases.ex: 只調查五人，太早「下結論」說多數學生的想法。
dist: draw the line：劃清界線；語意不通
make an excuse：找藉口；語意不通
take a chance：冒險；不接 about 想法

phrases.stem: My grandfather ____ walking for an hour every morning, even when it rains or when he feels a little tired.
phrases.zh: make a point of V-ing：特意、堅持做…
phrases.ex: even when it rains 表示他「堅持」每天早上散步。
dist: makes fun of：取笑；語意不通
makes use of：利用；不合散步習慣
makes sense of：理解；語意不通

phrases.stem: I meant to stay calm during the argument, but my anger ____ me and I said something I later regretted.
phrases.zh: get the better of：（情緒）戰勝、壓倒某人
phrases.ex: 本想冷靜，但（but）怒氣「壓過」了我，說出後悔的話。
dist: got rid of：擺脫；怒氣沒有擺脫我
got in touch with：聯絡；語意不通
got used to：習慣；語意不通

phrases.stem: Your grades ____ how expensive your notebook is; what really matters is how hard you study.
options: have a lot in common with
phrases.zh: have nothing to do with：與…無關
phrases.ex: 真正重要的是用功程度，所以成績與筆記本貴不貴「無關」。
dist: have a lot in common with：與…有很多共同點；語意不通
take the place of：取代；語意不通
keep pace with：跟上；語意不通

phrases.stem: According to one study, people who sleep less than five hours a night are more ____ catching colds.
phrases.zh: be prone to：易於…、有…的傾向（多指不好的事）
phrases.ex: 睡太少的人「比較容易」感冒。
dist: devoted to：致力於；感冒不是被致力的事

phrases.stem: Computers that never update their software are ____ attacks from hackers, so turn on automatic updates.
phrases.ex: 不更新的電腦「容易受」駭客攻擊，所以要開自動更新。
dist: immune to：不受…影響；方向相反

phrases.stem: The man's story was not ____ what the witnesses said, so the police began to doubt him.
phrases.ex: 警方開始懷疑，因為他的說法和證人「不一致」。
dist: familiar with：熟悉；故事不會熟悉證詞

phrases.stem: I am ____ believe her story, because she has always been honest with me, even when the truth was hard to hear.
phrases.zh: be inclined to V：傾向於、有意…
phrases.ex: 她一向誠實，所以我「傾向於」相信她。
dist: lucky to：有幸…；與相信她的理由無關

phrases.stem: Having grown up in Canada, Lucy was not ____ the hot and wet summers in Taipei and felt sick for weeks.
phrases.ex: 在加拿大長大，「不習慣」台北濕熱的夏天。
dist: opposed to：反對；天氣不是可以反對的事

phrases.stem: Many tourists are ____ local customs, so they sometimes act rudely without meaning to and upset the people living there.
phrases.zh: be ignorant of：不知道、對…無知
phrases.ex: without meaning to（無意間）失禮，是因為「不懂」當地習俗。
dist: tired of：厭倦；不合無意間失禮

phrases.stem: After a month of construction noise every morning, Ben was so ____ it that he finally moved out.
phrases.zh: be fed up with：受夠了、厭煩
phrases.ex: 噪音一個月，最後搬走，表示他「受夠了」。
dist: familiar with：熟悉；不會因此搬走
impressed with：對…印象深刻；語意不通

phrases.stem: Only students with an average grade above 85 are ____ the scholarship, so Tom's 80 was not enough.
phrases.ex: 85 分以上才「有資格」，所以 80 分不夠。
dist: responsible for：負責；學生不負責獎學金
grateful for：感謝；與資格門檻不合

phrases.stem: Lisa started doing yoga to help her ____ the stress of preparing for the college entrance exam.
phrases.zh: cope with：應付、處理（困難、壓力）
phrases.ex: 做瑜伽是為了「應付」考試壓力。
dist: make up with：與…和好；對象是人
come up with：想出；壓力不是被想出來的
catch up with：趕上；語意不通

phrases.stem: Whenever Kevin has a problem he can't solve, he always ____ his older sister for advice.
phrases.zh: turn to sb (for help)：向某人求助
phrases.ex: for advice 表示遇到難題時「求助於」姊姊。
dist: turns up：出現；不接人當受詞求建議

phrases.stem: Many farmers in the area ____ rain to water their crops, so a dry year can be a disaster for them.
phrases.ex: 乾旱年會造成災難，表示農民「依賴」雨水灌溉。
dist: call on：拜訪；號召；語意不通
turn on：打開（電器）；語意不通

phrases.stem: Our group is still ____ the science project, and we hope to finish it before Friday.
phrases.ex: still 與 hope to finish 表示報告「還在進行中」。
dist: looking up to：尊敬；對象是人
getting over：從…中恢復；語意不通

phrases.stem: Old batteries should not be thrown in the trash can; you should ____ them at special recycling points.
phrases.ex: 不能丟垃圾桶，應在回收點「處理掉」舊電池。
dist: run out of：用完；語意不通
think highly of：重視、看重；語意不通
make fun of：取笑；語意不通

phrases.stem: Jenny has ____ a job at the bank and is now waiting to be called for an interview.
phrases.zh: apply for：申請（工作、獎學金等）
phrases.ex: 等待面試通知，表示她已「應徵」銀行工作。
dist: cared for：照顧；喜歡；語意不通
fallen for：愛上；受騙；語意不通
asked after：問候（某人）；語意不通

phrases.stem: Before the camping trip, we ____ a list of everything we needed to bring so that we wouldn't forget anything.
phrases.zh: draw up：草擬、擬定（清單、計畫）
phrases.ex: 為了不忘東西，事先「列出」清單。

phrases.stem: Before the speech contest, Amy ____ her speech several times in front of the mirror to make sure she remembered every line.
phrases.zh: run through：排練、從頭到尾演練一遍
phrases.ex: 在鏡子前練好幾遍，是「排練」演講稿。
dist: ran into：偶遇；撞上；語意不通
ran away with：帶著…逃走；語意不通
ran across：偶然發現；不合練好幾遍

phrases.stem: When everyone laughed at the new student's accent, Sam ____ him and told the others to stop.
phrases.zh: stand up for：支持、挺身捍衛
phrases.ex: 叫其他人停止取笑，表示 Sam「挺身維護」新同學。
dist: looked down on：看不起；方向相反
made fun of：取笑；方向相反
stood in for：代替（某人）；字面相近但語意不同

phrases.stem: While my parents are away on business, I have to ____ my little brother and cook dinner for him.
phrases.ex: 父母不在，要「照顧」弟弟、幫他煮飯。
dist: look up to：尊敬；語意不通
look back on：回顧；語意不通

phrases.stem: Don't ____ your past mistakes for too long; learn what you can from them and then move forward with your life.
phrases.zh: dwell on：老是想著、耿耿於懷
phrases.ex: for too long 與 move forward 對比，勸人別「一直糾結」過去的錯。
dist: look up to：尊敬；錯誤不值得尊敬
pick up：撿起；學會；語意不通

phrases.stem: We should finish painting the outside of the house before the rainy season ____ in May.
phrases.zh: set in：（季節、壞天氣等）開始並持續
phrases.ex: 五月梅雨季「開始」前要漆完外牆。
dist: sets off：出發；引爆；季節不出發
sets aside：撥出、存下；語意不通

phrases.stem: The night market offers ____ foods, from stinky tofu and fried chicken to bubble tea and fresh fruit.
phrases.zh: a wide range of：各式各樣的、範圍廣泛的
phrases.ex: from A to B 列舉多種食物，表示選擇「多樣」。
dist: a shortage of：短缺；與列出許多食物矛盾
a lack of：缺乏；方向相反
a waste of：浪費；語意不通

phrases.stem: Writing a novel takes ____ time and patience; some writers spend more than ten years on a single book.
phrases.zh: a great deal of：大量的（接不可數名詞）
phrases.ex: 有作家花十年以上寫一本書，表示需要「大量」時間與耐心。
dist: a small amount of：少量；方向相反
a waste of：浪費；takes a waste of 不通

phrases.stem: In the survey, ____ students, about 80 percent, said they use their phones right before going to bed.
phrases.ex: 80 percent 是「大多數」。
dist: a handful of：少數幾個；方向相反
a minority of：少數；方向相反
the absence of：缺少；語意不通

phrases.stem: Joining the school band gave the new student ____; for the first time, she felt she was really part of a group.
phrases.ex: felt she was really part of a group 就是「歸屬感」。
dist: a sense of humor：幽默感；語意不通
a sense of direction：方向感；字面陷阱
a sense of loss：失落感；方向相反

phrases.stem: Only ____ people came to the concert because of the heavy rain, so the band played to an almost empty hall.
phrases.zh: a handful of：少數幾個、一小撮
phrases.ex: Only 與 almost empty hall 表示只有「少數幾個」人來。
dist: a large number of：大量；與空蕩蕩矛盾
the majority of：大多數；與 only 不合
a wide variety of：各式各樣；語意不通

phrases.stem: The museum's website offers ____ information about Taiwan's history, including old maps, photos, and videos.
phrases.zh: a wealth of：大量的、豐富的
phrases.ex: including 列出地圖、照片、影片，表示資料「豐富」。
dist: a lack of：缺乏；方向相反
a shortage of：短缺；方向相反
a matter of：…的問題；語意不通

phrases.stem: Many plants in the garden died last summer because of ____ water during the long dry season.
phrases.ex: 長期乾季導致植物死亡，是因為「缺水」。
dist: a great deal of：大量；方向相反
a wealth of：豐富的；方向相反
a variety of：各種各樣；語意不通

phrases.stem: Arguing with him is ____ time; he never changes his mind no matter what you say.
phrases.ex: 他從不改變想法，所以跟他爭論是「浪費」時間。
dist: a matter of：…的問題；a matter of time 是「遲早的事」，與此不合
a series of：一連串；語意不通

phrases.stem: Regular practice is ____ playing a musical instrument well; talent alone is not enough if you never spend time practicing.
phrases.ex: 光靠天分不夠，規律練習才是彈好樂器的「關鍵」。
dist: an obstacle to：…的障礙；方向相反
a threat to：…的威脅；方向相反
the opposite of：…的相反；語意不通

phrases.stem: ____ the strong earthquake, engineers checked hundreds of buildings to make sure they were still safe to live in.
phrases.zh: in the wake of：在…之後；緊接著…
phrases.ex: still safe 表示是地震「之後」檢查建築。
dist: Ahead of：在…之前；地震前無法得知是否「仍然」安全
In the name of：以…之名；語意不通
On behalf of：代表；語意不通

phrases.stem: The city is ____ building a new subway line, which should be finished by 2030 and will connect the airport to downtown.
phrases.zh: in the process of：正在…的過程中
phrases.ex: 預計 2030 年完工，表示城市「正在」興建捷運。
dist: in the habit of：有…的習慣；蓋捷運不是習慣
in danger of：有…的危險；語意不通
in memory of：紀念；語意不通

phrases.stem: Trust is ____ every good friendship; without it, friends cannot feel safe enough to share their true feelings with each other.
phrases.zh: at the heart of：在…的核心
phrases.ex: 沒有信任就無法分享感受，所以信任是友誼的「核心」。
dist: at the mercy of：任由…擺布；語意不通
at the cost of：以…為代價；語意不通
at the risk of：冒著…的風險；語意不通

phrases.stem: Students are chosen for the special science program ____ their grades and test scores, not their family background or wealth.
phrases.zh: on the basis of：根據、以…為基礎
phrases.ex: 依「成績」而非家庭背景挑選，是「根據」成績。
dist: on behalf of：代表；語意不通
in place of：取代；語意不通
at the mercy of：任由擺布；語意不通

phrases.stem: Some factories grow quickly ____ the environment, polluting nearby rivers and air just to save a little money.
phrases.zh: at the expense of：以犧牲…為代價
phrases.ex: 污染河川來省錢，是「犧牲」環境換取成長。
dist: in harmony with：與…和諧；方向相反
for the sake of：為了…的利益；與污染矛盾
in honor of：為紀念、向…致敬；語意不通

phrases.stem: Instead of giving out extra money, the company rewards its hard-working staff ____ extra vacation days at the end of the year.
phrases.zh: in the form of：以…的形式
phrases.ex: Instead of giving out extra money 說明獎勵「以」額外假期「的形式」發放。
dist: in danger of：有…的危險；語意不通
in the hope of：希望…；公司不是希望得到假期
at the mercy of：任由擺布；語意不通

phrases.stem: He moved to Taipei ____ finding a better job, but life in the big city turned out to be harder than he expected.
phrases.zh: in the hope of：懷著…的希望、希望能…
phrases.ex: 搬到台北是「希望」找到更好的工作，but 後說結果不如預期。
dist: in place of：代替；語意不通
in spite of：儘管；找工作不是讓步
in danger of：有…的危險；找到好工作不是危險

phrases.stem: A statue was put up in the town square ____ the doctor who saved hundreds of lives during the war.
phrases.zh: in honor of：為紀念、向…致敬
phrases.ex: 為救了數百人的醫生立雕像，是「紀念」他。
dist: in search of：尋找；語意不通
in favor of：贊成；語意不通
in charge of：負責；雕像不負責醫生

phrases.stem: Nurses are highly ____ in many countries, so it is easy for them to find well-paid jobs.
phrases.ex: 容易找到工作，表示護理師很「搶手」。

phrases.stem: Since winning the gold medal, the young athlete has been ____, with reporters following her wherever she goes.
phrases.zh: in the spotlight：成為眾人注目的焦點
phrases.ex: 記者到處跟著她，表示她成了「焦點」。
dist: in the dark：被蒙在鼓裡；字面陷阱
in the way：擋路；語意不通
out of sight：看不見；方向相反

phrases.stem: The baseball game was put off ____ the heavy rain, and it will be played next Sunday instead.
phrases.ex: 大雨是比賽延期的「原因」。
dist: on top of：除了…之外還；在…上面；語意不通
on behalf of：代表；語意不通
in favor of：贊成；語意不通

phrases.stem: Every winter, birds from colder countries arrive in southern Taiwan ____, sometimes more than 3,000 at a time.
phrases.zh: in large numbers：大量地、成群地
phrases.ex: 一次超過三千隻，表示「大量」飛來。
dist: in short supply：供應不足；方向相反
in a row：連續；不是數量多

phrases.stem: Rice is grown ____ in this area; huge farms cover almost the whole plain, and machines do most of the work.
phrases.zh: on a large scale：大規模地
phrases.ex: 巨大農田覆蓋整個平原，表示「大規模」種植。
dist: on a diet：在節食；字面陷阱
on the spot：當場；語意不通

phrases.stem: Thousands of young people leave their hometowns every year ____ better jobs in big cities.
phrases.ex: 離鄉到大城市是為了「追求」更好的工作。
dist: in spite of：儘管；語意不通
instead of：而不是；與離鄉找工作矛盾
in charge of：負責；語意不通

phrases.stem: The little boy is shy and hardly ever talks ____ strangers, but at home he is very lively.
phrases.ex: 害羞，在陌生人「面前」不說話；but 對比在家很活潑。
dist: in the absence of：在…不在時；方向相反
in place of：代替；語意不通
in favor of：贊成；語意不通

phrases.stem: Never drive ____ alcohol; even one drink can slow down your reactions on the road.
phrases.zh: under the influence of：受…的影響（酒後駕車常用）
phrases.ex: 一杯酒就會讓反應變慢，所以不要「受酒精影響」時開車。
dist: in the absence of：沒有…時；方向相反
for the sake of：為了；語意不通
in the hope of：希望；語意不通

phrases.stem: Since she moved to the countryside, her health has changed ____; she sleeps well and rarely gets sick.
phrases.ex: 睡得好又很少生病，表示健康「好轉」。
dist: for the worse：變糟；方向相反

phrases.stem: ____, the bus is late during rush hour, so I usually leave home ten minutes early.
phrases.zh: more often than not：常常、多半
phrases.ex: 公車「常常」誤點，所以我通常提早出門。
dist: Once in a blue moon：極少；與通常提早出門不合
All of a sudden：突然；與習慣性的情況不合
By no means：絕不；語意不通

phrases.stem: The hotel room was small and the food was just OK, but ____, we had a wonderful trip.
phrases.zh: all in all：總而言之、整體來說
phrases.ex: 雖有小缺點，但「整體而言」旅程很棒。
dist: all of a sudden：突然；語意不通
by no means：絕不；與 wonderful 矛盾

phrases.stem: He rushed all the way to the station, ____ find that the last train had already left.
phrases.zh: only to V：（出乎意料、令人失望的結果）結果卻…
phrases.ex: 一路趕到車站，「結果卻」發現末班車已開走。
dist: so as to：為了；他不是為了發現車開走
in order to：為了；同上，目的不合
as if to：彷彿要；語意不通

phrases.stem: She spoke in a very low voice ____ waking the baby sleeping in the next room.
phrases.ex: 小聲說話是「以免」吵醒寶寶。
dist: for the sake of：為了；方向相反
in the hope of：希望；方向相反
in charge of：負責；語意不通

phrases.stem: ____ he had only two weeks to prepare, his performance in the play was surprisingly good.
phrases.ex: 「考慮到」只準備兩週，表現好得令人意外（surprisingly）。
dist: Now that：既然；與 surprisingly 的語氣不合
So that：以便；不能放句首表原因

phrases.stem: ____, the students enjoyed the school trip to Hualien, though a few of them complained about the long bus ride.
phrases.zh: by and large：大體上、整體而言
phrases.ex: though 少數人抱怨，但「大體上」學生都很喜歡。
dist: By no means：絕不；與 enjoyed 矛盾
By accident：意外地、偶然；語意不通
By the way：順帶一提；用於轉換話題

phrases.stem: The restaurant is open every day ____ Mondays, so let's go there on Tuesday instead.
phrases.ex: 改週二去（instead），表示週一「除外」不營業。
dist: as well as：以及；包含而非排除
along with：連同；包含而非排除
together with：和…一起；包含而非排除

phrases.stem: ____ last year, the number of tourists visiting the island has doubled this year, thanks to the new direct flights.
phrases.ex: doubled 是今年「與去年相比」的結果。

phrases.stem: ____, I don't eat anything after nine at night, but I made an exception for my best friend's birthday party last week.
phrases.zh: as a rule：通常、一般而言
phrases.ex: 「通常」九點後不吃，but 生日派對是例外。
dist: As a result：結果；前面沒有原因
As a whole：整體而言；用於指整體事物
As opposed to：與…相對；後面須接名詞，語意也不通

phrases.stem: We can argue about the details, but ____, what really matters is whether the plan helps our customers.
options: at the end of the day
at the drop of a hat
on the tip of my tongue
phrases.zh: at the end of the day：說到底、歸根究柢
phrases.ex: 細節可以爭論，但「說到底」重點是能否幫助顧客。
dist: at the drop of a hat：立刻、毫不猶豫；語意不通
out of the blue：突然、意外地；語意不通
on the tip of my tongue：話到嘴邊；語意不通

phrases.stem: Although many people criticized his plan, the mayor refused to ____ and insisted that the new road would still be built.
phrases.ex: insisted ... would still be built 說明市長堅持立場，「不肯讓步」。

phrases.stem: Please ____ me for a few minutes while I look for your order in our computer system.
phrases.ex: while I look for your order 說明請對方「稍候、包涵」幾分鐘。
dist: deal with：處理；不會請客人「處理我」

phrases.stem: After years of selling only books, the small store decided to ____ into toys and stationery to attract more customers.
phrases.ex: 從只賣書到加賣玩具與文具，是「拓展」新領域。

phrases.stem: I ____ my old math teacher at the supermarket yesterday; I hadn't seen her since I graduated.
phrases.ex: 在超市、畢業後就沒見過，說明是「巧遇」。

phrases.stem: She got so angry on the phone that she ____ before I could explain what had happened.
phrases.ex: on the phone 與 before I could explain 表示她氣得「掛電話」。

phrases.stem: My father was against my plan to study abroad at first, but he finally ____ after I showed him the scholarship details.
phrases.ex: at first ... but finally 表轉折：從反對到「回心轉意」。

phrases.stem: The two sisters promised that nothing, not even money, would ever ____ them.
phrases.zh: come between：離間、介入（兩人之間）
phrases.ex: not even money 說明任何事都不能「破壞她們的感情」。

phrases.stem: The police have promised to ____ drunk driving by stopping and checking more cars on weekends.
phrases.ex: 警方增設臨檢站，是要「嚴格取締」酒駕。
dist: get down to：開始認真處理

phrases.stem: Since prices keep rising, my family has had to ____ eating out and cook at home more often.
phrases.ex: 物價上漲、多在家煮，所以「減少」外食。
dist: fall back on：依靠（後備）；與在家煮矛盾

phrases.stem: The meeting ____ for nearly four hours, and by the end everyone was tired and hungry.
phrases.ex: 近四小時、大家又累又餓，表示會議「冗長拖延」。

phrases.stem: My brother and his best friend from high school slowly ____ after they went to colleges in different cities.
phrases.ex: slowly 與 different cities 表示兩人「漸行漸遠」。
dist: got together：聚在一起（方向相反）
made up：和好；前提是吵架，句中沒有

phrases.stem: The loud music from the party next door ____ the sound of our TV, so we couldn't hear a word.
phrases.ex: couldn't hear a word 說明電視聲被音樂「蓋過」。
dist: made out：聽清楚、辨認出；主詞應為人

phrases.stem: As the sun went down, the sound of the children's laughter slowly ____ in the distance.
phrases.ex: slowly 與 in the distance 表示笑聲「漸漸消逝」。

phrases.stem: Eating well and getting enough sleep can help your body ____ colds and other diseases.
phrases.ex: 飲食與睡眠讓身體能「抵抗」感冒等疾病。

phrases.stem: As a new student, Amy worried that she would not ____ her classmates, but they welcomed her warmly.
phrases.ex: 新生擔心、但同學熱情歡迎，談的是能否「融入」。

phrases.stem: Stop ____ in the lab! Some of these chemicals are dangerous.
phrases.ex: 化學藥品危險，所以叫人別「胡鬧」。
dist: settling down：安定下來；沒必要阻止
coming around：改變心意；順道來訪

phrases.stem: Don't ____ at the sale and buy things you don't need just because they are cheap.
phrases.zh: get carried away：（太興奮而）失控、忘我
phrases.ex: 買不需要的東西只因便宜，就是「一時衝動、失控」。
dist: get put off：被延期；被弄得失去興趣

phrases.stem: Stop chatting and ____ your homework; it's already very late.
phrases.ex: 別再聊天、已經很晚了，所以要「繼續做」功課。
dist: get away with：（做壞事）逃過懲罰
get along with：與（人）相處融洽；受詞須為人

phrases.stem: Poor living conditions in the city ____ many health problems, as diseases spread quickly among the crowded population.
phrases.ex: 居住條件差使疾病快速傳播，表示「導致」健康問題。
dist: gave way to：被…取代；條件並未被取代

phrases.stem: The robber pointed a knife at the cashier and ordered her to ____ all the money.
phrases.ex: 搶匪拿刀威脅，要店員「交出」錢。
dist: hand in：繳交（作業、報告給上級）

phrases.stem: While taking a shower, the scientist suddenly ____ a simple solution to the problem that had troubled him for weeks.
phrases.ex: suddenly 與 solution 表示「靈光一閃想到」解法。

phrases.stem: The farmers decided to ____ planting the rice until the heavy rain stopped.
phrases.ex: until the heavy rain stopped 表示「暫緩」插秧。
dist: hold on：等一下；抓牢；不接動名詞

phrases.stem: Doctors advise people with weak lungs to ____ crowded places during the flu season.
phrases.ex: 肺不好、流感季，醫生建議「遠離」人多的地方。
dist: keep in touch with：與…保持聯絡

phrases.stem: She missed my phone call, so she sent me a message promising to ____ as soon as she got home.
phrases.ex: 漏接電話、到家就會「回電」。

phrases.stem: Because of his long illness, Kevin ____ the rest of the class in math and needed extra help.
phrases.ex: 久病、需要額外輔導，表示他「落後」同學。
dist: left behind：把…留下、甩在後面（意思相反，變成他超前）

phrases.stem: He attempted to ____ the rude comment as a joke, but deep down he was hurt.
phrases.ex: as a joke 與 but deep down he was hurt 對比：表面「一笑置之」。

phrases.stem: In the weeks ____ the final exam, the library was full of students every night.
phrases.zh: lead up to：（時間上）在…之前、逼近
phrases.ex: 期末考「前」幾週，圖書館每晚都滿。
dist: catching up on：補做、趕上（進度）；主詞不能是週

phrases.stem: After months of bad news, things are finally ____ for the company; sales rose by 20 percent last month.
phrases.ex: After months of bad news 與 sales rose 對比，表示情況「好轉」。

phrases.stem: The thief broke into the shop at night and ____ jewelry worth over a million dollars.
phrases.ex: 小偷闖入，接著「偷走」珠寶。

phrases.stem: The movie was good, but it didn't ____ the excellent book it was based on.
phrases.zh: measure up to：比得上、達到（標準）
phrases.ex: good, but ... excellent book 表示電影「比不上」原著。

phrases.stem: I was so nervous during the speech contest that I ____ the opening lines and had to start again.
phrases.ex: 太緊張、只好重來，表示開場白「搞砸了」。
dist: made up：編造；與重新開始無因果
gave up：放棄；但他又重新開始

phrases.stem: If you don't sign up by Friday, you will ____ the chance to visit the science museum for free.
phrases.ex: 沒在週五前報名，就會「錯過」免費參觀機會。
dist: hold on to：抓住、保留（方向相反）
take part in：參加；不報名卻能參加不合理

phrases.stem: The lecture was so boring that several students ____ in their seats.
phrases.ex: so boring that 表結果：學生「打瞌睡」。

phrases.stem: Every morning I ____ a small bakery on my way to school, and the smell of fresh bread is hard to resist.
phrases.ex: on my way to school 表示上學途中「經過」麵包店。

phrases.stem: It was a great job offer, and I couldn't believe that she ____ it just so she could stay in her hometown.
phrases.ex: couldn't believe 與 to stay in her hometown：她為了留在家鄉而「放棄」好機會。
dist: took up：接受（提議）；開始從事；與留在家鄉矛盾

phrases.stem: If you don't wash the dishes every day, they will ____ in the sink.
phrases.ex: 不每天洗碗，碗盤就會在水槽「堆積」。

phrases.stem: It's hard to ____ exactly why the machine stopped working, because many different parts could be the cause.
phrases.ex: many parts could be the cause 說明很難「確切找出」原因。

phrases.stem: The teacher used simple pictures to ____ her ideas to the young students.
phrases.ex: 用簡單圖片給小學生看，是為了「傳達」想法。

phrases.stem: The charity ____ families in need by offering them free meals and medical checks.
phrases.zh: reach out to：主動接觸、伸出援手
phrases.ex: 提供免費餐點與健檢，是對弱勢家庭「伸出援手」。
dist: keeps out of：避開、不介入（方向相反）

phrases.stem: Before visiting Japan, I ____ its history and customs so that I wouldn't be rude to the local people.
phrases.zh: read up on：（為某目的）大量閱讀、研讀
phrases.ex: 出發前為了不失禮，先「研讀」歷史與習俗。

phrases.stem: While cleaning the attic, I ____ some old photos of my grandfather.
phrases.ex: 打掃閣樓時「無意中翻到」舊照片。

phrases.stem: Because of a lack of money, the city had to ____ its plans for a new sports center and build only a small gym.
phrases.ex: build only a small gym 表示計畫「縮小規模」。

phrases.stem: We wanted to stay at a hotel by the beach, but it was fully booked, so we had to ____ a cheap one in town.
phrases.ex: 海邊旅館客滿，只好「退而求其次」住便宜的。
dist: settle down：安定下來；不接受詞

phrases.stem: On my first day at the new company, an older worker ____ and introduced me to everyone in the office.
phrases.ex: 第一天上班，老員工「帶我四處參觀」並介紹同事。
dist: let me down：讓我失望；與 friendly 矛盾

phrases.stem: Although the injury looked serious, the player ____ it and kept playing until the end of the game.
phrases.zh: shrug off：不在乎、不當一回事
phrases.ex: Although ... looked serious 與 kept playing 對比：他「不當一回事」。

phrases.stem: You have worked hard all week; now just ____ and enjoy the movie.
phrases.ex: 辛苦一週，現在就「放輕鬆」看電影。

phrases.stem: Please ____; the road is wet and there are children playing nearby.
phrases.ex: 路滑又有孩童，所以請「減速」。

phrases.stem: Since our English teacher is sick today, the music teacher will ____ her and teach our class.
phrases.ex: 英文老師生病，音樂老師「代課」。
dist: stand out from：從…中脫穎而出

phrases.stem: I ____ until three in the morning to finish my report, so I'm very sleepy now.
phrases.ex: 到凌晨三點、現在很睏，表示「熬夜」。
dist: woke up：醒來；不會持續到三點
gave up：放棄；與 to finish 矛盾

phrases.stem: Many of her health problems ____ years of poor sleep and too much stress.
phrases.ex: 健康問題是「結果」，睡不好與壓力是「原因」，所以用「源自」。
dist: result in：導致（因果方向相反）
lead to：導致（因果方向相反）

phrases.stem: The politician's speech ____ anger among farmers, who felt that their needs had been ignored.
phrases.zh: stir up：激起、引起（情緒、麻煩）
phrases.ex: 農民覺得被忽視，演講「激起」憤怒。

phrases.stem: Before the typhoon hit, people rushed to supermarkets to ____ water, rice, and instant noodles.
phrases.zh: stock up on：囤積、大量購買
phrases.ex: 颱風前衝去超市，是要「囤貨」。
dist: run out of：用完（方向相反）
catch up on：補做（睡眠、工作）

phrases.stem: The twins look so alike that even their teachers can hardly ____.
phrases.ex: 長得太像，老師也很難「分辨」。
dist: keep them apart：把他們隔開；與長得像無關

phrases.stem: The climbers had little food left, so they hoped they could ____ until the rescue team arrived.
phrases.ex: 食物所剩不多，希望能「撐到」救援抵達。

phrases.stem: My phone card is running low, so I need to ____ it before I make the call.
phrases.ex: running low（快用完）所以要「加值」。

phrases.stem: The speaker only ____ the problem of air pollution briefly and spent most of the time on water issues.
phrases.ex: only ... briefly 表示只「稍微提到」。
dist: focused on：專注於；與 briefly 矛盾

phrases.stem: Be careful not to ____ the wires on the floor; someone fell and got hurt last week.
phrases.ex: 地上電線、上週有人跌倒，提醒別「絆倒」。

phrases.stem: The new manager managed to ____ the failing company, and it made a profit within two years.
phrases.ex: failing company 兩年內獲利，表示經理「扭轉」頹勢。

phrases.stem: The constant noise from the construction site slowly ____ her, and she became tired and nervous.
phrases.ex: 持續噪音讓她又累又緊張，是被「慢慢消磨」。
dist: wore off：（效果）逐漸消退；不接人當受詞
broke down：故障；崩潰（不接受詞）

phrases.stem: Before choosing a university, you should ____ the good and bad points of each school carefully.
phrases.ex: 選大學前「權衡」各校優缺點。

phrases.stem: The singer was nervous at first, but her warm voice soon ____ the audience.
phrases.ex: nervous at first, but ... 表示後來「贏得」觀眾的心。

phrases.stem: Let's ____ the meeting now; we have already discussed everything on the list.
phrases.ex: 所有事項都討論完，所以「結束」會議。
dist: set up：安排、籌備（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The camera ____ the winner's face as tears of joy ran down her cheeks.
phrases.zh: zoom in on：（鏡頭）拉近特寫
phrases.ex: 拍到淚水流下，鏡頭「拉近」特寫臉部。

phrases.stem: When you cross the street in this area, ____ motorcycles; they often come out of nowhere.
phrases.ex: 機車常突然冒出，過馬路要「小心」。

phrases.stem: I have been meaning to clean my room for weeks, but I never ____ it.
phrases.zh: get around to：抽出時間去做
phrases.ex: 想了好幾週卻一直沒「抽空去做」。
dist: get rid of：擺脫、丟掉；房間不能丟掉

phrases.stem: The team ____ many difficulties when building the bridge, such as bad weather and a lack of workers.
phrases.ex: such as bad weather 列舉遭遇的「困難」。
dist: came up with：想出；不會想出困難

phrases.stem: She saved some money each month so that she would have something to ____ if she lost her job.
phrases.ex: 存錢是為了萬一失業時有「依靠」。

phrases.stem: He promised to help us move, but he ____ his word and never showed up.
phrases.zh: go back on (one's word)：食言、違背
phrases.ex: promised ... but never showed up 表示他「食言」。

phrases.stem: Before leaving the hotel, we have to ____ before noon and return the room key.
phrases.ex: 離開旅館、歸還房卡，是「退房」。
dist: check in：入住登記（方向相反）

phrases.stem: On her way to work, Mom ____ my little brother at school every morning.
phrases.zh: drop off：（開車）載某人到某處放下
phrases.ex: 上班途中每天早上把弟弟「送到」學校。

phrases.stem: His mother told him not to ____ seeing a dentist any longer, since the pain in his tooth was getting worse every day.
phrases.ex: not ... any longer 與 the pain was getting worse 表示不能再「拖延」看牙醫。

phrases.stem: Many workers in the small town had to ____ long hours and low pay because there were few other jobs they could find.
phrases.ex: because there were few other jobs 說明只能「忍受」長工時與低薪。
dist: look forward to：期待（不會期待低薪）

phrases.stem: Before going to sleep, the campers ____ their fire with sand and water so that it would not spread during the night.
phrases.ex: so that it would not spread 說明是「撲滅」營火。
dist: set up：架設（與防止延燒相反）
broke out：（火災）爆發，為不及物，不能接受詞

phrases.stem: The two teams decided to ____ their differences and work together to clean up the beach after the terrible storm.
phrases.zh: put aside：擱置（分歧）；（另一義）存錢
phrases.ex: work together 表示先把意見不合「擱在一邊」。

phrases.stem: Several students ____ the idea of a phone-free day at school, and the principal promised to think it over carefully.
phrases.ex: the principal promised to think it over 表示學生「提出」了提議。
dist: looked forward：期待（須接 to，且語意不合）

phrases.stem: He has ____ almost ten kilograms since he stopped playing basketball and started eating fast food every day.
phrases.zh: put on：（體重）增加；（另一義）穿上
phrases.ex: stopped playing basketball 加上 eating fast food 表示體重「增加」。
dist: taken off：脫下；（體重）減少，方向相反

phrases.stem: When our flight was canceled, a kind family in the village ____ my parents and me for the night and cooked us a hot meal.
phrases.zh: put up：讓人借住；（另一義）張貼
phrases.ex: flight was canceled 與 for the night 說明對方「收留我們過夜」。

phrases.stem: After the picnic, we ____ all the leftover food in the fridge so that it would stay fresh for lunch tomorrow.
phrases.ex: in the fridge 與 stay fresh 表示把食物「收起來」。
dist: put out：拿出來擺放；撲滅（方向相反）

phrases.stem: At the start of the test, the teacher asked us to ____ our names and student numbers at the top of the answer sheet.
phrases.ex: at the top of the answer sheet 表示「寫下」姓名學號。

phrases.stem: With her big brown eyes and quiet manner, the baby clearly ____ her grandmother rather than either of her parents.
phrases.ex: big brown eyes and quiet manner 指外貌個性「像」祖母。
dist: look after：照顧（嬰兒不會照顧祖母）

phrases.stem: After the coach was injured in a car accident, the team captain ____ the daily training for the rest of the season.
phrases.ex: the coach was injured 表示由隊長「接手」帶訓練。

phrases.stem: This old sofa ____ too much space in our small living room, so we are going to sell it and buy a smaller one.
phrases.zh: take up：佔據（空間、時間）；（另一義）開始從事
phrases.ex: too much space 表示沙發「佔用」太多空間。

phrases.stem: Because business was growing fast, the bakery decided to ____ three more workers before the busy holiday season.
phrases.ex: business was growing fast 表示要「雇用」更多人手。

phrases.stem: After the storm destroyed their home, the family was ____ by kind neighbors who let them stay for a whole month.
phrases.ex: who let them stay 說明鄰居「收留」他們。
dist: give up：放棄（與 kind neighbors 矛盾）

phrases.stem: Her small online cake shop really ____ after a famous singer posted photos of her cakes on social media.
phrases.zh: take off：（事業）突然走紅；（另一義）起飛
phrases.ex: after a famous singer posted photos 表示生意「爆紅」。

phrases.stem: After the festival ended, the workers spent the whole morning ____ the posters and flags hanging along the main street.
phrases.ex: After the festival ended 表示把海報旗子「拆下」。

phrases.stem: The shoes I bought online were too small for me, so I ____ the shoes to the store and got my money back.
phrases.zh: take back：退回（商品）；（另一義）收回（說過的話）
phrases.ex: too small 與 got my money back 表示「退貨」。

phrases.stem: To clean the electric fan properly, you have to ____ the whole fan first and wash each part in warm water.
phrases.ex: wash each part 表示要先把電扇「拆開」。
dist: take up：占用（空間、時間）；開始從事

phrases.stem: She was afraid of deep water as a child, but weekly swimming lessons slowly helped her ____ her fear.
phrases.zh: get over：克服；（從病痛、傷痛中）恢復
phrases.ex: but ... swimming lessons helped 表示「克服」恐懼。

phrases.stem: Since the new manager ____ his team so well, people rarely argue and the work always gets done on time.
phrases.ex: people rarely argue 表示經理和團隊「相處融洽」。
dist: look down on：瞧不起（與 rarely argue 不合）

phrases.stem: My Japanese is far from perfect, but I know enough to ____ when I travel and order food in restaurants.
phrases.ex: far from perfect, but I know enough 表示「勉強應付得來」。

phrases.stem: The poster uses very few words, but it ____ its message clearly: everyone should save water at home.
phrases.zh: get across：使（意思）被理解、傳達
phrases.ex: uses very few words, but ... clearly 表示有效「傳達」訊息。

phrases.stem: It took the family several weeks to ____ the mice that had moved into their kitchen during the winter.
phrases.ex: mice moved into their kitchen 表示要「除掉」老鼠。

phrases.stem: I called the hospital several times this morning, but the line was always busy and I never ____ to anyone.
phrases.zh: get through：（電話）接通；（另一義）熬過
phrases.ex: the line was always busy 表示電話始終「打不通」。

phrases.stem: If students ____ cheating once, they may start to believe they can do it again and again without being caught.
phrases.zh: get away with：（做壞事）逃過懲罰
phrases.ex: without being caught 表示作弊「沒被抓到」。

phrases.stem: I usually ____ work at six in the evening, so let's meet at the restaurant near my office at seven.
phrases.ex: at six ... meet at seven 表示六點「下班」。

phrases.stem: Let's ____ after the final exams and celebrate with a big dinner at the night market near our school.
phrases.ex: celebrate with a big dinner 表示大家「聚一聚」。
dist: put off：延期（後面須接受詞）

phrases.stem: Unable to pay for a trip abroad, the students ____ a much cheaper plan: camping by the lake for three days.
phrases.zh: come up with：想出（點子、計畫）
phrases.ex: a much cheaper plan 表示「想出」替代方案。

phrases.stem: Nearly half of the class ____ the flu last week, so the teacher decided to hold the test a week later.
phrases.ex: the flu 與考試延後表示學生「染上」流感。

phrases.stem: During the job interview, he ____ as honest and hard-working, so the company offered him the job the next day.
phrases.zh: come across (as)：給人…的印象；（另一義）偶然發現
phrases.ex: so the company offered him the job 表示他「給人」誠實勤奮的印象。

phrases.stem: Can you explain how this big change in your study habits ____? You used to hate reading, but now you read every day.
phrases.ex: how this big change ... 問改變是「怎麼發生」的。
dist: come up with：想出（須接受詞）

phrases.stem: The weather report said it would be sunny, but my worst fears ____: it rained all day while we were at the beach.
phrases.ex: my worst fears 加上 it rained all day 表示擔心的事「成真」。

phrases.stem: The truth finally ____ when a student found the missing money hidden in the bottom of a locker.
phrases.zh: come out：（真相）揭露；（另一義）出版、上市
phrases.ex: found the missing money 表示真相「水落石出」。
dist: come across：偶然發現（須接受詞）

phrases.stem: My cousin from Tainan will ____ for dinner tonight, so please clean your room before she arrives at six.
phrases.ex: for dinner tonight 與 before she arrives 表示表妹要「來家裡」。

phrases.stem: Your name ____ when we were talking about who should lead the school trip, and everyone thought you were the best choice.
phrases.zh: come up：被提及；（另一義）（問題）出現
phrases.ex: when we were talking about 表示名字在討論中「被提到」。

phrases.stem: How is your science project ____? If you need any help with the final report, just let me know.
phrases.zh: come along：進展；（另一義）一起來
phrases.ex: How is ... project 詢問專題「進展」如何。
