phrases.stem: The officer ____ my bag carefully at the airport, but he found nothing unusual and let me go.
phrases.zh: go through：仔細檢查；（另一義）經歷
phrases.ex: carefully ... found nothing unusual 表示「仔細檢查」行李。

phrases.stem: Before handing in her paper, Amy ____ every answer twice to look for careless mistakes.
phrases.ex: twice to look for careless mistakes 表示「檢查」答案。

phrases.stem: Not wanting to look different, Kevin ____ his friends' choice of movie, even though he hated horror films.
phrases.ex: Not wanting to look different 表示他「附和」朋友。

phrases.stem: Luckily, nobody was hurt when the bomb ____ in the empty parking lot late at night.
phrases.zh: go off：（炸彈）爆炸；（另一義）（鬧鐘）響
phrases.ex: the bomb 與 nobody was hurt 表示炸彈「爆炸」。

phrases.stem: Since it was raining heavily, we stayed home and cooked noodles instead of ____ for dinner.
phrases.ex: stayed home ... instead of 表示沒有「出門」吃晚餐。

phrases.stem: There was a lot of shouting outside, so I looked out of the window to see what was ____.
phrases.ex: to see what was ... 表示看看「發生」什麼事。

phrases.stem: Many people in poor areas have to ____ clean water, which causes serious health problems for their children.
phrases.ex: causes serious health problems 表示他們「沒有」乾淨的水。

phrases.stem: Every morning, a bus full of tourists ____ our house on its way to the lake in the mountains.
phrases.zh: go by：經過；（另一義）（時間）流逝
phrases.ex: on its way to the lake 表示巴士「經過」我家。

phrases.stem: The baseball game will ____ as planned this Sunday unless it starts to rain heavily before noon.
phrases.zh: go ahead：照常進行；（另一義）請便
phrases.ex: as planned ... unless it rains 表示比賽「照常舉行」。

phrases.stem: He stayed late at the office every night this week to ____ the time he lost while he was sick.
phrases.ex: the time he lost 表示要「彌補」生病損失的時間。

phrases.stem: Women ____ more than half of the workers at the factory, so the company opened a day care center for their children.
phrases.zh: make up：組成、佔（比例）；（另一義）編造
phrases.ex: more than half of the workers 表示女性「佔」一半以上。

phrases.stem: I really can't ____ why she suddenly left the birthday party without saying goodbye to anyone.
phrases.zh: make out：理解、弄懂；（另一義）看清
phrases.ex: I can't ... why 表示「搞不懂」原因。

phrases.stem: The hotel was almost full, so we had to ____ a small room with only one bed for the three of us.
phrases.ex: almost full ... only one bed 表示只好「將就」。

phrases.stem: Seeing dark clouds coming from the sea, the fishing boats ____ the harbor as quickly as they could.
phrases.ex: dark clouds coming 表示漁船趕緊「駛向」港口。

phrases.stem: After the argument, Lily wrote her sister a kind note to say sorry, and the two ____ before bedtime.
phrases.ex: wrote ... to say sorry 表示兩人「和好」。

phrases.stem: Only five of the hundred singers ____ to the final round of the contest, and Mia was one of them.
phrases.zh: make it：成功（做到、晉級）；（另一義）及時趕到
phrases.ex: Only five of the hundred 表示少數人「成功晉級」。
dist: give it：給它（不接 to the final round 表晉級）

phrases.stem: Please ____ you have your passport and ticket with you before you leave home for the airport.
phrases.ex: before you leave home 表示出門前「確認」帶了護照。

phrases.stem: Other children used to ____ his big round glasses, but now he wears them proudly to school every day.
phrases.ex: used to ... but now he wears them proudly 表示以前被「取笑」。

phrases.stem: The child cried loudly in the toy store, but his mother refused to ____ and buy him another toy car.
phrases.ex: refused to ... and buy 表示媽媽不肯「讓步」。

phrases.stem: After hours of questioning by the police, the tired man finally ____ and told them where he had hidden the money.
phrases.ex: After hours of questioning ... finally told 表示他終於「屈服」招供。

phrases.stem: The doctor advised him to ____ sugar for a month to see whether his skin problem would get better.
phrases.ex: for a month to see whether ... get better 表示暫時「戒掉」糖。

phrases.stem: The climbers had to ____ just two hundred meters from the top of the mountain because of a sudden snowstorm.
phrases.ex: because of a sudden snowstorm 表示被迫「放棄」攻頂。

phrases.stem: After running for almost three hours in the hot sun, my legs finally ____ and I had to sit down by the road.
phrases.zh: give out：（體力）耗盡；（另一義）分發
phrases.ex: had to sit down 表示雙腿「沒力」了。

phrases.stem: The old light bulb ____ only a weak yellow light, so we could hardly see the stairs at night.
phrases.ex: a weak yellow light 表示燈泡「發出」微弱的光。

phrases.stem: She tried hard to look calm on stage, but her shaking hands ____ how nervous she really was.
phrases.ex: tried to look calm, but ... shaking hands 表示發抖「洩露」了緊張。

phrases.stem: If you find a wallet on the street, you should try your best to ____ the wallet to its owner.
phrases.ex: to its owner 表示「還給」失主。
dist: give away：贈送；洩漏（不是歸還）

phrases.stem: In Taiwan, drivers must ____ to people walking across the street at a zebra crossing.
phrases.ex: to people walking across the street 表示駕駛要「禮讓」行人。

phrases.stem: Having been ____ on a farm in the countryside, Ken knows a lot about plants and animals.
phrases.ex: on a farm ... knows a lot about plants 表示他在農場「長大」。

phrases.stem: During the class meeting, Amy ____ the problem of trash in the classroom, and everyone agreed to help clean up.
phrases.zh: bring up：提出（話題、問題）；（另一義）撫養
phrases.ex: everyone agreed to help 表示 Amy「提出」垃圾問題。

phrases.stem: The heavy rain last week ____ serious floods in the south, and many roads to the mountains were closed.
phrases.ex: heavy rain 造成 floods，因果關係。

phrases.stem: The writer plans to ____ a new book of short stories about her childhood in Tainan later this year.
phrases.zh: bring out：推出、出版；（另一義）激發
phrases.ex: a new book 表示「出版」新書。

phrases.stem: The strong wind last night ____ several big trees, which blocked the road to our school this morning.
phrases.zh: bring down：使倒下；（另一義）降低
phrases.ex: blocked the road 表示樹被風「吹倒」。

phrases.stem: Could you ____ some fresh fruit for me when you come home from the market this afternoon?
phrases.zh: bring back：帶回來；（另一義）勾起（回憶）
phrases.ex: when you come home 表示順便「帶回」水果。

phrases.stem: Selling bags that she makes by hand ____ about twenty thousand dollars a month for my aunt.
phrases.ex: twenty thousand dollars a month 表示「賺進」收入。

phrases.stem: Too much pressure sometimes ____ the worst in people; they become angry over small things.
phrases.ex: they become angry over small things 表示壓力讓人「顯露」最壞一面。

phrases.stem: The school sports day ____ students, teachers, and parents for a whole day of fun and games.
phrases.ex: students, teachers, and parents 表示讓大家「齊聚」。

phrases.stem: Whenever his parents start to complain about his grades, Tom simply ____ and thinks about video games instead.
phrases.zh: tune out：不再理會、充耳不聞
phrases.ex: thinks about video games instead 表示他「不聽」父母說話。
dist: tune in：收聽；注意聽（方向相反）

phrases.stem: Online shopping ____ slowly in Taiwan at first, but now almost everyone buys clothes and food on the Internet.
phrases.ex: slowly at first, but now almost everyone 表示網購逐漸「流行」。

phrases.stem: I don't understand how this new washing machine works. Could you help me ____?
phrases.ex: I don't understand how ... works 表示請人幫忙「弄懂」。
dist: give it out：把它分發出去

phrases.stem: The bank ____ his request for a loan because he did not have a steady job or any savings at the time.
phrases.zh: turn down：拒絕；（另一義）調小（音量）
phrases.ex: did not have a steady job 表示銀行「拒絕」貸款。

phrases.stem: The quiet man everyone thought was a tourist ____ to be the new principal of our school.
phrases.zh: turn out (to be)：結果是、原來是
phrases.ex: everyone thought ... 與事實對比，表示他「原來是」新校長。

phrases.stem: Could you ____ the radio a little? I can't hear the news because of the noise from the street outside.
phrases.zh: turn up：調大（音量）；（另一義）出現
phrases.ex: I can't hear the news 表示要把音量「調大」。

phrases.stem: The school promised to ____ the complaints about the food in the cafeteria and make changes if needed.
phrases.ex: promised to ... and make changes 表示先「調查」抱怨。

phrases.stem: As a child, I ____ my older sister, who always got good grades and was kind to everyone around her.
phrases.ex: always got good grades and was kind 表示「仰慕」姊姊。
dist: look down on：瞧不起（方向相反）
put up with：忍受（與 kind 不合）

phrases.stem: I am really ____ meeting my pen pal from Japan, who is coming to visit Taiwan for the first time next month.
phrases.ex: coming to visit ... for the first time 表示「期待」見面。

phrases.stem: Some people ____ jobs like cleaning the streets, but these workers are important to every city.
phrases.ex: but these workers are important 形成對比，表示有人「看不起」這類工作。
dist: look up to：尊敬（方向相反）

phrases.stem: When she heard that her old dog had died, she ____ and cried for hours in her room.
phrases.zh: break down：（情緒）崩潰；（另一義）（機器）故障
phrases.ex: cried for hours 表示她「崩潰」大哭。

phrases.stem: When the war ____ in 1939, many young men in Europe had to leave school and join the army.
phrases.zh: break out：（戰爭、火災、疾病）爆發
phrases.ex: When the war ... 表示戰爭「爆發」。

phrases.stem: Last night someone ____ the school office and stole two computers and some cash from the desk.
phrases.ex: stole two computers 表示有人「闖入」辦公室。

phrases.stem: While they were walking in the park, the little dog managed to ____ its owner and ran happily after a bird.
phrases.ex: ran happily after a bird 表示小狗「掙脫」主人。
dist: break up with：與…分手（不用於寵物）
keep up with：跟上（與跑開相反）

phrases.stem: The plan sounds great on paper, but it will be very hard to ____ without more money and workers.
phrases.ex: sounds great on paper, but ... without more money 表示計畫難以「執行」。

phrases.stem: Despite the loud noise from the street, the teacher ____ with her lesson as if nothing had happened.
phrases.ex: as if nothing had happened 表示她「繼續」上課。

phrases.stem: The bus was crowded and kept stopping suddenly, so I had to ____ tightly to keep from falling over.
phrases.zh: hold on：抓緊；（另一義）（電話中）稍等
phrases.ex: tightly to keep from falling 表示要「抓緊」。

phrases.stem: He wanted to tell his boss what he really thought, but he ____ because he was afraid of losing his job.
phrases.ex: afraid of losing his job 表示他「忍住」沒說。

phrases.stem: Two men with guns ____ a bank in the city center and ran away with a large amount of cash.
phrases.zh: hold up：持槍搶劫；（另一義）耽擱
phrases.ex: with guns ... ran away with cash 表示「搶劫」銀行。

phrases.stem: She walked so fast that her little brother had to run to ____ her on their way to school.
phrases.ex: walked so fast ... had to run 表示弟弟要跑才「跟得上」。
dist: keep away from：遠離（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The doctor told me to ____ sweets and fried food for a while until my stomach gets better.
phrases.zh: stay away from：遠離；避開（keep off 亦同義）
phrases.ex: until my stomach gets better 表示暫時「別吃」甜食炸物。

phrases.stem: The phone in the office ____ ringing all morning, but nobody answered it because everyone was at a meeting.
phrases.ex: all morning ... nobody answered 表示電話「一直」響。

phrases.stem: The smoke from the burnt toast ____ the fire alarm, and everyone in the building had to go outside.
phrases.zh: set off：觸發、引爆；（另一義）出發
phrases.ex: smoke ... fire alarm 表示煙「觸發」警報。

phrases.stem: After the earthquake, the city ____ a special center to help families who had lost their homes find a place to stay.
phrases.ex: a special center to help families 表示「設立」中心。

phrases.stem: During exam season, the library ____ a quiet room for students who are preparing for the college entrance exam.
phrases.zh: set aside：保留、撥出（空間、時間）
phrases.ex: for students who are preparing 表示「保留」一間給考生。

phrases.stem: The building project ____ serious problems when the company suddenly could not pay its workers.
phrases.zh: run into：遭遇（困難）；（另一義）巧遇
phrases.ex: serious problems 表示計畫「碰上」問題。

phrases.stem: We ____ time before we could answer the last question, so our team lost the quiz by ten points.
phrases.ex: before we could answer the last question 表示時間「用完」了。

phrases.stem: A big truck backed out of the parking lot and ____ my bike, which I had left on the ground behind it.
phrases.ex: truck ... my bike ... behind it 表示卡車「輾過」腳踏車。

phrases.stem: Their marriage slowly ____ after they started arguing about money almost every day, and they finally decided to live apart.
phrases.zh: fall apart：（關係、計畫）瓦解；（另一義）散掉
phrases.ex: arguing about money every day 表示婚姻「破裂」。

phrases.stem: If you ____ with your rent for three months, the owner of the apartment may ask you to leave.
phrases.zh: fall behind (with)：拖欠（款項）；（另一義）落後
phrases.ex: may ask you to leave 表示「拖欠」房租。

phrases.stem: The deal to sell our house ____ at the last minute because the buyer could not get a loan from the bank.
phrases.ex: the buyer could not get a loan 表示交易「告吹」。

phrases.stem: Many old people ____ the phone trick and sent money to strangers who said they were police officers.
phrases.ex: trick ... sent money to strangers 表示「受騙上當」。

phrases.stem: To save enough money for a new bike, Ben decided to ____ snacks and soft drinks for a few months.
phrases.ex: To save money ... 表示「少吃」零食飲料。

phrases.stem: The heavy snow ____ the mountain village from the outside world for almost a week last winter.
phrases.zh: cut off：使隔絕；（另一義）切斷（供應）
phrases.ex: from the outside world 表示村莊被「隔絕」。

phrases.stem: A car suddenly ____ in front of us on the highway, and my father had to brake hard to avoid hitting it.
phrases.zh: cut in：（車輛）超車切入；（另一義）插嘴
phrases.ex: in front of us ... had to brake hard 表示有車「切入」。

phrases.stem: Business at the shop was slow in winter, but it began to ____ again when the tourists returned in spring.
phrases.zh: pick up：好轉、回升；（另一義）接人
phrases.ex: slow in winter, but ... tourists returned 表示生意「回升」。

phrases.stem: Instead of walking past it, the boy ____ the empty bottle on the ground and threw it into the trash can.
phrases.zh: pick up：撿起；（另一義）（自然地）學會
phrases.ex: threw it into the trash can 表示先「撿起」瓶子。

phrases.stem: My mother let me ____ my own birthday cake at the bakery, so I chose a chocolate one with strawberries on top.
phrases.ex: so I chose 表示讓我「挑選」蛋糕。

phrases.stem: The two families ____ the wedding at the last minute, and all the guests were told to stay home.
phrases.ex: guests were told to stay home 表示婚禮「取消」。

phrases.stem: This recipe ____ two eggs and a cup of milk, but we only have one egg, so we'll need to buy more.
phrases.ex: but we only have one egg 表示食譜「需要」兩顆蛋。

phrases.stem: The teacher ____ me to answer the question, but I hadn't been listening, so I had no idea what to say.
phrases.zh: call on：點名（某人發言）；（另一義）拜訪
phrases.ex: to answer the question 表示老師「點名」我。

phrases.stem: With so many players out sick, the coach has to ____ the young players to win the game tonight.
phrases.ex: With so many players out sick 表示只能「靠」年輕球員。

phrases.stem: We can't ____ the bus arriving on time in this heavy snow, so let's leave home thirty minutes early.
phrases.ex: so let's leave home early 表示不能「指望」公車準時。

phrases.stem: All those early mornings at the swimming pool ____ when he won a gold medal at the national games.
phrases.ex: won a gold medal 表示努力「有了成果」。

phrases.stem: It took my parents twenty years to ____ the loan for our house, and they finally did it last month.
phrases.zh: pay off：還清（債務）；（另一義）有回報
phrases.ex: twenty years ... finally did it 表示「還清」房貸。

phrases.stem: He promised himself that one day he would ____ the boys who had laughed at him by beating them in a race.
phrases.ex: who had laughed at him 表示要「報復」他們。

phrases.stem: My uncle ____ at the gym three times a week, and now he is much stronger than he was last year.
phrases.zh: work out：健身、運動；（另一義）解決
phrases.ex: at the gym ... much stronger 表示他去「健身」。

phrases.stem: Their plan to sell cold drinks at the beach didn't ____; it rained all week and nobody came.
phrases.ex: rained all week and nobody came 表示計畫「不成功」。

phrases.stem: The letters UN ____ the United Nations, an international group that works for peace around the world.
phrases.ex: The letters UN 表示縮寫「代表」聯合國。

phrases.stem: Among all the drawings in the art contest, Mia's ____ because of her bold use of bright colors.
phrases.ex: bold use of bright colors 表示她的畫「脫穎而出」。

phrases.stem: Doctors and nurses are ____ near the finish line in case any runner gets hurt during the marathon.
phrases.ex: in case any runner gets hurt 表示醫護人員「待命」。

phrases.stem: He ____ by riding his bike without using his hands, and then he fell and hurt his arm.
phrases.ex: riding without using his hands 表示他在「耍帥炫技」。

phrases.stem: The guest speaker ____ thirty minutes late because his train had been delayed by the storm.
phrases.ex: thirty minutes late 表示講者晚了才「出現」。

phrases.stem: After a month in the hospital, Kevin studied hard every night to ____ the rest of his class.
phrases.ex: After a month in the hospital 表示要努力「趕上」同學。

phrases.stem: At first, few people used the city's shared bikes, but the idea slowly ____, and now they are everywhere.
phrases.ex: At first, few people ... now they are everywhere 表示逐漸「流行」。

phrases.stem: Two runners had to ____ because of the heat, but the rest of the runners finished the race safely.
phrases.zh: drop out (of)：退出（比賽）；（另一義）輟學
phrases.ex: but the rest finished 表示兩人「退出」比賽。
dist: drop off：讓…下車；打瞌睡；減少

phrases.stem: I'll ____ your office after lunch to pick up the books you said I could borrow.
phrases.ex: after lunch to pick up the books 表示「順道過去」。

phrases.stem: After a long day of hiking in the hot sun, we were completely ____ and went to bed early.
phrases.zh: worn out：筋疲力盡；（另一義）（物品）磨破
phrases.ex: went to bed early 表示大家「累壞了」。

phrases.stem: The excitement of moving to a new city soon ____, and she began to miss her old friends back home.
phrases.zh: wear off：（感覺、效果）逐漸消退
phrases.ex: soon ... began to miss her old friends 表示興奮感「消退」。

phrases.stem: The truck driver slowly ____ into the narrow street while a man behind the truck gave him directions.
phrases.ex: a man behind the truck gave him directions 表示司機在「倒車」。

phrases.stem: The scientist ____ her ideas with clear examples and data from real experiments, so few people disagreed.
phrases.ex: with clear examples and data 表示用資料「佐證」。

phrases.stem: The honest student ____ the wallet he found on the bus to the police station near his school.
phrases.zh: hand in：上交（給權責單位）；繳交
phrases.ex: to the police station 表示把錢包「交給」警察。

phrases.stem: At the start of the exam, the teacher ____ the test papers to every student in the room.
phrases.ex: to every student 表示老師「發」考卷。

phrases.stem: Many old stories in this village have been ____ from parents to children for hundreds of years.
phrases.ex: from parents to children 表示故事「代代相傳」。

phrases.stem: Sadly, the famous singer ____ last year, but his songs are still loved by people of all ages.
phrases.ex: Sadly ... but his songs are still loved 表示歌手「過世」。

phrases.stem: When he saw the blood on his hand, the boy turned white and ____ for a few seconds.
phrases.ex: for a few seconds 表示短暫「昏過去」。
dist: pass away：過世（不會只有幾秒）

phrases.stem: Please read this note from the principal and then ____ the note to the next person in your row.
phrases.ex: to the next person 表示把紙條「傳下去」。

phrases.stem: Before seeing the doctor for the first time, you need to ____ a form about your health history.
phrases.ex: a form 表示「填寫」表格。

phrases.stem: The concert hall ____ quickly, and many fans had to stand outside to listen to the music.
phrases.ex: had to stand outside 表示場內很快「客滿」。

phrases.stem: While Jenny is on vacation next week, Amy will ____ her at the front desk of the hotel.
phrases.zh: fill in for：代替（某人工作）
phrases.ex: While Jenny is on vacation 表示 Amy「代班」。

phrases.stem: The teacher waited quietly for the noisy class to ____ before she started the lesson.
phrases.zh: settle down：安靜下來；（另一義）定居
phrases.ex: noisy class ... before she started 表示等學生「安靜下來」。

phrases.stem: Moving to a new city was hard for the family, but they slowly ____ and made many new friends.
phrases.ex: made many new friends 表示漸漸「適應」新環境。

phrases.stem: No matter how angry the fans get, the referee must ____ the rules of the game.
phrases.ex: No matter how angry the fans get 表示必須「堅守」規則。

phrases.stem: The weather is so nice here. Why not ____ for a few more days before you go back home?
phrases.ex: for a few more days before you go back 表示多「待」幾天。

phrases.stem: As the only person wearing a suit at the beach party, he really ____ and felt a little silly.
phrases.zh: stick out：引人注目；（另一義）突出
phrases.ex: the only person wearing a suit 表示他很「顯眼」。

phrases.stem: The song was played so often on the radio that its tune ____ me for days after I first heard it.
phrases.zh: stick with：（記憶）留在心中；（另一義）（綽號）跟著某人
phrases.ex: for days after I first heard it 表示旋律一直「留在腦中」。

phrases.stem: Let me ____ what we discussed today: we will meet again next week, and each of you will bring one idea.
phrases.ex: what we discussed today 表示「總結」今天的討論。

phrases.stem: For me, one word ____ my whole trip to Japan last summer: amazing. I want to go there again.
phrases.ex: one word ... amazing 表示一個字就能「概括」旅程。

phrases.stem: The reporter decided to ____ on the story and find out what happened to the family after the fire.
phrases.ex: find out what happened ... after the fire 表示「追蹤後續」。

phrases.stem: The salesperson called me a week after I bought the car to ____ and ask whether I was happy with it.
phrases.ex: a week after I bought the car 表示「後續追蹤」。

phrases.stem: The strange noises outside the tent kept the campers ____ all night, and none of them could fall asleep until the sun came up.
phrases.zh: on edge：緊張不安、提心吊膽
phrases.ex: strange noises ... none of them could fall asleep 表示大家「提心吊膽」。

phrases.stem: Drinking too much coffee can leave you feeling ____: your heart beats fast, and you find it hard to relax.
phrases.ex: heart beats fast ... hard to relax 表示「坐立不安」。
dist: at ease：自在、放鬆（與 hard to relax 相反）

phrases.stem: When the customer complained that his soup was cold, the waiter brought him a fresh bowl ____ and said he was sorry.
phrases.ex: complained ... brought him a fresh bowl 表示服務生「當場」換一碗。

phrases.stem: When the man fainted on the street, a doctor who happened to be passing by was able to help him ____ before the ambulance arrived.
phrases.ex: 醫生剛好路過，「當場」救助。

phrases.stem: She left the back door open ____ so that the cat could come inside when it got cold at night.
phrases.ex: so that the cat could come inside 說明是有目的「故意」留門。
dist: by accident：意外地（與 so that 的目的不合）

phrases.stem: The baby cried for hours ____ last night, and his tired parents had no idea how to calm him down.
phrases.ex: for hours ... 表示「連續」哭了好幾小時。

phrases.stem: Mr. Lin went on stage and accepted the award ____ his daughter, who was studying abroad and could not be there.
phrases.ex: could not be there 表示林先生「代表」女兒領獎。

phrases.stem: ____ being a full-time student, Jason also works at a restaurant three nights a week to help his family.
phrases.ex: also works at a restaurant 表示「除了」當學生外還打工。

phrases.stem: If the team loses one more game this season, it will be ____ falling to a lower league next year.
phrases.ex: If the team loses one more game 表示「有降級危險」。

phrases.stem: A few of the dishes were a bit too salty, but ____ we enjoyed our meal at the new restaurant.
phrases.zh: on the whole：大致上、整體而言
phrases.ex: A few ... but 對比，表示「整體來說」很滿意。

phrases.stem: The prices of fruit and vegetables are ____ because the typhoon destroyed many farms in the south.
phrases.zh: on the rise：上漲中、增加中
phrases.ex: typhoon destroyed many farms 表示菜價「上漲」。

phrases.stem: Sorry, I can't go out with you tonight. I'm ____ at the hospital until midnight, so maybe we can meet tomorrow.
phrases.ex: at the hospital until midnight 表示要「值班」。

phrases.stem: "Let's take a taxi to the station. No, ____, the MRT will be faster at this time of day because of the traffic."
phrases.zh: on second thought：再想一想、改變主意
phrases.ex: No, ... the MRT will be faster 表示說話者「改變主意」。

phrases.stem: Online classes save students a lot of travel time. ____, it is often harder for them to ask their teachers questions.
phrases.zh: on the other hand：另一方面
phrases.ex: 前句說優點、後句說缺點，用「另一方面」轉折。
dist: in other words：換句話說（後句並非重述）

phrases.stem: When her students threw her a surprise party, the teacher was so moved that she was ____ for words.
phrases.zh: at a loss (for words)：（感動得）說不出話
phrases.ex: so moved that ... for words 表示感動到「說不出話」。

phrases.stem: Having missed the last bus in a strange city at midnight, Tom was ____ as to what he should do next.
phrases.ex: missed the last bus ... what he should do next 表示「不知所措」。

phrases.stem: Old wooden houses are ____ during the dry season, when a small fire can quickly get out of control.
phrases.ex: dry season ... a small fire 表示木屋「有危險」。

phrases.stem: With his job and his family's future ____, the man knew he could not afford to make another mistake.
phrases.zh: at stake：（利益）攸關、岌岌可危
phrases.ex: could not afford to make another mistake 表示工作和家庭「岌岌可危」。

phrases.stem: The singer wanted to avoid the reporters ____, so she left the hotel through the kitchen door late at night.
phrases.zh: at all costs：不惜任何代價
phrases.ex: left through the kitchen door late at night 表示「無論如何」都要避開記者。

phrases.stem: Farmers in this area are ____ the weather; a single strong typhoon can destroy a whole year's work.
phrases.zh: at the mercy of：任由…擺布
phrases.ex: a single typhoon can destroy 表示農民「受天氣擺布」。
dist: at the risk of：冒著…的危險

phrases.stem: ____, the old house seemed perfect, but we soon found that the roof leaked whenever it rained.
phrases.zh: at first sight：乍看之下；（另一義）一見鍾情
phrases.ex: looked perfect ... but we soon found 表示「乍看」很好。

phrases.stem: Speaking in front of the class used to make him nervous, but now he feels completely ____ on stage.
phrases.ex: used to make him nervous, but now 對比，表示現在很「自在」。
dist: on edge：緊張不安（方向相反）

phrases.stem: Don't just choose your answers ____ on the test; think carefully about each question before you decide.
phrases.ex: think carefully 形成對比，表示別「亂選」。

phrases.stem: He tried ____ to start the old car for half an hour, and in the end he had to call a taxi.
phrases.ex: in the end he had to call a taxi 表示嘗試「白費」。

phrases.stem: Who is ____ the sound and lights for tonight's show? The speakers on the left side are not working.
phrases.ex: The speakers are not working 表示要找「負責」音響的人。

phrases.stem: Doctors are ____ in the countryside, so many patients have to travel to the city to see one.
phrases.ex: have to travel to the city 表示鄉下醫師「短缺」。
dist: in the long run：長遠來看

phrases.stem: When the teacher opened the classroom door, the excited children ran ____, laughing and shouting across the playground.
phrases.ex: ran ... across the playground 表示孩子們「四散」奔跑。
dist: in the same boat：處境相同

phrases.stem: Buying cheap shoes may save you money now, but ____ good ones are cheaper because they last much longer.
phrases.zh: in the long run：長遠來看
phrases.ex: now ... but 對比，表示「長期而言」好鞋較划算。
dist: at first sight：乍看之下（與 last much longer 不合）

phrases.stem: My brother and I are ____: we both have big exams next week, and neither of us has started studying yet.
phrases.zh: in the same boat：處境相同
phrases.ex: we both ... neither of us 表示兩人「處境相同」。

phrases.stem: Many small shop owners on this street are ____ this year; high rents and fewer customers are hurting all of them.
phrases.zh: in the same boat：同病相憐
phrases.ex: are hurting all of them 表示大家「處境相同」。

phrases.stem: I wrapped the glass vase in many layers of paper, and luckily it arrived at my aunt's house ____.
phrases.ex: wrapped ... many layers ... luckily 表示花瓶「完好」送達。
dist: in the same boat：處境相同

phrases.stem: Don't worry about the results of your application; you will hear from the school ____, probably within two weeks.
phrases.zh: in due time：在適當的時候、終將
phrases.ex: probably within two weeks 表示「時候到了」就會收到通知。

phrases.stem: With everyone in the class helping, we cleaned the whole classroom ____ and were able to go home early.
phrases.ex: were able to go home early 表示「很快」就打掃完。
dist: in due time：終將（不強調快）

phrases.stem: Reading more books helps you learn new words, which ____ helps you write better essays.
phrases.zh: in turn：轉而、進而；（另一義）輪流
phrases.ex: reading → new words → better essays 的連鎖因果，用「進而」。

phrases.stem: The judge ruled ____ the small farmer, so the big company had to pay him for the damage to his land.
phrases.zh: in favor of：對…有利；（另一義）贊成
phrases.ex: so the big company had to pay him 表示判決「有利於」農夫。

phrases.stem: ____ size, Taiwan is a small island, but it has some of the tallest mountains in East Asia.
phrases.ex: size 表示「就面積而言」。

phrases.stem: ____ his age, my grandfather still climbs the mountain near our home every weekend with his friends.
phrases.ex: his age 與 still climbs 形成讓步，用「儘管」。

phrases.stem: You can use honey ____ sugar in this cake; it will taste just as sweet and be a little healthier.
phrases.ex: just as sweet 表示用蜂蜜「代替」糖。
dist: on top of：除…之外（不是加更多糖）

phrases.stem: Ann is smart, works hard, and is always ready to help others. ____, she is the perfect person for the job.
phrases.ex: 前面列出優點，後句做總結。
dist: on the other hand：另一方面（前後沒有對比）

phrases.stem: The doctor said my father's illness was "not serious at all." ____, there was nothing for us to worry about.
phrases.ex: 後句重述醫生的話，用「換句話說」。
dist: on the other hand：另一方面

phrases.stem: Nobody told me about the change of plans, so I was left completely ____ until the morning of the trip.
phrases.ex: Nobody told me 表示我「不知情」。
dist: in the same boat：處境相同

phrases.stem: She has been late for school three days ____, so her teacher decided to call her parents.
phrases.ex: three days ... call her parents 表示「連續」遲到三天。

phrases.stem: The museum is very popular, so you need to book your visit at least two weeks ____.
phrases.ex: very popular ... at least two weeks 表示要「提前」預約。

phrases.stem: I have seen the famous singer on TV many times, but I have never met her ____.
phrases.ex: on TV ... but never met her 表示沒見過「本人」。

phrases.stem: Swimming twice a week is a good way to stay ____ if you sit at a desk all day for work.
phrases.ex: sit at a desk all day 表示要靠游泳「保持健康」。

phrases.stem: "Can I bring my little brother to the birthday party tomorrow?" "____! The more people, the more fun."
phrases.ex: The more people, the more fun 表示熱情「當然好」。
dist: by no means：絕不（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The test was ____ easy; even the best student in our class could not finish it on time.
phrases.zh: by no means：絕不、一點也不
phrases.ex: even the best student could not finish 表示「一點也不」簡單。
dist: by far：遠遠地（須接最高級）

phrases.stem: Scientists discovered the new medicine ____ while they were looking for a cure for a different disease.
phrases.ex: while they were looking for ... a different disease 表示是「意外」發現。

phrases.stem: Our music teacher asked us to learn the words of the school song ____ before the graduation ceremony.
phrases.ex: learn the words ... before the ceremony 表示要把歌詞「背起來」。

phrases.stem: Summer is ____ the most crowded time of year for the beach hotels; they are full almost every night.
phrases.zh: by far：（修飾最高級）遠遠、顯然
phrases.ex: the most crowded ... full almost every night 表示「顯然」最熱門。

phrases.stem: Thanks for helping me with my homework. ____, have you heard that Mr. Chen is leaving our school?
phrases.ex: 後句轉換話題，用「順便一提」。

phrases.stem: My passport is ____, so I need to get a new one before our trip to Korea next month.
phrases.ex: need to get a new one 表示護照「過期」。
dist: out of breath：上氣不接下氣

phrases.stem: The ticket machine at the station was ____, so we had to buy our tickets from the man at the window.
phrases.ex: had to buy ... from the man at the window 表示售票機「故障」。

phrases.stem: For many young people, buying a house in Taipei is ____ because prices have risen so much.
phrases.zh: out of reach：遙不可及；（另一義）拿不到
phrases.ex: prices have risen so much 表示買房「遙不可及」。

phrases.stem: Asking my parents for more money this month is ____; they have already said no twice.
phrases.zh: out of the question：不可能的
phrases.ex: already said no twice 表示再要錢「不可能」。

phrases.stem: The boy ran all the way from the bus stop and arrived at class ____ and red in the face.
phrases.zh: out of breath：上氣不接下氣
phrases.ex: ran all the way 表示「喘不過氣」。

phrases.stem: The car went ____ on the icy road and hit a tree, but luckily the driver was not badly hurt.
phrases.ex: icy road ... hit a tree 表示車子「失控」。

phrases.stem: The little boy hid the chocolate ____ under his bed so that his mother would not find it.
phrases.zh: out of sight：看不見的地方
phrases.ex: hid ... so that his mother would not find it 表示藏在「看不見」處。

phrases.stem: My uncle has been ____ since March, so he spends every morning looking for jobs online.
phrases.ex: looking for jobs online 表示他「失業」。

phrases.stem: Plans for the school's hundredth birthday party are already ____, and students are practicing songs every afternoon.
phrases.ex: students are practicing songs every afternoon 表示籌備「進行中」。

phrases.stem: The doctor gave him some medicine to keep his high blood pressure ____, and told him to eat less salt.
phrases.ex: medicine ... high blood pressure 表示把血壓「控制住」。

phrases.stem: The workers were ____ to finish the bridge before the rainy season, so they worked through every weekend.
phrases.ex: before the rainy season ... worked through every weekend 表示工人「壓力大」趕工。

phrases.stem: Grandmother has been a little ____ since she caught a cold last week, so she is resting at home.
phrases.ex: caught a cold ... resting at home 表示奶奶「不舒服」。

phrases.stem: The man who robbed the jewelry store is now ____, and the police are asking him where he hid the money.
phrases.ex: the police are asking him 表示他已「被捕」。

phrases.stem: The swimming pool is closed for repairs, so ____ students will have PE class in the gym instead.
phrases.ex: closed for repairs 表示「暫時」改在體育館上課。
dist: for good：永久地（與修繕不合）

phrases.stem: After the terrible accident, he gave up driving ____ and never sat behind the wheel of a car again.
phrases.ex: never ... again 表示「永遠」不開車。
dist: for a while：一陣子（與 never again 不合）

phrases.stem: When choosing a pet, think about its size, its cost, and, ____, how much time you can spend with it.
phrases.ex: 列舉條件後，用「最重要的是」強調最後一點。

phrases.stem: As a firefighter, he puts saving lives ____, even before his own safety.
phrases.zh: above all else：比什麼都重要
phrases.ex: even before his own safety 表示救人「最重要」。

phrases.stem: ____, the old dog found its way home after being lost in the mountains for two whole months.
phrases.zh: against all odds：儘管困難重重、出乎意料地
phrases.ex: lost in the mountains for two months 表示能回家「實屬不易」。

phrases.stem: When she heard that her son was safe after the earthquake, her joy was ____.
phrases.ex: her son was safe 表示喜悅「無法言喻」。

phrases.stem: Because of the heavy snow, all the trains are running about two hours ____ today.
phrases.ex: heavy snow 表示火車「誤點」。
dist: ahead of schedule：提前（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The actor agreed to talk about his private life, but only ____; he didn't want any of it in the newspapers.
phrases.zh: off the record：私下的、不公開的
phrases.ex: didn't want any of it in the newspapers 表示「不公開」。

phrases.stem: In this city, old temples and modern buildings stand ____, showing both the past and the present.
phrases.ex: showing both the past and the present 表示新舊建築「並存」。
dist: far apart：相距遙遠（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The two villages are so ____ that it takes a whole day to walk from one to the other.
phrases.ex: takes a whole day to walk 表示兩村「相距很遠」。
dist: side by side：並排（方向相反）

phrases.stem: Use a strong hair band to keep your hair ____ while you are running around on the basketball court.
phrases.ex: strong hair band ... while running 表示把頭髮「固定好」。
dist: in shape：身材好（不用於頭髮固定）
in order：井然有序（多指文件、事情）

phrases.stem: The convenience store near my house is open ____, so I can buy milk there even at three in the morning.
phrases.zh: around the clock：全天候、24 小時
phrases.ex: even at three in the morning 表示「24 小時」營業。

phrases.stem: Your plan will solve the problem ____, but we will still need other ways to fix it completely.
phrases.zh: to some extent：在某種程度上
phrases.ex: but ... still need other ways 表示只「部分」解決。

phrases.stem: "I guess you don't like spicy food." "____, I love it; I put hot sauce on almost everything I eat."
phrases.zh: as a matter of fact：事實上
phrases.ex: 用「事實上」糾正對方的猜測。

phrases.stem: The lights went out ____ in the middle of the movie, and everyone in the theater began to scream.
phrases.ex: in the middle of the movie ... began to scream 表示燈「突然」熄滅。

phrases.stem: Some dishonest shop owners ____ tourists who don't know the local prices and charge them much more than usual.
phrases.zh: take advantage of：佔…便宜；（另一義）利用（機會）
phrases.ex: dishonest ... charge them much more 表示「佔觀光客便宜」。

phrases.stem: Students from more than ten countries ____ the international science fair held in Taipei last month.
phrases.ex: science fair 表示學生「參加」科展。
dist: take place：舉行（主詞應為活動）

phrases.stem: The story of the movie ____ in a small fishing village by the sea about seventy years ago.
phrases.zh: take place：（故事、事件）發生；（另一義）舉行
phrases.ex: in a small fishing village ... seventy years ago 表示故事「發生」的時地。

phrases.stem: The young doctor tried hard to ____ the old man's words, but he spoke too softly and too fast.
phrases.ex: spoke too softly and too fast 表示醫生努力「聽懂」。

phrases.stem: Our teacher believes that a few kind words can ____ to a student who is having a really hard day.
phrases.zh: make a difference：產生影響、有幫助
phrases.ex: kind words ... having a hard day 表示能「帶來改變」。

phrases.stem: The weather will be sunny only until Friday, so let's ____ it and go to the beach tomorrow.
phrases.zh: make the most of：充分利用
phrases.ex: sunny only until Friday 表示要「好好把握」好天氣。

phrases.stem: Students who ____ what the teacher says in class usually do not need to study as much before exams.
phrases.ex: do not need to study as much 表示上課「專心聽」的學生。

phrases.stem: This phone program helps runners ____ how far and how fast they run every day, so they can see their progress.
phrases.zh: keep track of：記錄、掌握（動態）
phrases.ex: so they can see their progress 表示要「記錄」跑步數據。
dist: lose track of：失去聯繫、忘記（方向相反）

phrases.stem: There were so many people at the night market that I ____ my little sister for a few terrible minutes.
phrases.zh: lose track of：（一時）找不到、失去…的蹤影；（另一義）忘了（時間）
phrases.ex: so many people ... terrible minutes 表示人太多「看不到」妹妹。
dist: keep track of：掌握動態（方向相反）

phrases.stem: Please ____ the soup on the stove and turn off the heat as soon as it starts to boil.
phrases.zh: keep an eye on：留意、看著
phrases.ex: turn off the fire as soon as it starts to boil 表示要「看著」湯。

phrases.stem: Regular exercise ____ staying healthy, so doctors suggest walking for at least thirty minutes a day.
phrases.zh: play an important role in：扮演重要角色、對…很重要
phrases.ex: so doctors suggest walking 表示運動對健康「很重要」。
dist: take the place of：取代（運動不是取代健康）
get in the way of：妨礙（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The famous singer was ____ copying another band's song, but he said he had never heard it before.
phrases.ex: but he said he had never heard it 表示他在否認「被指控」抄襲。

phrases.stem: Before you sign the contract, make sure you are ____ all the costs, including the hidden ones.
phrases.ex: make sure ... including the hidden ones 表示要「清楚知道」所有費用。

phrases.stem: Even young children are ____ understanding when adults are sad, so it's better to explain things to them honestly.
phrases.ex: so it's better to explain ... honestly 表示小孩「有能力」察覺。

phrases.stem: The driver who caused the accident was held ____ the damage and had to pay for all the repairs.
phrases.ex: caused the accident ... had to pay 表示被認定要「負責」。

phrases.stem: This small mountain town is ____ its hot springs, which attract visitors from all over Asia every winter.
phrases.ex: its hot springs ... attract visitors 表示小鎮「以溫泉聞名」。

phrases.stem: Leonardo da Vinci is ____ a painter, but he was also a great scientist and inventor.
phrases.ex: a painter 是身分，用 famous as。
dist: be famous for：以（特色、作品）聞名，後接特點而非身分

phrases.stem: This writing paper is ____ old newspapers, so buying it helps to save trees and reduce waste.
phrases.zh: be made from：由…製成（原料已變質）
phrases.ex: old newspapers ... save trees 表示紙是由舊報紙「製成」。
dist: be made into：被製成（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The power failure ____ hundreds of people being stuck on the MRT for over an hour last night.
phrases.ex: power failure → people being stuck，前因後果用 result in。

phrases.stem: The police say that most car accidents ____ drivers not paying enough attention to the road.
phrases.ex: drivers not paying attention 是車禍的「原因」。

phrases.stem: A healthy breakfast usually ____ fruit, eggs, and some kind of bread or rice, plus a glass of milk.
phrases.ex: 列出早餐內容，表示「由…組成」。

phrases.stem: Many families in this village ____ fishing for a living, so a bad season hurts almost everyone.
phrases.ex: for a living ... a bad season hurts everyone 表示「依靠」捕魚維生。

phrases.stem: The new movie ____ the lives of poor families in the city and the hard choices they have to make.
phrases.zh: deal with：探討（主題）；（另一義）處理、應付
phrases.ex: the lives of poor families 表示電影「探討」的主題。

phrases.stem: Every student in our class ____ the class fund to buy flowers and a card for our sick teacher.
phrases.zh: contribute to：捐獻、出錢；（另一義）促成
phrases.ex: the class fund to buy flowers 表示每人「捐錢」給班費。

phrases.stem: Even a small mistake in the design could ____ serious problems after the bridge is finished.
phrases.ex: a small mistake → serious problems，表示「導致」。

phrases.stem: The discount only ____ students with a student card, so please show yours when you pay.
phrases.ex: only ... students with a student card 表示折扣「適用」學生。

phrases.stem: The angry customer ____ seeing the manager, saying the waiter had been rude to her and her children.
phrases.ex: angry ... saying the waiter had been rude 表示她「堅持」見經理。
dist: look forward to：期待（與 angry 不合）

phrases.stem: Several parents ____ the new rule that students could not bring phones to school, saying they needed to reach their children.
phrases.ex: saying they needed to reach their children 表示家長「反對」新規定。

phrases.stem: We are all ____ the end of the rainy season so that we can play baseball outside again.
phrases.ex: so that we can play baseball outside again 表示「期待」雨季結束。

phrases.stem: After working at night for twenty years, my father is ____ sleeping during the day and can do it easily.
phrases.ex: for twenty years ... can do it easily 表示已「習慣」白天睡覺。
dist: be opposed to：反對（與 can do it easily 不合）

phrases.stem: Students from warm countries often find it hard to ____ the cold winters when they first study in Canada.
phrases.ex: from warm countries ... find it hard 表示「難以適應」寒冬。

phrases.stem: The famous singer ____ most of her free time to working with sick children in hospitals.
phrases.zh: devote ... to V-ing：把（時間、心力）奉獻於
phrases.ex: most of her free time to working with sick children 表示「投入」時間。

phrases.stem: Starting next January, a new rule that bans plastic straws in all restaurants in the city will ____.
phrases.ex: Starting next January ... bans plastic straws 表示新規定「生效」。

phrases.stem: When the vase was broken, the little boy tried to ____ his sister, but his mother knew the truth.
phrases.zh: shift the blame onto：把責任推給（某人）
phrases.ex: but his mother knew the truth 表示他想「嫁禍」姊姊。

phrases.stem: When the disease spread through the city, the young doctor had to ____ her own fears and calmly treat her patients.
phrases.zh: set aside：把（情緒）擱在一旁；（另一義）撥出（時間、金錢）
phrases.ex: her own fears ... calmly treat 表示要「放下」恐懼。

phrases.stem: After a careful check, the player was ____ of using drugs and allowed to play in the final game.
phrases.zh: clear sb. of：洗清（某人的嫌疑）
phrases.ex: allowed to play in the final 表示他被「證明清白」。
dist: accuse sb. of：指控（與 allowed to play 相反）

phrases.stem: The flood ____ the village of its only bridge, and the children could no longer get to school.
phrases.zh: rob A of B：奪走 A 的 B
phrases.ex: its only bridge ... could no longer get to school 表示洪水「奪走」了橋。

phrases.stem: The smell of fresh bread always ____ me of my grandmother's kitchen on Sunday mornings.
phrases.ex: smell ... my grandmother's kitchen 表示氣味「讓我想起」奶奶的廚房。
dist: remember：記得（不用 remember sb. of）

phrases.stem: A broken leg ____ him from playing in the final game, so he had to watch it from the bench.
phrases.zh: prevent sb. from V-ing：阻止某人做
phrases.ex: so he had to watch it from the bench 表示斷腿「使他無法」上場。
dist: protect sb. from：保護（語意不合）

phrases.stem: Many people ____ the government for the high price of houses, but others say it is simply the market.
phrases.zh: blame A for B：把 B 歸咎於 A
phrases.ex: high price of houses ... but others say 表示有人「怪罪」政府。

phrases.stem: During his long and lonely years abroad, he ____ his mother's letters, which he read again and again.
phrases.ex: long and lonely years ... read again and again 表示信給他「安慰」。

phrases.stem: The guilt of telling a lie to her best friend ____ her heavily for days, and she finally told her the truth.
phrases.ex: The guilt ... heavily ... finally told her the truth 表示罪惡感「壓在心上」。

phrases.stem: The teacher had a hard time keeping the excited students under ____ during the field trip to the zoo.
phrases.ex: excited students 表示老師難以「管住」學生。

phrases.stem: For Amy, who has lived in Tokyo for ten years, ordering food in Japanese is ____.
phrases.zh: a piece of cake：輕而易舉
phrases.ex: lived in Tokyo for ten years 表示用日文點餐「很簡單」。
dist: the last straw：最後一根稻草
a drop in the ocean：杯水車薪

phrases.stem: On the first day of school, the teacher played a name game with the new students to ____.
phrases.zh: break the ice：打破僵局、化解陌生
phrases.ex: first day ... new students 表示玩遊戲來「破冰」。

phrases.stem: A ticket to the World Cup final can ____, so most fans watch the game on TV at home instead.
options: cost an arm and a leg
phrases.zh: cost an arm and a leg：非常昂貴
phrases.ex: so most fans watch the game on TV 表示門票「貴得要命」。
dist: work like a charm：非常有效

phrases.stem: When my mother said I was always tired because I played games all night, she ____; that was the real reason.
options: hit the nail on the head
phrases.zh: hit the nail on the head：一針見血、說中要害
phrases.ex: that was the real reason 表示媽媽「說中了」。

phrases.stem: The broken window was only ____; when we went inside, we found that the whole house had been badly damaged by water.
phrases.zh: the tip of the iceberg：冰山一角
phrases.ex: when we went inside ... the whole house 表示破窗只是「冰山一角」。
dist: a piece of cake：輕而易舉
a grain of salt：（半信半疑）

phrases.stem: Breaking his leg turned out to be ____; while resting at home, he started writing the novel that made him famous.
phrases.zh: a blessing in disguise：因禍得福
phrases.ex: Breaking his leg ... the novel that made him famous 表示「因禍得福」。
dist: a piece of cake：輕而易舉
a drop in the ocean：杯水車薪

phrases.stem: My brother is so busy with his work in Europe that he calls our parents only ____, maybe twice a year.
phrases.zh: once in a blue moon：難得一次、極少
phrases.ex: maybe twice a year 表示「很少」打電話。

phrases.stem: The workers asked again and again for safer machines, but their requests ____ until a serious accident happened.
phrases.zh: fall on deaf ears：被當作耳邊風
phrases.ex: again and again ... until a serious accident 表示請求「沒人理會」。
dist: work like a charm：非常有效

phrases.stem: Putting a little salt on the floor to keep the ants away ____; we haven't seen a single one since then.
options: cost an arm and a leg
phrases.zh: work like a charm：非常有效
phrases.ex: haven't seen a single one since 表示方法「超有效」。
dist: fall on deaf ears：被當耳邊風
cost an arm and a leg：非常昂貴

phrases.stem: Telling teenagers not to do something sometimes ____; it only makes them want to do it even more.
phrases.zh: have the opposite effect：適得其反
phrases.ex: makes them want to do it even more 表示「適得其反」。
dist: work like a charm：非常有效（方向相反）
go according to plan：照計畫進行（方向相反）
pay off：有回報、成功（方向相反）

phrases.stem: The rescue ____: all twelve climbers were brought down the mountain safely before the storm arrived.
phrases.zh: go according to plan：按計畫順利進行
phrases.ex: all twelve climbers ... safely 表示救援「照計畫完成」。
dist: fall on deaf ears：被當耳邊風
have the opposite effect：適得其反

phrases.stem: To ____ on planning the class trip, our class leader asked everyone to vote on where we should go.
phrases.zh: get the ball rolling：開始著手、帶頭起步
phrases.ex: asked everyone to vote 表示先「開個頭」。

phrases.stem: My father and I don't always ____ about politics, but we never let it hurt our relationship.
phrases.zh: see eye to eye：意見一致
phrases.ex: but we never let it hurt our relationship 表示兩人「意見不一定相同」。
dist: turn a blind eye：視而不見

phrases.stem: When Ben joined the new school, some classmates gave him ____ and refused to sit with him at lunch.
phrases.zh: give sb. the cold shoulder：冷落某人
phrases.ex: refused to sit with him 表示同學「冷落」他。
dist: a warm welcome：熱烈歡迎（方向相反）
a piece of cake：輕而易舉

phrases.stem: My sister's plane is landing in the middle of the storm, so I'm ____ that it will arrive safely.
phrases.zh: keep one's fingers crossed：祈求好運
phrases.ex: that it will arrive safely 表示「祈禱」平安。

phrases.stem: The coach ____ after the terrible game, telling the players clearly that they had played like children.
phrases.zh: pull no punches：毫不留情、直言不諱
phrases.ex: telling the players clearly ... like children 表示教練「直言不諱」。
dist: beat around the bush：拐彎抹角（方向相反）

phrases.stem: If you want a raise, don't spend twenty minutes ____; just tell your boss clearly what you want.
options: hitting the nail on the head
phrases.zh: beat around the bush：拐彎抹角
phrases.ex: just tell your boss clearly 形成對比，表示別「拐彎抹角」。
dist: hit the nail on the head：一針見血

phrases.stem: During the election, the newspaper ____ and refused to support either of the two candidates.
phrases.zh: sit on the fence：保持中立、騎牆觀望
phrases.ex: refused to support either 表示報社「不表態」。

phrases.stem: The small old wooden house looks ____ among the tall glass buildings in the city center.
phrases.ex: among the tall glass buildings 表示老木屋「格格不入」。

phrases.stem: The movie tried hard to be funny, but most of its jokes ____, and few people in the theater laughed.
options: cost an arm and a leg
phrases.ex: few people ... laughed 表示笑話「沒效果」。
dist: work like a charm：非常有效（方向相反）
cost an arm and a leg：非常昂貴

phrases.stem: Leaving all your studying until the night before the exam is ____; you will be too tired to remember anything.
phrases.zh: a recipe for disaster：必定導致災難的做法
phrases.ex: too tired to remember anything 表示這樣做「注定失敗」。
dist: a piece of cake：輕而易舉
a drop in the ocean：杯水車薪

phrases.stem: The man I shared an apartment with never washed his dishes, but when he ate my birthday cake, that was ____; I moved out the next week.
phrases.zh: the last straw：壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草
phrases.ex: never washed ... but when he ate my cake ... moved out 表示忍無可忍。
dist: the tip of the iceberg：冰山一角
a drop in the ocean：杯水車薪

phrases.stem: It's getting dark, and we've already caught ten fish. Let's ____ and go home before it gets cold.
phrases.zh: call it a day：到此為止、收工
phrases.ex: getting dark ... go home 表示「收工」。

phrases.stem: The mayor is ____ after reporters found that he had used public money to pay for a family trip.
phrases.ex: used public money ... 被發現，表示市長「惹上麻煩」。

phrases.stem: We were going to tell everyone about the new baby at dinner, but my aunt ____ by mentioning it on the phone that morning.
options: let the cat out of the bag
phrases.zh: let the cat out of the bag：洩漏秘密
phrases.ex: going to tell everyone ... but my aunt ... mentioning it 表示阿姨「說溜嘴」。
dist: rain cats and dogs：下傾盆大雨

phrases.stem: With food prices rising quickly, many families find it hard to ____ at the end of each month.
phrases.zh: make ends meet：收支平衡、勉強維持生計
phrases.ex: food prices rising 表示很難「收支平衡」。

phrases.stem: The police asked the thief who had helped him, but he refused to ____ and kept quiet the whole time.
phrases.zh: spill the beans：洩密、說出實情
phrases.ex: refused to ... and kept quiet 表示他不肯「招出」同夥。

phrases.stem: When a salesperson says a product will change your whole life, you should take it with ____.
phrases.zh: take ... with a grain of salt：對…半信半疑
phrases.ex: change your whole life 誇大其詞，所以要「半信半疑」。
dist: a piece of cake：輕而易舉

phrases.stem: I've said I'm sorry and explained everything that happened. Now ____: you can forgive me or not.
options: the ball is in your court
phrases.zh: the ball is in your court：該你做決定了
phrases.ex: you can forgive me or not 表示「輪到你決定」。
dist: the coast is clear：四下無人、安全了
it's a piece of cake：很簡單
it's raining cats and dogs：下傾盆大雨

phrases.stem: You have already sold the car. There's no point ____ now; just learn from it and move on.
phrases.zh: cry over spilled milk：為無法挽回的事懊悔
phrases.ex: already sold ... learn from it and move on 表示別再「後悔」。

phrases.stem: When the typhoon closed the airport, all the travelers were ____, so they shared food and stories while they waited.
phrases.zh: in the same boat：同舟共濟、處境相同
phrases.ex: all the travelers ... shared food 表示大家「處境相同」。
dist: on top of the world：欣喜若狂

phrases.stem: On his first day at the restaurant, an older waiter helped Tim ____ by showing him how everything worked.
phrases.zh: learn the ropes：學會訣竅、熟悉工作
phrases.ex: first day ... showing him how everything worked 表示幫他「上手」。

phrases.stem: Some restaurants ____ by cooking with cheap, old oil, which can make their customers sick.
phrases.ex: cheap, old oil ... make customers sick 表示餐廳「偷工減料」。

phrases.stem: Planting a few trees in the city is only ____ compared with the huge forests that are cut down every year.
phrases.zh: a drop in the ocean：杯水車薪、微不足道
phrases.ex: a few trees ... compared with the huge forests 表示「微不足道」。
dist: the last straw：最後一根稻草
a grain of salt：（半信半疑）

phrases.stem: The doctor gave him clear advice about his diet, and this time he decided to ____ it, eating less sugar and walking every day.
phrases.zh: act on：根據（建議）採取行動
phrases.ex: eating less sugar and walking every day 說明他真的「照建議去做」。

phrases.stem: To help the younger kids understand the story, the teachers ____ the whole fairy tale on stage, with funny voices and colorful costumes.
phrases.ex: on stage、funny voices、costumes 說明是「演出」故事。

phrases.stem: Her story just doesn't ____: she said she was home all night, but her neighbor saw her car leave at ten.
phrases.zh: add up：合乎邏輯；（數字）加起來對得上
phrases.ex: 冒號後說明說法前後矛盾，所以「說不通、不合理」。

phrases.stem: Our cat has been missing since Sunday, so I'm going to ____ the neighborhood to find out if anyone has seen her.
phrases.ex: to find out if anyone has seen her 說明是「到處打聽」。

phrases.stem: The coach usually stays calm, but when his players stopped trying in the second half, he finally ____ at them during the break.
phrases.ex: usually stays calm 與 finally 形成對比，表示他終於「發火」。
dist: took off：起飛；脫下；突然成功

phrases.stem: The wind was so strong that it ____ the small fire we had made, and we had to start it again with dry leaves.
phrases.ex: had to start it again 說明火被風「吹熄」了。

phrases.stem: People give many reasons for failing a diet, but success really ____ one thing: whether you can keep going when it gets hard.
phrases.ex: 冒號後只剩一個關鍵，表示「歸結為」這件事。

phrases.stem: While the shop owner was out at lunch, a thief ____ through the back window and took all the money from the register.
phrases.ex: through the back window 與 took all the money 說明小偷「闖入」。

phrases.stem: Since I haven't played the piano for years, I need to ____ my skills before I perform at my sister's wedding next month.
phrases.zh: brush up on：複習、重溫（生疏的技能）
phrases.ex: haven't played for years 與 before I perform 說明要「複習、重溫」技巧。

phrases.stem: If you keep studying until three in the morning every night, you will ____ long before the exam, so get some sleep.
phrases.ex: so get some sleep 說明熬夜會讓人「精疲力竭」。

phrases.stem: Passengers should ____ at the airline counter at least two hours before an international flight to leave enough time for security.
phrases.ex: at the airline counter 與 before an international flight 說明是「報到」。

phrases.stem: While I'm away this weekend, could you ____ my dog once or twice and make sure he has enough water?
phrases.ex: make sure he has enough water 說明是「去看看狀況」。

phrases.stem: My grandfather felt lonely after moving to the new apartment, so we sent him funny videos every day to ____.
phrases.zh: cheer up：使振作、使高興起來
phrases.ex: felt lonely 與 funny videos 說明是要「讓他開心起來」。

phrases.stem: The city asked volunteers to help ____ the beach after the typhoon left trash and broken branches everywhere.
phrases.ex: trash and broken branches everywhere 說明要「清理」海灘。

phrases.stem: His skin problem ____ after he stopped eating fried food, and his face looked healthy again within a month.
phrases.ex: looked healthy again 說明皮膚問題「好轉、消退」。

phrases.stem: The factory will ____ next year, and all three hundred workers there will have to look for new jobs.
phrases.zh: close down：（商店、工廠）歇業、關閉
phrases.ex: all workers will have to look for new jobs 說明工廠要「關閉」。

phrases.stem: In the interview, try not to ____ too proud; talk about your team's success, not just your own.
phrases.ex: talk about your team's success 說明不要「給人」驕傲的印象。

phrases.stem: After the long run, walk slowly for five minutes to let your body ____ before you sit down.
phrases.ex: after the long run 與 walk slowly 說明讓身體「冷卻、緩和」。

phrases.stem: When you finish a task on your list, ____ that task with a red pen so you can see how much you have done.
phrases.ex: finish each task 說明完成一項就「劃掉」一項。

phrases.stem: Some people worry that small family-run shops will ____ as more and more people buy everything online.
phrases.zh: die out：（物種、習俗）消失、絕跡
phrases.ex: as more people buy online 說明小店會「消失、絕跡」。

phrases.stem: Every morning, the teacher waits patiently at the front of the room until the noise ____ and everyone is ready to listen.
phrases.zh: die down：（風雨、聲音）逐漸平息
phrases.ex: waits patiently until 與 ready to listen 說明吵鬧聲「漸漸平息」。

phrases.stem: During the camping trip, we had to ____ hot showers and phone signals for three whole days.
phrases.ex: for three whole days 說明三天「沒有……也得過」。

phrases.stem: The city plans to ____ the old parking rules, which most drivers find confusing and unfair.
phrases.ex: confusing and unfair 說明要「廢除」舊規定。

phrases.stem: He usually wears jeans and T-shirts, but he ____ in a suit and tie for his sister's wedding.
phrases.ex: usually wears jeans 與 suit and tie 對比，表示他「盛裝打扮」。

phrases.stem: Ken planned to stay in Paris for only a week, but he fell in love with the city and ____ living there for ten years.
phrases.ex: planned only a week 與 ten years 對比，表示「最後竟然」住了十年。

phrases.stem: Instead of blaming others, the team leader chose to ____ his own mistakes and apologized to everyone.
phrases.zh: face up to：勇敢面對（困難、事實）
phrases.ex: Instead of blaming others 與 apologized 說明是「勇敢面對」自己的錯。

phrases.stem: When I checked my bank account, I ____ that someone had used my card to buy things online.
phrases.ex: checked my bank account 說明是「發現」被盜刷。

phrases.stem: Many workers believe that the only way to ____ in this company is to work late every night.
phrases.ex: in this company 與 work late every night 說明是「出人頭地、升遷」。

phrases.stem: After being laughed at in front of the class, Leo spent weeks planning how to ____ the boys who had done it.
phrases.ex: being laughed at 與 planning 說明要「報復」那群男生。

phrases.stem: Having ____ in a big family, Jenny is used to sharing her room and her toys with others.
phrases.ex: in a big family 與 used to sharing 說明她是在大家庭「長大」的。

phrases.stem: These shoes were too big for my daughter last year, but she ____ them in just a few months.
phrases.zh: grow out of：長大後擺脫（習慣、恐懼）
phrases.ex: were too big last year 說明她很快就「長大穿不下」。
dist: made up for：彌補；不及格不是彌補

phrases.stem: Instead of studying, my brother likes to ____ at the coffee shop near our school and chat with his friends.
phrases.zh: hang out：閒晃、和朋友混在一起
phrases.ex: chat with his friends 說明是「閒晃、消磨時間」。

phrases.stem: The small shop lost money for two years, but the owner ____, and business finally got better last spring.
phrases.zh: hang on：緊抓不放；堅持下去
phrases.ex: lost money for two years 與 finally got better 說明老闆「撐住、堅持下去」。

phrases.stem: As soon as school was over, the children grabbed their bags and ____ the playground across the street.
phrases.ex: grabbed their bags 說明是「朝……前進」遊樂場。

phrases.stem: Before the new system starts, we'll run a short test to ____ any problems that users might find.
phrases.zh: iron out：解決（小問題）、消除分歧
phrases.ex: before the new system starts 說明是先「解決、消除」問題。

phrases.stem: The school year will ____ with a welcome party for all the new students in the gym.
phrases.ex: school year will ____ with a welcome party 說明以派對「開始」。

phrases.stem: Rather than ____ any staff during the hard times, the boss decided to cut his own pay by half.
phrases.ex: Instead of 與 cut his own pay 說明老闆不想「裁員」。

phrases.stem: When you fill in the form, don't ____ your phone number, or we will not be able to contact you.
phrases.ex: or we will not be able to contact you 說明不要「漏掉」電話。

phrases.stem: When she moved to the city for college, she had to ____ her friends and her quiet life in the village.
phrases.ex: moved to the city 說明她必須「拋下」朋友與鄉村生活。

phrases.stem: My little sister has worked so hard for this piano contest; whatever the results are, I am sure she will not ____ her teacher.
phrases.ex: 她非常努力，一定不會讓老師「失望」。

phrases.stem: The children ____ in two rows outside the classroom, waiting quietly for the teacher to let them in.
phrases.ex: in two rows 與 waiting 說明是「排隊」。

phrases.stem: Everyone said the movie was the best of the year, but it didn't ____ all the excitement, and I left feeling bored.
phrases.zh: live up to：達到、不辜負（期望）
phrases.ex: left feeling bored 說明電影「不如」大家說的那樣好。

phrases.stem: The store owner forgot to ____ the shop last night, and someone walked in and took money from the register.
phrases.ex: forgot 與 someone walked in 說明他忘了「鎖門」。

phrases.stem: Please ____ with your email address and password before you leave a message on our website.
phrases.ex: with your email address and password 說明是「登入」。

phrases.stem: Years later, many soldiers ____ the war with sadness, remembering the friends who never came home.
phrases.ex: years later 與 remembering 說明是「回顧」戰爭。

phrases.stem: Before signing the contract, the lawyer carefully ____ every page to make sure nothing was missing.
phrases.ex: carefully every page 說明是「仔細翻閱、瀏覽」。

phrases.stem: The two words 'desert' and 'dessert' look so similar that many students ____ when they write.
phrases.ex: look so similar 說明學生常把兩字「搞混」。
dist: make them up：編造；和好；組成

phrases.stem: After the fight with her best friend, Amy decided to forgive her and ____ instead of thinking about it every day.
phrases.zh: move on：放下過去、繼續前進
phrases.ex: instead of thinking about it every day 說明要「放下、往前走」。

phrases.stem: The police ____ the list of suspects from twenty to just two after checking everyone's phone records.
phrases.ex: from twenty to just two 說明是「縮小範圍」。

phrases.stem: After a few meetings with the counselor, the quiet girl finally started to ____ about the pressure she felt at home.
phrases.ex: quiet 與 finally started 說明她開始「敞開心房」談壓力。

phrases.stem: When the hotel was full, we ____ a small cabin by the lake, which turned out to be even better.
phrases.ex: hotel was full 說明只好「選擇」小木屋。
dist: cared for：照顧；喜歡；語意不通

phrases.stem: When the store owner showed the video, the boy finally ____ taking the chocolate and paid for it.
phrases.ex: showed the video 與 paid for it 說明他終於「承認」拿了巧克力。

phrases.stem: The school will ____ the old textbooks gradually, and by next year every student will use the new ones.
phrases.ex: gradually 與 every student will use the new ones 說明是「逐步淘汰」舊課本。
dist: phase in：逐步引進，方向相反

phrases.stem: Truly successful people often ____ their achievements, saying they were just lucky, because they don't want to seem proud.
phrases.ex: saying they were just lucky 說明他們「淡化」成就。
dist: play up：強調、誇大，方向相反

phrases.stem: During the tour, the guide ____ several buildings that were more than three hundred years old.
phrases.ex: several buildings 說明導遊「指出」那些建築。

phrases.stem: Feeling suddenly sleepy on the highway, my father decided to ____ and rest for twenty minutes before driving on.
phrases.ex: rest for twenty minutes before driving on 說明要「把車停到路邊」。

phrases.stem: The small company almost closed during the economic crisis, but it ____ and is now bigger than ever.
phrases.ex: almost closed 與 bigger than ever 說明公司「撐過難關」。

phrases.stem: Planning a surprise party for 200 people without my mother finding out seemed impossible, but my father ____.
phrases.zh: pull off：（克服困難）成功完成
phrases.ex: seemed impossible, but 說明爸爸竟然「成功辦到」。

phrases.stem: The police have not yet ____ the possibility that the fire at the old warehouse was started on purpose.
phrases.ex: have not ____ the possibility 說明警方尚未「排除」縱火可能。

phrases.stem: You shouldn't ____ buying a house; compare prices and visit different areas before you decide.
phrases.ex: compare prices before you decide 說明不要「倉促做」決定。

phrases.stem: Her whole family came to the train station to ____ when she left home to start college in the north.
phrases.ex: came to the station 與 when she left home 說明是「送行」。

phrases.stem: The salesman kept smiling and saying the car was perfect, but my father ____ his act and refused to buy it.
phrases.ex: refused to buy it 說明爸爸「看穿」推銷員的把戲。

phrases.stem: The new phone was so popular that it ____ in most stores on the first day.
phrases.ex: so popular 與 on the first day 說明手機「賣光」。

phrases.stem: Because of the dangerous storm, officials decided to ____ the airport for two days, and hundreds of flights were cancelled.
phrases.zh: shut down：（機器、工廠）關閉、停止運轉
phrases.ex: hundreds of flights were cancelled 說明機場「關閉」。

phrases.stem: I've decided to ____ a cooking class at the community center because I'm tired of eating instant noodles.
phrases.ex: tired of instant noodles 說明要「報名」烹飪課。

phrases.stem: Out of the hundreds of photos in the contest, the judges ____ Lily's picture of an old fisherman for first prize.
phrases.ex: out of hundreds 與 for first prize 說明評審「挑出」她的作品。

phrases.stem: The two sisters argued for days about who would get the bigger room, but their mother finally ____ the problem.
phrases.ex: argued for days 與 finally 說明媽媽終於「解決」了問題。

phrases.stem: The microphone isn't working, so you'll have to ____ if you want the people at the back to hear you.
phrases.ex: microphone isn't working 與 hear you 說明要「大聲一點」。
dist: cheer up：使振作、使高興起來

phrases.stem: After twenty years as the head of the company, Mr. Lee decided to ____ and let a younger leader take over.
phrases.ex: let a younger leader take over 說明他要「下台、辭職」。
dist: step up：加強；挺身而出，方向相反

phrases.stem: With the final exams only a month away, Jenny has ____ her efforts and now studies four hours every night.
phrases.ex: only a month away 與 four hours every night 說明她「加強」努力。

phrases.stem: I wasn't going to buy the expensive jacket, but the friendly salesclerk ____ it by saying it looked perfect on me.
phrases.zh: talk sb into sth：說服某人做某事
phrases.ex: wasn't going to buy 與 looked perfect on me 說明店員「說服我買」。
dist: talked me out of：勸某人不要做，方向相反
let me in on：讓某人知道

phrases.stem: Max was ready to sell his old guitar, but his music teacher ____ it, saying it had a beautiful sound.
phrases.zh: talk sb out of：勸某人打消念頭
phrases.ex: was ready to sell 與 beautiful sound 說明老師「勸他不要」賣。
dist: talked him into：說服某人做，方向相反
put him up to：慫恿某人（做壞事）

phrases.stem: Many people were sad when the old cinema was ____, since they had watched their first movies there.
phrases.ex: old cinema 與 sad 說明戲院被「拆除」。

phrases.stem: The company offered me a job in another city. It's a big change, so I need some time to ____.
phrases.ex: a big change 與 need some time 說明要「仔細考慮」。
dist: make it up：編造；和好；組成

phrases.stem: Don't ____ the box the TV came in; we will need it if we have to send the TV back.
phrases.ex: we will need it 說明不要「丟掉」箱子。

phrases.stem: The little boy ate too much chocolate at the party and then ____ all over the back seat of the car.
phrases.ex: ate too much chocolate 說明他「吐了」。
dist: took off：起飛；脫下；突然成功

phrases.stem: Before buying the hiking boots, Amy wanted to ____ both sizes to see which one was more comfortable.
phrases.ex: see which size is more comfortable 說明是「試穿」。

phrases.stem: The engineers will ____ the new robot in the factory for a month before they decide to buy more.
phrases.ex: for a month before they decide 說明是「試用」機器人。

phrases.stem: After the rain stopped, the little stream ____ a fast river that was too dangerous to cross.
phrases.ex: too dangerous to cross 說明小溪「變成」急流。

phrases.stem: The children ____ all the paper in the printer making cards, so I couldn't print my report.
phrases.ex: couldn't print my report 說明紙「用光」了。

phrases.stem: Many parents only ____ the problem of their kids' phone use when their grades start to drop.
phrases.ex: only when grades start to drop 說明家長那時才「意識到」問題。

phrases.stem: The singer was ____ her voice backstage, singing a few easy songs before going on stage.
phrases.ex: singing a few easy songs before going on stage 說明是「暖身」。

phrases.stem: ____ for pickpockets in the train station; they often work in groups and look like normal travelers.
phrases.ex: pickpockets 說明要「小心」扒手。

phrases.stem: A single bad investment ____ all the money the family had saved over twenty years.
phrases.ex: all the money saved over twenty years 說明積蓄「全部化為烏有」。

phrases.stem: During the lecture, Ben tried to ____ every word the professor said, but he couldn't write fast enough.
phrases.ex: couldn't write fast enough 說明他想「寫下」每個字。

phrases.stem: Jack and his new roommate soon became close friends because they had so much ____: both loved hiking, cooking, and old movies.
phrases.ex: 冒號後列出兩人共同喜好，所以是「有很多共同點」。

phrases.stem: The report describes the accident ____, including the time, the weather, the speed of each car, and what every driver said.
phrases.ex: including 後列出大量細節，說明是「詳細地」描述。

phrases.stem: ____, children learn languages faster than adults, though some adults also become fluent in a short time.
phrases.ex: though some adults 是例外，前半句講的是「一般而言」。

phrases.stem: The famous actor rarely appears ____ these days; he stays at home and avoids reporters and cameras.
phrases.ex: avoids reporters and cameras 說明他很少「公開」露面。

phrases.stem: The two leaders met ____ before the conference, and no reporters were allowed to hear what they discussed.
phrases.ex: no reporters were allowed 說明是「私下」見面。

phrases.stem: The whole city was damaged by the storm, but the old town ____ was badly hit, losing nearly half its houses.
phrases.ex: The whole city 與 the old town 對比，指「尤其、特別」是老城區。

phrases.stem: ____ the rising number of traffic accidents, the city has put up more speed cameras near schools.
phrases.ex: accidents 增加 → 加裝測速照相，是「回應」問題。
dist: In memory of：紀念；語意不通

phrases.stem: My neighbor fixed my bike, and ____ his kindness, I baked him a chocolate cake.
phrases.ex: his kindness 與 baked him a cake 說明是「作為回報」。
dist: in search of：尋找；語意不通

phrases.stem: Every summer, thousands of young people leave the countryside and move to big cities ____ better jobs.
phrases.ex: leave the countryside 是為了「尋找」更好的工作。
dist: in memory of：紀念；語意不通

phrases.stem: Lisa tried three different jobs after college, and ____ she decided to open her own bakery.
phrases.ex: tried three jobs 之後，「最後」決定開店。
dist: in the way：擋路；語意不通

phrases.stem: The plumber can't come until Friday; ____, put a bucket under the pipe to catch the water.
phrases.ex: can't come until Friday 說明在等待的「這段期間」先放水桶。

phrases.stem: The firefighters arrived just ____ to save the sleeping family before the burning roof fell in on them.
phrases.ex: just ____ to save … before the roof fell in 說明是「及時」趕到。

phrases.stem: If you keep forgetting to hand in your homework, you'll be ____ with the teacher sooner or later.
phrases.ex: keep forgetting homework 說明會「惹上麻煩」。

phrases.stem: ____ the big swimming pool it already has, the new sports center will also offer a gym, two tennis courts, and a climbing wall.
phrases.ex: 後面列出泳池以外還有的設施，表示「除了……還有」。

phrases.stem: ____ the wishes of the old woman, her ashes were scattered over the sea she had loved all her life.
phrases.ex: wishes 與 ashes were scattered 說明是「依照」她的心願。

phrases.stem: ____ last year's dry summer, this summer has been very wet, with rain almost every afternoon.
phrases.ex: dry 與 very wet 對比，表示「與……相反」。
dist: In memory of：紀念；語意不通

phrases.stem: The small coffee shop offers a free cup of coffee ____ ten used bottles brought back by customers.
phrases.ex: free coffee 與 ten used bottles 說明是「拿……來交換」。

phrases.stem: A good team works ____ each other; everyone knows their role and helps the others when needed.
phrases.ex: helps the others 說明團隊「和諧相處」。

phrases.stem: Every year on her birthday, the family plants a tree ____ their grandmother, who passed away ten years ago.
phrases.ex: passed away 說明是「紀念」祖母。

phrases.stem: The school collects old coats every winter and gives them to people ____ who cannot afford warm clothes.
phrases.ex: cannot afford warm clothes 說明是「需要幫助的」人。

phrases.stem: Sorry I can't talk now; I'm ____ to catch the last train, so I'll call you tomorrow.
phrases.ex: can't talk now 與 catch the last train 說明「趕時間」。

phrases.stem: If you already knew the bridge was closed for repairs, why did you drive this way ____?
phrases.zh: in the first place：當初；首先
phrases.ex: why did you … 是質問「一開始、當初」為何這樣做。
dist: in the long run：長遠來看

phrases.stem: Many families stayed in the town ____ the coming storm, refusing to leave the homes they had lived in for years.
phrases.ex: refusing to leave 說明「面對」暴風雨仍留下。
dist: in search of：尋找；語意不通

phrases.stem: The company raised all workers' pay by five percent this year ____ the rising cost of living.
phrases.ex: raised pay 配合 rising cost of living，表示「與……一致」。

phrases.stem: Everyone thinks Emma is from Canada, but ____ she was born and raised in Australia.
phrases.ex: Everyone thinks … but 表示「事實上」並非如此。

phrases.stem: Sorry, am I ____? I'll move my chair so you can get to the window.
phrases.ex: move my chair so you can get to the window 說明擋到路。

phrases.stem: We stopped at a small village ____ to the beach and bought some fresh fruit for lunch.
phrases.ex: stopped at a village … to the beach 說明是「去途中」。
dist: in the way：擋路；語意不通

phrases.stem: ____, a person in Taiwan eats about fifty kilograms of rice a year, though the number varies from family to family.
phrases.ex: varies from family to family 說明是「平均」數字。

phrases.stem: Once everyone was ____, the captain closed the door and the small boat left the harbor.
phrases.ex: closed the door and the boat left 說明大家已「上船」。
dist: on edge：緊張不安、提心吊膽

phrases.stem: The winning designs from the student art contest will be ____ in the school library for two weeks.
phrases.ex: winning designs 與 in the library for two weeks 說明是「展出」。

phrases.stem: The driver escaped through the window just seconds before his car was ____ and then exploded on the highway.
phrases.ex: escaped 與 exploded 說明車子「著火」。

phrases.stem: The mountain path is too narrow for cars or bikes, so the only way to reach the temple is ____.
phrases.ex: too narrow for cars or bikes 說明只能「步行」。

phrases.stem: Our science teacher is always ____ in the lab to answer questions and help us with the equipment.
phrases.ex: answer questions and help us 說明老師一直「在場待命」。

phrases.stem: The math test wasn't easy at all. ____, it was the hardest one I've ever taken in my life.
phrases.ex: wasn't easy 之後語氣加強，表示「恰恰相反」。

phrases.stem: If you wait until after Christmas, many toys will be ____ at half the price.
phrases.ex: at half the price 說明是「特價」。

phrases.stem: Her headaches have come ____ for months; some days they're bad and other days she feels fine.
phrases.ex: some days bad, other days fine 說明是「斷斷續續」。
dist: once and for all：一勞永逸

phrases.stem: Please arrive ____ for tomorrow's job interview; being late will make a bad first impression on the manager.
phrases.ex: being late 說明要「準時」。

phrases.stem: Even though two workers got sick, the project is still ____, and we'll hand it in next Friday as planned.
phrases.ex: as planned 說明進度「如期」。

phrases.stem: With the typhoon close ____, families rushed to the stores to buy water and food.
phrases.ex: close ____ 與 rushed to buy 說明颱風「迫近」。

phrases.stem: To join the club, you must be ____ sixteen years old; younger students are not allowed.
phrases.ex: younger students are not allowed 說明「至少」十六歲。

phrases.stem: The bus ride takes twenty minutes ____, so you'll easily get there before the store closes at nine.
phrases.ex: you'll get there before the store closes 說明「最多」二十分鐘。

phrases.stem: My little brother can be annoying ____, but most of the time he's sweet, funny, and helpful.
phrases.ex: but usually sweet 說明他只是「有時候」煩人。

phrases.stem: The two runners crossed the finish line ____, so the judges had to look at the video to decide the winner.
phrases.ex: judges had to look at the video 說明兩人「同時」到達。

phrases.stem: The town built a large factory ____ its clean air; many people there now have trouble breathing.
phrases.zh: at the cost of：以…為代價
phrases.ex: many people now have trouble breathing 說明是「以犧牲」乾淨空氣為代價。
dist: at the mercy of：任由…擺布

phrases.stem: An experienced doctor can often tell ____ whether a child is seriously ill or just tired.
phrases.ex: experienced 與 can often tell 說明「一眼就」看出。

phrases.stem: I wasn't ____ during the game because I had a cold, and I missed several easy shots.
phrases.zh: at my best：處於最佳狀態
phrases.ex: had a cold 與 missed easy shots 說明狀態「不在最佳」。

phrases.stem: Jenny is busy studying for her exams ____, but she will be free to travel in July.
phrases.ex: busy now 與 free in July 對比，表示「目前」很忙。

phrases.stem: The rain stopped ____ after a whole week, and the children could finally play outside.
phrases.ex: after a whole week 與 finally 說明「終於」停了。

phrases.stem: ____, the new coach seemed strict and cold, but the players soon found that he really cared about them.
phrases.ex: seemed … but soon found 對比，表示「起初」。

phrases.stem: I found my old diary ____ while I was cleaning out the closet last weekend.
phrases.ex: while cleaning 意外發現，表示「偶然」。

phrases.stem: The prisoners escaped ____ a long tunnel that they had dug under the wall with spoons.
phrases.ex: a long tunnel 說明是「藉由」地道逃脫。

phrases.stem: Cats are curious ____, so they love to explore boxes, bags, and anything new in the house.
phrases.ex: love to explore anything new 說明貓「天生」好奇。

phrases.stem: I can't tell you ____ when the package will arrive, but it should be here by Friday.
phrases.ex: should be here by Friday 只是推測，所以無法「確定」。

phrases.stem: If you order two large pizzas tonight, you can get a big bottle of soda ____.
phrases.ex: buy two pizzas 送一瓶汽水，表示「免費」。

phrases.stem: Some animals can live for a very long time. Some turtles, ____, live for more than one hundred years.
phrases.ex: Some turtles 是前句的例子，表示「例如」。

phrases.stem: The two brothers agreed to stop fighting ____ their mother, who was tired of their arguments.
phrases.ex: who was tired of their arguments 說明是「為了」媽媽。

phrases.stem: The power went out, so we sat in the dark ____ until the lights came back on.
phrases.ex: until the lights came back on 說明是「一陣子」。

phrases.stem: The fire destroyed everything in the restaurant, so the owner had to start again ____.
phrases.ex: destroyed everything 說明必須「從頭開始」。

phrases.stem: My uncle lives abroad, but he calls us ____ to see how we are doing.
phrases.ex: lives abroad 但仍會「不時」打電話。

phrases.stem: Her first novel has been ____ for years, but the publisher plans to print it again next spring.
phrases.ex: plans to print it again 說明目前「絕版」。

phrases.stem: The new game console was so popular that it was ____ in every store by noon.
phrases.ex: so popular 與 in every store by noon 說明「缺貨」。

phrases.stem: My mother still keeps her old platform shoes, hoping they will come back in style even though they went ____ long ago.
phrases.ex: come back in style 與 long ago 說明鞋子早已「過時」。

phrases.stem: The food at the camp was simple, but ____—with no electricity and only one small stove—it tasted wonderful.
phrases.zh: under the circumstances：在這種情況下
phrases.ex: 破折號說明條件很差，表示「在這種情況下」。

phrases.stem: Swimmers should ____ enter the water when the red flag is flying, because the waves are too strong.
phrases.ex: the waves are too strong 說明「絕對不可」下水。
dist: under the circumstances：在這種情況下

phrases.stem: Keep a flashlight ____ beside your bed, so you can find it quickly if there is a power cut.
phrases.ex: find it quickly 說明要放在「伸手可及」處。

phrases.stem: This is ____ the most beautiful beach I have ever seen; the sand is white and the water is crystal clear.
phrases.ex: most beautiful … sand is white 說明「無疑」是最美的。

phrases.stem: The principal will hold a meeting next week ____ the new school rules about phone use.
phrases.ex: meeting 主題是新規定，表示「關於」。
dist: in search of：尋找；語意不通

phrases.stem: Some of the songs on the album are weak, but ____ it is still one of the best albums of the year.
phrases.ex: Some songs are weak 與 still one of the best 對比，指「整體而言」。

phrases.stem: The dog was sleeping peacefully when, ____, it jumped up and ran barking to the front door.
