phrases.ex: sleeping peacefully 與 jumped up 說明是「突然」。
dist: once and for all：一勞永逸
in the long run：長遠來看

phrases.stem: I'm tired of reminding you every day. Will you clean your room ____ and keep it clean?
phrases.zh: once and for all：一勞永逸
phrases.ex: tired of reminding every day 說明要「徹底、一勞永逸」解決。

phrases.stem: ____, the little plant grew taller, and by the end of summer it reached the top of the window.
phrases.ex: by the end of summer 說明是「逐漸」長高。

phrases.stem: The farmer works in the fields ____, rain or shine, and he has never complained once.
phrases.zh: day in and day out：日復一日
phrases.ex: rain or shine 說明他「日復一日」工作。

phrases.stem: Our family doesn't watch much TV, but ____ we rent a movie on Saturday night.
phrases.ex: doesn't watch much TV 說明只是「偶爾」看電影。
dist: day in and day out：日復一日

phrases.stem: If you keep telling lies to your friends, ____ they will stop trusting you and stop calling you.
phrases.ex: keep telling lies 的結果「遲早」會失去信任。
dist: day in and day out：日復一日

phrases.stem: The two cars cost ____ the same, so I chose the one with the better color.
phrases.ex: cost the same 加上依顏色決定，表示價錢「差不多」。

phrases.stem: The teacher asked us to read the chapter ____ so that we could discuss it in class the next day.
phrases.ex: so that we could discuss it the next day 說明要「事先」讀。

phrases.stem: The news website is updated every hour, so the stories on it are always ____ and correct.
phrases.ex: updated every hour 說明新聞永遠「最新」。

phrases.stem: It's ____ the judges to decide who wins; the singers can only do their best.
phrases.ex: the judges to decide 說明「由評審決定」。

phrases.stem: Tom thought his teammates liked him, but they often made fun of him ____, which hurt him deeply when he finally found out.
phrases.ex: thought they liked him 與 when he finally found out 說明他們是「在背後」取笑他。

phrases.stem: The farmers lost most of their crops because of the sudden frost, which was completely ____.
phrases.zh: beyond their control：他們無法控制
phrases.ex: sudden frost 說明那是他們「無法控制」的。
dist: under their control：在他們控制之下
in their power：在他們能力範圍內
at their best：處於最佳狀態

phrases.stem: The engineer was so ____ fixing the machine that he didn't notice it had become dark outside the factory.
phrases.zh: be absorbed in：專心於、沉浸於
phrases.ex: didn't notice it had become dark 說明他「全神貫注」。

phrases.stem: Some people become ____ sugar; they feel tired and upset if they go a single day without eating sweets.
phrases.zh: be addicted to：沉迷於、對…上癮
phrases.ex: feel upset without sweets 說明對糖「上癮」。

phrases.stem: The student felt deeply ____ himself for copying his friend's homework, and he told the teacher the truth the next day.
phrases.ex: copying homework 與 told the truth 說明他「感到羞愧」。

phrases.stem: Many seniors are ____ finding a job after graduation, since the economy has been weak for years.
phrases.ex: economy has been weak 說明他們對找工作「焦慮」。
dist: familiar with：熟悉；故事不會熟悉證詞

phrases.stem: Our coach is fully ____ helping every player improve, staying after practice almost every night to give extra lessons.
phrases.ex: staying after practice every night 說明他「全心投入」。

phrases.stem: Scientists are ____ the rapid melting of the ice in the Arctic because it may raise sea levels around the world.
phrases.ex: may raise sea levels 說明科學家「擔憂」。

phrases.stem: Instead of always wanting the newest phone, she is ____ the old one she has had for five years.
phrases.ex: Instead of always wanting the newest phone 說明她對舊手機「感到滿足」。

phrases.stem: The old musician was ____ teaching young people traditional music, giving free lessons every weekend until he was ninety.
phrases.zh: be dedicated to：致力於、奉獻於
phrases.ex: free lessons until ninety 說明他「致力於」教學。

phrases.stem: After spending two hours in the hot sun, the workers were ____ a cold drink and a place to rest.
phrases.ex: hot sun 與 cold drink 說明他們「渴望」得到飲料。

phrases.stem: The scientists at the university are ____ research on new ways to turn ocean waves into electricity.
phrases.ex: research 說明他們「從事」研究。

phrases.stem: Because you bought the TV less than a year ago, you are ____ a free repair under the store's policy.
phrases.ex: less than a year 與 store's policy 說明有「權利」免費維修。

phrases.stem: The young lawyer proved that she was ____ the challenge, winning her very first case against a famous opponent.
phrases.ex: winning her very first case 說明她「能勝任」。

phrases.stem: Workers in the factory are ____ loud noise all day, so they must wear special ear covers.
phrases.zh: be exposed to：暴露於、接觸到
phrases.ex: must wear ear covers 說明他們「暴露於」噪音中。

phrases.stem: Before driving in a foreign country, you should become ____ the local traffic rules to avoid getting a ticket.
phrases.zh: be familiar with：（人）熟悉（某事物）
phrases.ex: to avoid getting a ticket 說明要「熟悉」規則。

phrases.stem: The old man's face looked ____ me, and later I realized he had been my primary school principal.
phrases.zh: be/sound familiar to：（事物）為某人所熟悉
phrases.ex: later I realized 說明臉看起來「眼熟」。

phrases.stem: This tea is completely ____ sugar and chemicals, so it is a healthy choice for people on a diet.
phrases.ex: healthy choice 說明茶「沒有」糖和化學物。

phrases.stem: The family was deeply ____ the firefighters who saved their dog from the burning house.
phrases.zh: be grateful to sb for sth：感謝某人
phrases.ex: saved their dog 說明全家「感激」消防員。

phrases.stem: The company was found ____ polluting the river and had to pay a large fine to the city.
phrases.ex: had to pay a large fine 說明被判「有罪」。

phrases.stem: Some bacteria have become ____ common medicines, so doctors now need stronger drugs to treat them.
phrases.ex: need stronger drugs 說明細菌對藥物「免疫」。

phrases.stem: The island wants to become ____ imported oil by using wind and solar power instead.
phrases.zh: be independent of：不依賴、獨立於
phrases.ex: by using wind and solar power instead 說明想「不依賴」進口石油。

phrases.stem: The manager seemed ____ the workers' complaints; he never replied to their emails or changed anything.
phrases.ex: never replied or changed anything 說明他「漠不關心」。

phrases.stem: Mark became ____ his best friend when the friend got the lead role in the play that Mark had wanted.
phrases.ex: the role that Mark had wanted 說明他「嫉妒」。

phrases.stem: My aunt is really ____ gardening; she spends every weekend planting flowers and talking about them.
phrases.zh: be keen on：熱衷於、很喜歡
phrases.ex: spends every weekend planting flowers 說明她「熱衷於」園藝。
dist: tired of：厭倦；不合無意間失禮

phrases.stem: Prices are ____ rise again next year because the cost of oil keeps going up.
phrases.ex: cost of oil keeps going up 說明價格「很可能」上漲。

phrases.stem: He is ____ cleanliness; he washes his hands over thirty times a day and won't let anyone touch his things.
phrases.zh: be obsessed with：著迷於、執著於
phrases.ex: thirty times a day 說明他「著迷、執著」於乾淨。
dist: familiar with：熟悉；故事不會熟悉證詞

phrases.stem: Many teachers are ____ the new rule that allows students to use phones in class, saying it will be a distraction.
phrases.ex: saying it will be a distraction 說明老師「反對」。

phrases.stem: The young chef was ____ the first restaurant she opened, and she happily showed every guest around the kitchen.
phrases.ex: happily showed every guest around 說明她「以……為傲」。
dist: tired of：厭倦；不合無意間失禮

phrases.stem: The police believe that the two robberies are ____ each other, since the same car was seen at both places.
phrases.ex: the same car was seen at both places 說明兩案「有關聯」。

phrases.stem: Many old people are ____ use online banking because they worry that their money could be stolen.
phrases.ex: worry that their money could be stolen 說明他們「不願意」使用。

phrases.stem: The coach was ____ his team's performance; they played hard and won by twenty points.
phrases.ex: played hard and won by twenty points 說明教練「滿意」。

phrases.stem: Dogs are very ____ sound, so the fireworks during the New Year can make them nervous and scared.
phrases.ex: fireworks make them nervous 說明狗對聲音「敏感」。

phrases.stem: The new building looks very ____ the old one; both have red walls and large round windows.
phrases.ex: both have red walls and large round windows 說明兩棟「相似」。

phrases.stem: All prices on this website are ____ change without notice, so check the final price before you pay.
phrases.zh: be subject to：可能受…影響、易遭受
phrases.ex: without notice 與 check the final price 說明價格「可能會」變動。

phrases.stem: The coach thinks this year's team is ____ last year's; the players are faster, stronger, and work better together.
phrases.ex: faster, stronger 說明今年的球隊「優於」去年。

phrases.stem: The guard became ____ the man carrying a large bag who kept walking around the bank without going inside.
phrases.ex: kept walking around without going inside 說明警衛「起疑」。

phrases.stem: Living with roommates teaches you to be ____ different habits, such as staying up late or playing loud music.
phrases.ex: living with roommates 與 different habits 說明要學會「容忍」。

phrases.stem: Heavy afternoon rain in summer is ____ the weather in Taipei; it happens almost every day in July.
phrases.zh: be typical of：是…的典型作風
phrases.ex: happens almost every day 說明這是台北天氣的「典型特色」。

phrases.stem: The young writer's first novel is ____ a major prize; it is beautifully written and deeply moving.
phrases.ex: beautifully written and deeply moving 說明作品「值得」得獎。

phrases.stem: This small village is ____ its hot springs, and people come from all over the island to relax there.
phrases.ex: people come from all over 說明村子「以……聞名」。

phrases.stem: Michael Jordan, ____ one of the greatest basketball players of all time, won six championships with the Chicago Bulls.
phrases.zh: be known as：被稱為、以…之名為人所知
phrases.ex: 同位語說明他「被稱為」最偉大球員之一。

phrases.stem: The teacher was ____ planning the school trip, so she knew every detail of the schedule.
phrases.ex: knew every detail 說明她「參與」規劃。

phrases.stem: The hospital is ____ nurses, so the ones who work there often have to stay for sixteen hours.
phrases.ex: have to stay for sixteen hours 說明醫院「缺乏」護士。

phrases.stem: After living in the small town for twenty years, Mr. Lin had become deeply ____ it and didn't want to move.
phrases.ex: didn't want to move 說明他對小鎮「有感情」。

phrases.stem: Bad weather may ____ the drop in the number of visitors to the night market this month.
phrases.ex: bad weather 是遊客減少的「原因」。

phrases.stem: New students usually need a few weeks to ____ the busy schedule and heavy homework of senior high school.
phrases.ex: need a few weeks 說明要「適應」。

phrases.stem: I ____ the doctor that we should walk at least thirty minutes a day; it really helps my health.
phrases.ex: it really helps my health 說明我「同意」醫生的看法。

phrases.stem: The principal does not ____ students wearing slippers to school, so he asked them to wear proper shoes.
phrases.ex: asked them to wear proper shoes 說明他「不贊成」穿拖鞋。

phrases.stem: The company ____ customer service, so every new worker spends a whole month learning how to talk to customers.
phrases.ex: spends a whole month learning 說明公司「重視」客服。
dist: turns a blind eye to：視而不見；方向相反
keeps pace with：跟上；語意不通

phrases.stem: Our coach ____ hard work more than talent; he says practice is the real key to winning.
phrases.ex: practice is the real key 說明他「相信」努力的價值。

phrases.stem: Old people who keep active can ____ regular exercise; it helps them sleep better and stay healthy.
phrases.ex: helps them sleep better 說明從運動「受益」。

phrases.stem: Every time he wins a game, Ken ____ his skills, so the other players find him annoying.
phrases.ex: the other players find him annoying 說明他「吹噓」。

phrases.stem: The nurses at the hospital ____ the patients with great patience, even during the busy night shifts.
phrases.ex: with great patience 說明護士「照顧」病人。

phrases.stem: Try not to ____ the top students in your class; just focus on doing a little better than you did last time.
phrases.zh: compare A with/to B：將A與B比較
phrases.ex: focus on doing better than last time 說明不要和別人「比較」。

phrases.stem: Several guests ____ the dirty rooms at the hotel, so the manager offered them a free night.
phrases.ex: manager offered them a free night 說明客人「抱怨」。
dist: cared for：照顧；喜歡；語意不通

phrases.stem: It's hard to ____ the road when your phone keeps ringing, so turn it off before you drive.
phrases.ex: phone keeps ringing 說明難以「專心」看路。

phrases.stem: Faced with the video evidence, the driver finally ____ hitting the parked car and driving away.
phrases.zh: confess to：承認、坦白（錯誤或罪行）
phrases.ex: faced with the video evidence 說明他「承認」。

phrases.stem: Every product sold in this country must ____ strict safety standards before it can be sold in stores.
phrases.ex: before it can be sold 說明必須「符合」標準。

phrases.stem: The landlord will only ____ letting us keep a cat in the apartment if we agree to pay for any damage.
phrases.ex: if we agree to pay for any damage 說明房東附條件「同意」。

phrases.stem: The weather in northern Taiwan can ____ that in the south a lot; it is often rainy in Taipei while Kaohsiung is sunny.
phrases.ex: rainy vs. sunny 說明兩地天氣「不同」。

phrases.stem: Even newborn babies seem to ____ the voices of strangers, since they stop crying as soon as she starts to speak.
phrases.ex: stop crying as soon as she speaks 說明嬰兒能「分辨」母親與陌生人的聲音。
dist: mistake their mother's voice for：把母親的聲音誤認為……
mix their mother's voice with：把母親的聲音和……混在一起
cover their mother's voice with：用……蓋過母親的聲音

phrases.stem: When she was a little girl, Mia often ____ living in a big house by the sea, and now she does.
phrases.ex: and now she does 說明她小時候「夢想」過。

phrases.stem: All the students in the class ____ the school's clean-up day, picking up trash in the park.
phrases.ex: picking up trash 說明學生「參加」清潔日。

phrases.stem: During the exam, try to ____ the questions you know first instead of wasting time on the hard ones.
phrases.ex: instead of wasting time 說明要「專注於」會的題目。

phrases.stem: Drinking coffee in the evening can ____ your ability to fall asleep, so try tea or milk instead.
phrases.ex: so try tea or milk instead 說明咖啡會「妨礙」入睡。

phrases.stem: Many older workers find it hard to ____ the fast changes in technology, so the company offers free computer classes.
phrases.ex: offers free computer classes 說明他們難以「跟上」。

phrases.stem: The city cut down some old trees to ____ a new road leading to the airport.
phrases.ex: cut down trees 是為了「騰出空間」給新路。

phrases.stem: The farmers ____ the rain by collecting it in large tanks and using it to water their crops.
phrases.ex: collecting it and using it 說明是「利用」雨水。
dist: turn a blind eye to：視而不見；方向相反

phrases.stem: I can't ____ which shirt to buy—the blue one looks nice, but the white one is cheaper.
phrases.zh: make up one's mind：下定決心、做決定
phrases.ex: blue looks nice but white is cheaper 說明「無法下決定」。
dist: mind my own business：少管閒事

phrases.stem: After the earthquake, volunteers ____ blankets and warm meals, since many had lost their homes.
phrases.ex: since many had lost their homes 說明志工「提供」物資。
dist: deprived the victims of：剝奪受害者的……
robbed the victims of：搶走受害者的……
warned the victims of：警告受害者……

phrases.stem: The audience didn't ____ the singer's jokes at all; nobody laughed, and some people even left early.
phrases.ex: nobody laughed 說明觀眾沒有「回應」。

phrases.stem: Some people need years to ____ the loss of a loved one, so be patient with them.
phrases.ex: need years 說明「從悲傷中恢復」。

phrases.stem: In his speech, the president did not ____ the problem directly, but everyone knew what he was talking about.
phrases.ex: everyone knew what he was talking about 說明他沒有直接「提及」。

phrases.stem: Firefighters must ____ every emergency call as quickly as possible, because even one minute can make a big difference.
phrases.ex: quickly 與 one minute can make a difference 說明要「回應」每通電話。

phrases.stem: Students who copy answers from the Internet ____ failing the course, since teachers now check every report.
phrases.zh: run the risk of：冒…的風險
phrases.ex: teachers now check every report 說明會「冒著」不及格的風險。

phrases.stem: Without a good coach and enough practice, our small school doesn't ____ beating the national champions.
phrases.zh: stand a chance of：有…的可能
phrases.ex: Without a good coach 說明我們沒有「機會」贏。
dist: run the risk of：冒…的風險

phrases.stem: For a healthier breakfast, you can ____ in your tea; it is more natural and tastes just as sweet.
phrases.ex: healthier 與 more natural 說明是「用蜂蜜代替糖」。
dist: substitute sugar for honey：用糖代替蜂蜜
add sugar to honey：把糖加進蜂蜜
turn honey into sugar：把蜂蜜變成糖

phrases.stem: After years of hard work, the small team finally ____ building a robot that could climb stairs.
phrases.ex: finally 說明他們「成功」做出機器人。

phrases.stem: People who live in big cities often ____ poor air quality, especially during the cold winter months.
phrases.ex: poor air quality 說明居民「受……之苦」。

phrases.stem: When the captain was hurt, the youngest player ____ the team and led them to victory.
phrases.ex: captain was hurt 與 led them to victory 說明他「接管」球隊。
dist: took pride in：以…為傲；失敗的計畫不會令人驕傲

phrases.stem: Before deciding where to live, you should ____ the cost of rent and the distance to your workplace.
phrases.ex: Before deciding 說明要「考慮」這些因素。
dist: turn a blind eye to：視而不見；方向相反

phrases.stem: The young farmer ____ her vegetables; she grows them without chemicals and checks each one by hand.
phrases.ex: checks each one by hand 說明她「以……自豪」。
dist: runs the risk of：冒…的風險
keeps pace with：跟上；語意不通

phrases.stem: Most of the players ____ the new coach, because he is fair and always explains his decisions clearly.
phrases.zh: think highly of：重視、高度評價
phrases.ex: fair and explains clearly 說明球員「很尊敬」他。

phrases.stem: The store owner could no longer ____ the children stealing chocolate, so he called their parents.
phrases.zh: turn a blind eye to：對…視而不見
phrases.ex: could no longer 與 called their parents 說明他不再「睜一隻眼閉一隻眼」。

phrases.stem: Your dog can stay in the hotel room ____ he is kept quiet and doesn't damage anything; otherwise you'll have to pay extra.
phrases.ex: otherwise you'll have to pay extra 說明是「只要」符合條件。

phrases.stem: I'll send you the photos ____ I get home tonight, so you can pick the best ones for the school website.
phrases.ex: I'll send … tonight 說明是「一……就」。

phrases.stem: ____ I know, the store is still open on Sundays, but you'd better call before you go just to make sure.
phrases.zh: as far as ... is concerned：就…而言
phrases.ex: you'd better call to make sure 說明只是「就我所知」。

phrases.stem: The new phone can be used to pay for the bus ____ to open the door of your apartment, so you can leave your wallet and keys at home.
phrases.ex: leave your wallet and keys at home 說明兩種用途都有，表示「以及」。

phrases.stem: ____ the long dry season, rice prices rose sharply because farmers could not grow enough crops.
phrases.zh: as a result of：由於、因為…的結果
phrases.ex: dry season 造成價格上漲，表示「由於……的結果」。

phrases.stem: The doctor said I should drink plain water, ____ sweet drinks like soda, if I want to lose weight.
phrases.zh: as opposed to：而不是、與…相對
phrases.ex: plain water 與 sweet drinks 對立，表示「而非」。

phrases.stem: The old man walked slowly through his empty house, touching every wall ____ he were saying goodbye to an old friend.
phrases.ex: he were（假設語氣）表示「彷彿」在道別。

phrases.stem: Write down your password and keep it in a safe place ____ you forget it.
phrases.ex: keep it in a safe place 是預防，表示「以防萬一」忘記。

phrases.stem: The family sold their car and moved to a smaller apartment ____ save money for their son's college education.
phrases.ex: save money for college 是目的，表示「為了」。
dist: so as not to：為了不要…

phrases.stem: He left the meeting room quietly ____ disturb the speaker, who was in the middle of an important talk.
phrases.zh: so as not to：為了不要…
phrases.ex: quietly 說明是「為了不」打擾講者。
dist: in order to：為了；同上，目的不合
in an effort to：努力想要

phrases.stem: My mother cut the apples into small pieces ____ my baby brother could eat them easily.
phrases.ex: cut into small pieces 是目的，表示「以便」。

phrases.stem: ____ you don't win the contest, you will still learn a lot from preparing for it.
phrases.ex: still learn a lot 表示「即使」沒贏也有收穫。
dist: Only if：只有在…才；與 still 矛盾

phrases.stem: ____ the restaurant was expensive, we went there to celebrate because it was our grandmother's favorite place.
phrases.zh: even though：雖然、儘管（事實的讓步）
phrases.ex: expensive 與 we went there 讓步，表示「雖然」。

phrases.stem: ____ the exams are over, the students can finally relax and enjoy their summer vacation.
phrases.ex: exams are over 與 finally relax 說明「既然」考完了。

phrases.stem: You will get a refund ____ you return the shoes within seven days; after that, we can't take them back.
phrases.ex: after that we can't take them back 說明「唯有在……條件下」。

phrases.stem: When you feel angry, take a deep breath ____ shouting at the people around you.
phrases.ex: take a deep breath 而不是大吼，表示「而非」。

phrases.stem: Since it was a beautiful day, we decided to walk to school ____ taking the crowded bus.
phrases.ex: walk 取代 taking the bus，表示「代替」。

phrases.stem: Living in the city center is expensive, ____ the noise and traffic jams you have to deal with every day.
phrases.zh: not to mention：更不用說、何況還有（用於肯定）
phrases.ex: 在 expensive 之外再補充壞處，表示「更不用說」。

phrases.stem: My little brother can't even swim across the pool, ____ the river behind our village.
phrases.zh: let alone：更不用說（用於否定之後）
phrases.ex: can't even … 後接更難的事，表示「更不用說」。

phrases.stem: Jenny has lived in Tokyo with a Japanese family for ten years. ____ her Japanese is so good.
phrases.ex: lived in Tokyo for ten years 說明「難怪」日文好。

phrases.stem: My mother always makes time to have dinner with us every evening, ____ busy she is at work.
phrases.ex: always makes time 表示「無論多忙」。

phrases.stem: There was nothing in the refrigerator ____ some old cheese and a bottle of water.
phrases.ex: nothing … 後接例外，表示「除了」。

phrases.stem: The company hires workers mainly based on their skills and experience, ____ where they went to school.
phrases.ex: based on their skills 表示「不論」學歷。

phrases.stem: ____ the new bridge, people in the village can now reach the city in twenty minutes instead of two hours.
phrases.ex: 新橋帶來好處，表示「多虧」。

phrases.stem: The baseball game was cancelled ____ the typhoon, so the fans got their money back.
phrases.ex: 颱風造成取消，表示「由於」。

phrases.stem: ____ the rising cost of rent, the coffee shop had to move to a smaller place outside the city center.
phrases.ex: rising cost 造成搬遷，表示「由於」。
dist: Instead of：而不是；與離鄉找工作矛盾

phrases.stem: ____ a recent study, teenagers who sleep less than six hours a night are more likely to feel sad.
phrases.ex: a recent study 是資料來源，表示「根據」。
dist: Instead of：而不是；與離鄉找工作矛盾

phrases.stem: ____ the long line at the ticket office, we had a great time at the zoo; the animals were active and the weather was perfect.
phrases.ex: 排隊是唯一缺點，其餘都很好，表示「除了」。

phrases.stem: The school sent each student a new uniform ____ a letter explaining the new dress rules.
phrases.ex: uniform 和 letter 一起寄，表示「連同」。

phrases.stem: The famous singer, ____ her band, will perform at the stadium next month, and tickets go on sale tomorrow.
phrases.ex: singer 與 her band 一起演出，表示「連同」。

phrases.stem: My parents let me go to the concert ____ I would come home before eleven and call them when it ended.
phrases.ex: come home before eleven 是條件，表示「條件是」。

phrases.stem: Visitors to the art museum may take photos inside the museum, ____ they do not use a flash.
phrases.ex: do not use a flash 是條件，表示「倘若」。

phrases.stem: ____ she only started learning English last year, she speaks it surprisingly well with her classmates.
phrases.ex: only started last year 與 surprisingly well，表示「考慮到」。

phrases.stem: This job is different from my last one ____ I can work from home three days a week.
phrases.ex: 說明「不同之處在於」可在家工作。

phrases.stem: Life in the busy city was ____ the quiet village life she had known as a child.
phrases.zh: a far cry from：與…相差甚遠
phrases.ex: busy city 與 quiet village 對比，表示「天差地遠」。

phrases.stem: The old bridge is badly damaged; it's only ____ before it falls into the river.
phrases.zh: a matter of time：只是時間早晚的問題
phrases.ex: badly damaged 說明倒塌「只是時間問題」。
dist: a waste of time：浪費時間
a piece of cake：輕而易舉

phrases.stem: The students were working ____ to finish their science project before the deadline at midnight.
phrases.zh: against the clock：分秒必爭、與時間賽跑
phrases.ex: before the deadline at midnight 說明是「與時間賽跑」。
dist: on the house：店家招待、免費

phrases.stem: When she first designed clothes that could be folded into a bag, people thought she was crazy, but she was simply ____.
phrases.zh: ahead of one's time：超越時代、思想領先
phrases.ex: thought she was crazy 與 simply 說明她「超越時代」。
dist: down to earth：務實；平易近人

phrases.stem: Whenever my grandfather starts telling stories about his childhood, all the children sit around him and are ____.
phrases.ex: sit around him 說明孩子們「專心聆聽」。
dist: out of breath：上氣不接下氣
on the house：店家招待、免費

phrases.stem: My best friend is always ready to help; she will come over ____ whenever I need someone to talk to.
options: at the drop of a hat
phrases.zh: at the drop of a hat：毫不猶豫地、立刻
phrases.ex: always ready to help 說明她「隨叫隨到」。
dist: in the dark：在黑暗中；被蒙在鼓裡

phrases.stem: The test results were wrong, so the scientists were ____ and had to start the experiment all over again.
phrases.zh: back to square one：回到原點、從頭開始
phrases.ex: start all over again 說明「回到原點」。
dist: on the house：店家招待、免費

phrases.stem: Many people helped ____ to prepare the wedding, though the guests only saw the happy couple.
phrases.ex: guests only saw the couple 說明其他人在「幕後」幫忙。
dist: on the house：店家招待、免費
out of the blue：突然；出乎意料

phrases.stem: News of the job opening spread ____, and soon everyone in the village had heard about it.
phrases.zh: by word of mouth：口耳相傳
phrases.ex: spread … everyone had heard 說明消息「口耳相傳」。
dist: on the house：店家招待、免費

phrases.stem: While I was looking through the magazine, an ad for a cheap trip to Japan ____, so I read it carefully.
phrases.zh: catch one's eye：吸引某人目光
phrases.ex: I read it carefully 說明廣告「吸引我的目光」。

phrases.stem: When boys and girls ____ in this country, they are allowed to vote and get a driver's license.
phrases.ex: allowed to vote 說明是「成年」。

phrases.stem: After the fire destroyed his shop, it took him months to ____ what had happened and start again.
phrases.zh: come to terms with：接受、面對（傷痛）
phrases.ex: took months 與 start again 說明他慢慢「接受」事實。

phrases.stem: I let my kids play video games on weekends, but I ____ at games that are full of violence.
phrases.zh: draw the line at：拒絕做、劃清界線
phrases.ex: but … games full of violence 說明這是「底線」。

phrases.stem: The student knew he had copied his friend's homework, so he went to the teacher's office to ____.
phrases.zh: face the music：勇於承擔後果
phrases.ex: knew he had copied 說明他去「承擔後果」。
dist: turn a blind eye：視而不見

phrases.stem: Sunny days are ____ in this rainy city in winter, so people go outside whenever the sun comes out.
phrases.zh: few and far between：稀少、難得
phrases.ex: go outside whenever the sun comes out 說明晴天「很少」。
dist: on the house：店家招待、免費

phrases.stem: Our teacher's question—"What will you regret when you're eighty?"—gave the whole class ____.
phrases.zh: food for thought：值得深思的事
phrases.ex: 引人深思的問題給了全班「值得思考的事」。
dist: a piece of cake：輕而易舉
a waste of time：浪費時間

phrases.stem: I want to say I am sorry ____ for what I said to you yesterday; I was angry, but I should not have said it.
options: from the bottom of my heart
phrases.zh: from the bottom of one's heart：衷心地
phrases.ex: 真心道歉，表示「發自內心」。
dist: from bad to worse：每況愈下
out of the blue：突然；出乎意料
on the house：店家招待、免費

phrases.stem: Cooking with chopsticks was hard for the exchange student at first, but she ____ it within a week.
phrases.zh: get the hang of：掌握訣竅、上手
phrases.ex: hard at first 與 within a week 說明她「學會訣竅」。

phrases.stem: Rock climbing looks scary, but my friend says it's a lot of fun, so I've decided to ____.
phrases.ex: looks scary, but a lot of fun 說明決定「試試看」。

phrases.stem: Great teachers often ____ for their students, staying after class to help anyone who is having trouble.
phrases.zh: go the extra mile：額外努力、多做一步
phrases.ex: staying after class 說明老師「額外付出」。

phrases.stem: Since the money comes from taxes, citizens should ____ how the city spends its budget.
phrases.zh: have a say in：對…有發言權
phrases.ex: money comes from taxes 說明市民應該「有發言權」。
dist: have a word with：和……談一談

phrases.stem: We need to ____ before sunrise if we want to reach the mountain before the crowds arrive.
phrases.ex: before sunrise 與 reach the mountain 說明要「出發上路」。

phrases.stem: After graduation, our class created a group chat to ____, even though we all live in different cities now.
phrases.ex: live in different cities 說明是為了「保持聯絡」。

phrases.stem: The team lost the first three games, but the coach told the players not to ____ because the season was still long.
phrases.ex: season was still long 說明不要「灰心」。

phrases.stem: The businessman ____ in the oil industry and later gave much of his money to build hospitals.
phrases.ex: gave much of his money 說明他「發了大財」。

phrases.stem: The small town ____ last year when a farmer found a huge piece of gold in his field.
phrases.zh: make headlines：登上頭條、成為新聞焦點
phrases.ex: found a huge piece of gold 說明小鎮「上了新聞頭條」。

phrases.stem: At the yard sale, my neighbor sold all kinds of ____, from old picture frames to cups without handles.
phrases.ex: from old picture frames to cups 說明是「零碎雜物」。
dist: bread and butter：生計；基本的東西

phrases.stem: We argued for an hour before we realized we were not ____; I was talking about Friday, and she meant Saturday.
phrases.zh: on the same page：看法一致、有共識
phrases.ex: talking about different days 說明兩人「想法不一致」。
dist: in the same boat：處境相同
up in the air：懸而未決

phrases.stem: We were enjoying a sunny afternoon at the beach when ____ a heavy rainstorm hit, and everyone ran for cover.
phrases.zh: out of the blue：突然、出乎意料地
phrases.ex: sunny afternoon 與 heavy rainstorm 說明「突然」。
dist: out of breath：上氣不接下氣
on the house：店家招待、免費

phrases.stem: I don't know how many people will come to the party, so I'll just ____ and buy more food if needed.
phrases.zh: play it by ear：見機行事、臨場決定
phrases.ex: don't know how many 說明要「隨機應變」。

phrases.stem: If you think your brother is overreacting, ____ and think about how you would feel if it happened to you.
phrases.zh: put oneself in someone's shoes：設身處地
phrases.ex: how you would feel if it happened to you 說明要「設身處地」。
dist: put your foot down：堅決反對

phrases.stem: The old man walks his dog around the lake every morning, ____, and he has done so for twenty years.
phrases.ex: every morning 與 for twenty years 說明「風雨無阻」。

phrases.stem: The boss said the report was "interesting," but if you ____, you'll see he didn't like it very much.
phrases.zh: read between the lines：讀出弦外之音
phrases.ex: said interesting but didn't like it 說明要「讀出言外之意」。
dist: read in a hurry：匆忙閱讀

phrases.stem: After losing badly in the first round, the champion tried to ____ by saying he had been sick.
phrases.ex: by saying he had been sick 說明他找藉口「保住面子」。

phrases.stem: The coffee at this small shop is ____; I've tried coffee all over the world, and nothing tastes better.
phrases.zh: second to none：首屈一指、最好的
phrases.ex: nothing tastes better 說明咖啡「首屈一指」。
dist: a piece of cake：輕而易舉
out of the blue：突然；出乎意料

phrases.stem: All the dancers were good, but the youngest one ____ with her amazing jumps, and the audience cheered loudly.
phrases.ex: the audience cheered loudly 說明她「搶盡鋒頭」。

phrases.stem: On long drives to the south, my parents always ____ driving so that neither of them gets too tired.
phrases.ex: so that neither of them gets too tired 說明是「輪流」。

phrases.stem: Most people think the teacher helps the students, but in this class it's ____; the students teach the teacher how to use the computer.
phrases.zh: the other way around：正好相反
phrases.ex: 分號後角色互換，表示「正好相反」。
dist: on the house：店家招待、免費
up in the air：懸而未決

phrases.stem: Before you post that angry message online, ____; once it's out there, you can't take it back.
phrases.ex: you can't take it back 說明要「三思」。

phrases.stem: The company has had its ____ over the past fifty years, but it is still one of the most successful in the country.
phrases.zh: ups and downs：起起伏伏、好壞時光
phrases.ex: over fifty years 與 still one of the biggest 說明「起起伏伏」。
dist: food for thought：值得深思的事

phrases.stem: The actor learned all his lines ____, so he didn't change a single word from the script.
phrases.ex: didn't change a single word 說明是「一字不差」。
dist: by word of mouth：口耳相傳
on the house：店家招待、免費
out of the blue：突然；出乎意料

phrases.stem: Our vacation plans are still ____ because my father doesn't know yet if he can take time off work.
phrases.zh: up in the air：懸而未決、尚未確定
phrases.ex: doesn't know yet 說明計畫「尚未確定」。
dist: on the house：店家招待、免費

phrases.stem: The answer was ____, but I couldn't remember it before the teacher called the next student.
options: on the tip of my tongue
on the top of my list
phrases.zh: on the tip of one's tongue：話到嘴邊（一時想不起來）
phrases.ex: couldn't remember it 說明話到嘴邊卻想不起來。
dist: on the top of my list：我的首選
on the house：店家招待、免費

phrases.stem: Even after becoming the company's president, she remained ____, eating lunch with the workers in the staff room.
phrases.zh: down to earth：務實的；平易近人的
phrases.ex: eating lunch with the workers 說明她「平易近人」。
dist: up in the air：懸而未決

phrases.stem: Children often take their parents' love ____ and only realize how much it means when they grow older.
phrases.zh: take ... for granted：視為理所當然
phrases.ex: only realize when they grow older 說明小時候「視為理所當然」。

phrases.stem: The workers threatened to stop working, but the company refused to ____ and would not raise their pay.
phrases.ex: refused to 與 would not raise their pay 說明公司「不讓步」。

phrases.stem: The website is a little slow today, so please ____ us while we fix the problem.
phrases.ex: while we fix the problem 說明請使用者「耐心等候」。

phrases.stem: The famous singer decided to ____ into acting, and her first movie will come out next year.
phrases.ex: singer 轉往 acting 說明是「拓展、跨足」新領域。
dist: break out：（戰爭、火災）爆發；逃出

phrases.stem: While shopping in Tokyo, we ____ a classmate from Taiwan; none of us expected to see each other there.
phrases.ex: none of us expected 說明是「偶然遇見」。

phrases.stem: When the caller started asking for my bank password, I ____ immediately and reported the number to the police.
phrases.ex: asking for my bank password 說明我立刻「掛斷電話」。

phrases.stem: My grandmother hated the idea of using a smartphone, but she ____ after we showed her how to video call her grandson in Canada.
phrases.ex: hated the idea 與 after we showed her 說明她「改變心意」。
dist: took off：起飛；脫下；突然成功

phrases.stem: Don't let a small argument ____ you and your best friend; talk to her and fix it.
phrases.zh: come between：離間、介入（兩人之間）
phrases.ex: talk to her and fix it 說明不要讓爭吵「破壞感情」。

phrases.stem: The school has decided to ____ students using phones during exams; anyone caught will get a zero.
phrases.ex: anyone caught will get a zero 說明是「嚴厲取締」。

phrases.stem: The doctor told my father to ____ salty food because his blood pressure was too high.
phrases.ex: blood pressure too high 說明要「減少」吃鹹。

phrases.stem: The trial ____ for months, and the family began to wonder if it would ever end.
phrases.ex: wonder if it would ever end 說明審判「拖延很久」。
dist: took off：起飛；脫下；突然成功

phrases.stem: When we were kids, my cousin and I were very close, but we ____ after his family moved to America.
phrases.ex: were very close 與 moved to America 說明兩人「漸行漸遠」。
dist: took off：起飛；脫下；突然成功

phrases.stem: The crowd's cheers ____ the speaker's voice, and nobody could hear what he was saying.
phrases.ex: nobody could hear 說明聲音被「蓋過」。

phrases.stem: Over time, the pain of losing the game slowly ____, and the players began to enjoy practice again.
phrases.ex: slowly 與 began to enjoy again 說明痛苦「漸漸消失」。
dist: took off：起飛；脫下；突然成功

phrases.stem: The small army managed to ____ the enemy's attack until help finally arrived from the capital.
phrases.ex: for three days until help arrived 說明要「擊退」敵人。

phrases.stem: Mark changed schools three times, so he learned quickly how to ____ new groups of people.
phrases.ex: changed schools three times 說明他學會「融入」新團體。

phrases.stem: The teacher told the boys to stop ____ and start working on their group project.
phrases.ex: stop … and start working 說明男孩們在「胡鬧」。
dist: settling down：安定下來；沒必要阻止

phrases.stem: It's easy to ____ when you're shopping online late at night, so set a limit before you start.
phrases.zh: get carried away：（太興奮而）失控、忘我
phrases.ex: set a limit 說明容易「失控、忘我」。

phrases.stem: We can talk about the party later; right now, let's ____ the meeting so we can all go home.
phrases.ex: right now 與 so we can all go home 說明要「繼續進行」會議。
dist: get away with：做壞事而逃過懲罰

phrases.stem: The invention of the car ____ big changes in how cities were planned and built.
phrases.ex: invention of the car 帶來城市規劃的改變，表示「引起」。

phrases.stem: When the game was over, the players had to ____ their uniforms to the coach so they could be washed.
phrases.ex: to the coach 說明是「交出」制服。

phrases.stem: After weeks of failing to name his new coffee shop, Ken finally ____ the perfect name while walking his dog.
phrases.ex: finally the perfect name 說明他「忽然想到」。

phrases.stem: Let's ____ buying a new car until we know whether you'll get the new job.
phrases.ex: until we know 說明先「延後」購車。

phrases.stem: If you want to stay healthy, try to ____ fried food and sweet drinks as much as possible.
phrases.ex: stay healthy 說明要「遠離」油炸食物與甜飲。

phrases.stem: The manager is in a meeting now, but she will ____ as soon as the meeting ends, so please wait for her phone call.
phrases.ex: wait for her phone call 說明她會「回電」。
dist: call up：打電話給（須接受詞）；召集

phrases.stem: Our country ____ other countries in the use of solar power, so the government started a new plan to catch up.
phrases.ex: started a new plan to catch up 說明我國「落後」他國。

phrases.stem: When reporters asked about the rumors, the actor just smiled and tried to ____ the whole thing.
phrases.ex: just smiled 說明他想「一笑置之」。

phrases.stem: In the days ____ the wedding, the bride was so busy that she hardly had time to sleep.
phrases.zh: lead up to：（時間上）在…之前、逼近
phrases.ex: In the days … the wedding 說明是婚禮「前夕」。
dist: looking up to：尊敬；對象是人

phrases.stem: My grades were poor last term, but things are ____ now that I've joined a study group.
phrases.ex: poor last term 與 now 對比，表示情況「好轉」。

phrases.stem: While the shop owner was busy with a customer, a young man ____ two expensive watches and ran away.
phrases.ex: ran away 說明他「偷走」了手錶。
dist: made up for：彌補；不及格不是彌補

phrases.stem: The new player was expected to be a star, but his performance didn't ____ the coach's high hopes.
phrases.zh: measure up to：比得上、達到（標準）
phrases.ex: expected to be a star, but 說明表現「不及」期望。

phrases.stem: I ____ the cake because I added salt instead of sugar, so we had to buy one from the bakery.
phrases.ex: salt instead of sugar 說明蛋糕被「搞砸」了。

phrases.stem: Many people work so hard that they ____ watching their children grow up, which they later regret.
phrases.ex: which they later regret 說明他們「錯過」了孩子的成長。

phrases.stem: My grandfather often ____ in front of the TV after lunch, and we had to wake him up for his afternoon walk.
phrases.ex: wake him up 說明他「打瞌睡」。
dist: took off：起飛；脫下；突然成功

phrases.stem: Thousands of cars and buses ____ our school every single day, so the street is always noisy.
phrases.ex: Thousands of cars 與 noisy 說明車輛「經過」學校。

phrases.stem: He ____ the chance to study in America because he didn't want to leave his sick mother alone.
phrases.ex: didn't want to leave his mother 說明他「放棄」機會。

phrases.stem: When you are away on a long vacation, letters and newspapers can ____ outside your door.
phrases.ex: away on a long vacation 說明信件會「堆積」。

phrases.stem: The doctors couldn't ____ the cause of his headaches, so they sent him for more tests.
phrases.ex: sent him for more tests 說明無法「確定」原因。

phrases.stem: A good speaker or teacher can ____ difficult ideas in simple words that everyone can understand.
phrases.ex: in simple words that everyone can understand 說明是「表達清楚」。

phrases.stem: The new mayor often ____ young people by visiting schools and answering their questions online.
phrases.zh: reach out to：主動接觸、伸出援手
phrases.ex: visiting schools 與 answering their questions 說明他主動「接觸、關懷」年輕人。
dist: runs out of：用完；語意不通

phrases.stem: Before her job interview, Amy ____ the company's history so that she could answer every question well.
phrases.zh: read up on：（為某目的）大量閱讀、研讀
phrases.ex: Before her interview 與 answer every question well 說明她「事先研讀」。

phrases.stem: While walking in the forest, the children ____ a small house that no one seemed to live in.
phrases.ex: while walking 意外發現房子，表示「偶然遇到」。

phrases.stem: Because fewer people came this year, the town decided to ____ the festival from five days to two.
phrases.ex: from five days to two 說明是「縮減」規模。

phrases.stem: I really wanted the red sweater, but they didn't have my size, so I had to ____ a blue one.
phrases.ex: didn't have my size 說明只好「將就」藍色的。

phrases.stem: When I visited my cousin in Hualien, she spent the whole day ____ her hometown, taking me to the beach and the night market.
phrases.ex: taking me to the beach and the night market 說明她「帶我四處參觀」。
dist: tell sb about：告訴某人關於（只用說的，不是帶著逛）
bring sb back to：帶某人回到（她家鄉不是我回去的地方）
look sb up：拜訪某人（不接 in 地方表導覽）

phrases.stem: The singer ____ the bad reviews of her new album and said she was proud of her work.
phrases.zh: shrug off：不在乎、不當一回事
phrases.ex: said she was proud of her work 說明她對負評「不在意」。

phrases.stem: The hard work is done, so ____ and let the machine finish the job for you.
phrases.ex: hard work is done 說明可以「放輕鬆」。

phrases.stem: You're eating your dinner much too fast; ____ and enjoy your food, or you'll get a stomachache.
phrases.ex: eating too fast 說明要「慢下來」。

phrases.stem: The famous actor was sick, so a young actor had to ____ him in the play at the last minute.
phrases.ex: actor was sick 說明另一位演員要「代替」他。

phrases.stem: All the children ____ very late on New Year's Eve to watch the fireworks at midnight.
phrases.ex: to watch the fireworks at midnight 說明孩子們「熬夜」。
dist: woke up：醒來；不會持續到三點
took off：起飛；脫下；突然成功

phrases.stem: Most arguments between the two neighbors ____ a small problem about where to park their cars.
phrases.ex: arguments 與 a small problem 說明爭吵「源於」停車問題。

phrases.stem: The new rule about school uniforms ____ a lot of trouble, and many students wrote letters to the principal.
phrases.zh: stir up：激起、引起（情緒、麻煩）
phrases.ex: many students wrote letters 說明規定「引起」了風波。

phrases.stem: Before the long holiday, my parents always ____ rice and vegetables because most stores will be closed.
phrases.zh: stock up on：囤積、大量購買
phrases.ex: most stores will be closed 說明要事先「囤積」。

phrases.stem: The two kinds of mushrooms look so similar that only experts can ____; one is safe to eat, but the other is deadly.
phrases.ex: look so similar 說明只有專家能「分辨」。

phrases.stem: The workers on strike said they would ____ until the company agreed to give them better pay.
phrases.ex: until the company agreed 說明工人要「堅持下去」。

phrases.stem: Remember to ____ your bus card before you get on; it has less than ten dollars left.
phrases.ex: less than ten dollars left 說明要「加值」。

phrases.stem: In her speech, the principal ____ the new library briefly, but she mostly talked about the sports day.
phrases.ex: briefly 與 mostly talked about 說明只是「稍微提到」。
dist: focused on：專注於；與 briefly 矛盾

phrases.stem: Tie your shoelaces before you go down the stairs, or you might ____ them and fall.
phrases.ex: or you might … and fall 說明會被鞋帶「絆倒」。

phrases.stem: The new coach managed to ____ the losing team, and they won the championship the following year.
phrases.ex: losing team 與 won the championship 說明教練「扭轉局面」。

phrases.stem: Months of caring for her sick mother ____ Lisa, and she began to feel tired all the time.
phrases.ex: Months of caring 與 tired all the time 說明她被「拖垮」。
dist: wore off：（效果）逐漸消退；不接人當受詞

phrases.stem: Before buying a used car, ____ the price, the condition of the car, and how much it will cost to repair.
phrases.ex: Before buying 與列出各項因素 說明要「權衡」。

phrases.stem: At first the villagers didn't trust the young doctor, but her kindness and skill soon ____ the whole village.
phrases.ex: didn't trust 與 her kindness 說明她「贏得」他們的信任。

phrases.stem: We only have ten minutes left before the bell, so let's ____ today's lesson with a short quiz.
phrases.ex: ten minutes left 說明要「結束」課程。

phrases.stem: The camera slowly ____ the small boy's face as he held up a sign that said, "Please save our river."
phrases.zh: zoom in on：（鏡頭）拉近特寫
phrases.ex: camera slowly 說明鏡頭「拉近特寫」男孩的臉。
dist: looked down on：看不起；方向相反

phrases.stem: When you hike in these mountains, ____ snakes; they often hide under rocks along the trail.
phrases.ex: often hide under rocks 說明要「留意」蛇。

phrases.stem: I keep saying I'll fix the broken chair, but I never seem to ____ it because I'm always busy.
phrases.zh: get around to：抽出時間去做
phrases.ex: never seem to … because always busy 說明一直沒「抽空去做」。
dist: get away with：做壞事而逃過懲罰

phrases.stem: The young businessman ____ many problems when he started his company, but he never gave up.
phrases.ex: but he never gave up 說明他「遭遇」許多困難。

phrases.stem: Learning a second skill gives you something to ____ if your first job doesn't work out.
phrases.ex: if your first job doesn't work out 說明要有「依靠」。

phrases.stem: The company ____ its promise to give workers a bonus, and many of them were angry.
phrases.zh: go back on (one's word)：食言、違背
phrases.ex: many of them were angry 說明公司「違背」承諾。

phrases.stem: Library users can ____ up to ten books at a time and keep them for two weeks.
phrases.ex: keep them for two weeks 說明是「借出」書。

phrases.stem: Every Saturday, my father ____ our old clothes at the community center so they can be given to people in need.
phrases.zh: drop off：（開車）載某人到某處放下
phrases.ex: so they can be given to people in need 說明是「送去、放下」。

ex: The manager asked the cashier to {account} for the missing money, but she could not give any reason.
Can you {account} for your absence from class yesterday? The teacher wants a good excuse.
Young people {account} for nearly 60 percent of the shop's customers, so it sells mostly fashionable clothes.
Exports {account} for about half of the country's income, so a weak world economy hurts it badly.
She opened a bank {account} and put part of her salary into it every month.
Someone stole my password and used my {account} to buy things online without my permission.
The witness gave the police a detailed {account} of what happened just before the accident.
According to his own {account}, he was at home alone watching TV when the crime took place.
The government promised to {address} the problem of air pollution before it gets any worse and more people get sick.
If we don't {address} these complaints quickly, more customers will stop buying our products.
The president gave a moving {address} to the nation after the earthquake, asking everyone to help one another.
In her opening {address}, the principal welcomed all the new students and their parents to the school.
When you {address} the judge in court, you must call her "Your Honor" and speak politely.
He does not know how to {address} his new boss, so he just calls him "sir" to be polite.
Please write your name and {address} clearly so that we can send the package to your home.
I moved last month, so the letter was sent to my old {address} by mistake.
I really {appreciate} your help with the move; I couldn't have done it without you.
We would {appreciate} it if you could reply to this email by Friday.
She stopped on the bridge to {appreciate} the beautiful view of the mountains.
Living in the city, she has learned to {appreciate} the quiet beauty of the countryside.
I don't think you {appreciate} how serious this problem is; we could lose all our customers.
Few people {appreciate} how hard it is to raise three children alone until they actually try it.
The house has {appreciated} greatly in value since we bought it twenty years ago.
Land near the new train station is expected to {appreciate} quickly, so many people are buying it now.
I cannot {bear} the noise from the building site next door; it starts at six every morning.
She could hardly {bear} the pain after the accident, so the nurse gave her some medicine.
As the team leader, he must {bear} full responsibility for the failure of the project.
The company will {bear} all the costs of your business trip, including hotels and meals.
Please {bear} in mind that the museum closes at five, so don't arrive too late.
{Bear} in mind that prices may change, so check the website again before you order.
These apple trees did not {bear} any fruit this year because the summer was too dry.
In the old story, the queen {bore} a son who later became a wise and powerful king.
After dinner, the waiter brought us the {bill}, and we were surprised at how expensive the meal was.
If you don't pay your phone {bill} by Friday, the company will cut off your service.
The new {bill} must be passed by lawmakers before it can become law next year.
Many lawmakers voted against the {bill} because it would raise taxes on ordinary families.
He paid for the coffee with a hundred-dollar {bill} and told the waiter to keep the change.
She found a five-hundred-dollar {bill} in the pocket of her old jeans while she was washing her clothes.
The bird used its long, thin {bill} to catch small fish in the shallow river.
Ducks have flat {bills} that help them find food in the mud at the bottom of ponds.
The post office is just two {blocks} away, so you can easily walk there in five minutes.
We live on the same {block}, so we often see each other at the bus stop in the morning.
A fallen tree {blocked} the road after the typhoon, so all the cars had to turn around.
The tall building across the street {blocks} the sun, so our apartment is dark even at noon.
She cut the cheese into small {blocks} and put them on a plate for the guests.
The children built a tall tower with colorful wooden {blocks} on the living room floor.
We {booked} a table for six at the restaurant because it is always crowded on weekends.
You should {book} your flight early; tickets get much more expensive close to the holidays.
This {book} about the history of Taiwan is so interesting that I finished reading it in two days.
I borrowed three {books} from the library to prepare for my history report next week.
The shop owner kept the {books} carefully, writing down every dollar the shop earned and spent.
After checking the company's {books}, the boss discovered that someone had been stealing money for years.
If you keep driving that fast on wet roads, you are {bound} to have an accident sooner or later.
With so many talented players, the team is {bound} to win the championship this year.
This train is {bound} for Kaohsiung and will stop at Taichung and Tainan on the way.
The ship was {bound} for Japan when it ran into a terrible storm at sea.
The ball went out of {bounds}, so the other team got to throw it back in.
His love for his children knows no {bounds}; he would do anything to make them happy.
After working for three hours straight, we took a short {break} and had some coffee.
During the ten-minute {break} between classes, many students rushed to the shop to buy snacks.
If you {break} the law, you may have to pay a fine or even go to prison.
He {broke} his promise and didn't show up at the party, so his best friend was very upset.
The young runner {broke} the world record, finishing the race faster than anyone before her.
The movie {broke} the record for the most tickets sold on its first day in Taiwan.
The doctor gently {broke} the news to the family that their father had only months to live.
Who will {break} the bad news to her that the school trip has been canceled?
The {capital} of Taiwan is Taipei, and most important government offices are located there.
The city of Paris, the {capital} of France, attracts millions of visitors from all over the world every year.
To start a new business, you need enough {capital} to rent an office and hire workers.
The small company could not grow because it lacked the {capital} to buy new machines.
Remember to begin every sentence with a {capital} letter and end it with a period.
Please write your name in {capitals} on the form so that we can read it easily.
Some people believe that {capital} punishment can stop serious crimes such as murder, but others disagree.
In some countries, selling large amounts of drugs is a {capital} crime, and people may be put to death for it.
